n-m-h3-prob-02.title: Zviitiko Zviviri Zvisingagone Kuitika Pamwe Chete: Zvizvimiriri here?
n-m-h3-prob-02.goal: Siyanisa "hazvigone kuitika pamwe chete" ne "zvizvimiriri," uye utsanangure kufunga uchishandisa zvinoreva kuzvimiririra (kuziva chimwe hakuchinji mukana wechimwe).
n-m-h3-prob-02.material: Dhayisi yakarurama inokandwa kamwe. Chiitiko A ndechekuti kukanda i1 kana 2, uye B ndechekuti i3 kana 4. Zviitiko zviviri hazvigoni kuitika panguva imwe chete. Jimin akaona izvi ndokugadzira chirevo chiri pazasi.
n-m-h3-prob-02.thinking.0: Tonga kana chirevo chakarurama uchishandisa humbowo
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.prompt: Jimin akati, "Zviitiko A naB hazvigone kuitika panguva imwe chete, saka hazvikanganisani. Saka zvizvimiriri." Ndekupi kuongorora kunokodzera zvikuru kwechirevo chaJimin?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.0: Funga iwe pachako kuti chii chinoitika kumukana waB kana waziva kuti A yaitika.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kana zvizvimiriri, kuziva A kunofanira kusiya mukana waB wakafanana nepakutanga. Fananidza kana zvichidaro mumamiriro aya.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.a: Zvakaipa. Kana waziva kuti A yaitika, B haichagoni kuitika, saka mukana waB wakasiyana nepakutanga.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.b: Zvakarurama. Sezvo zviitiko zviviri zvisingaitiki pamwe chete, chimwe hachichinji mukana wechimwe.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.b: Wakaverenga "hazvigone kuitika pamwe chete" se "hazvikanganisani." Kuti chiitiko chimwe chaitika kuita kuti chimwe chisagoneka chinhu chine simba guru.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.c: Zvakarurama. Sezvo A naB zvine mukana wakafanana, chimwe hachikanganisi chimwe.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.c: Mikana kuenzana muhukuru nekuzvimiririra zvinhu zvakasiyana. Kuzvimiririra kunoenderana nekuti mukana wechimwe unochinja kana waziva chimwe here.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.d: Zvakaipa. Sezvo A naB zvine mikana yakasiyana, chimwe chinokanganisa chimwe.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.d: Mikana yakasiyana haireve kuti zviitiko hazvizvimiriri. Zvaunofanira kufananidza ndezvekuti mukana wechimwe unochinja kana waziva chimwe here.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.explain: Kana A naB zvisingagone kuitika panguva imwe chete uye chimwe nechimwe chine mukana wakakura kupfuura 0, saka kuziva kuti A yaitika kunochinja mukana waB kuita 0. Dai zvaizvimiriri, P(B|A)=P(B) yaifanira kushanda, saka hazvizvimiriri. Pachidhayisi, kana A i1 kana 2 uye B i3 kana 4, P(B)=1/3, asi kana A yaitika, P(B|A)=0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.prompt: Nekukanda kumwe chete kwedhayisi, funga zvakare chiitiko C (kukanda kweeven) nechiitiko D (kukanda kwe3 kana pazasi). Sarudza mapairi ose ezviitiko anozvimiririra kune mumwe nemumwe.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kune pairi rega rega, wana P(zviitiko zvose zviviri zvinoitika) ne P(wekutanga)×P(wechipiri) uye ufananidze kana dzakaenzana.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wanyora kukanda kuri kwechiitiko chega chega, wobva wawana kukanda kuri kwezviitiko zvose zviviri.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.a: Wakatora pairi risingagone kuitika pamwe chete serinozvimiririra. Kana chimwe chaitika, mukana wechimwe unova 0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.d: Wakatora A kuva mukati meD se "hazvina chekuita." Kana A yaitika, D inoitika zvechokwadi, saka mukana waD unochinja.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.explain: P(A)=1/3, P(C)=1/2, uye P(A∩C)=P({2})=1/6=P(A)P(C), saka A naC zvizvimiriri. B naC zvizvimiririwo, nokuti B∩C={4} uye 1/6=1/3×1/2. Kune A naD, P(A∩D)=1/3 asi P(A)P(D)=1/6, saka hazvizvimiriri. Zviitiko zvinogona kuzvimiririra kunyange zvichiyambukirana, uye zviitiko zvisingayambukirani (kana mikana yadzo yakakura kupfuura 0) hazvigoni kuzvimiririra.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora tsananguro yekutumira kuna Jimin. Zvichibva pazvinoreva kuti A naB zvizvimiriri, tsanangura kuti nei A naB zvisingazvimiriri mumuenzaniso uyu wedhayisi, uchishandisa "mukana waB kana tichiziva kuti A yaitika."
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti kukanda kupi kunosara kana waziva kuti A yaitika, uye uone kana chero ichi chiri chaB.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mukana wekutanga waB nemukana panguva iyoyo padivi nedivi mumutsara mumwe uye ufananidze.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso Kana waziva kuti A yaitika, saka B ...
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvinoreva kuzvimiririra se "kuziva chiitiko chimwe hakuchinji mukana wechimwe" here?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mumuenzaniso uyu, wakataura mukana wekutanga waB nemukana wayo mushure mekuziva kuti A yaitika zvose here?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura kuti "hazvigone kuitika panguva imwe chete" ne "zvizvimiriri" zvakasiyana here?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.0: Dai zviitiko zvaizvimiriri, mukana waB waizoramba uri 1/3 kunyange mushure mekuziva kuti A yaitika. Asi kana A (1 kana 2) yaitika, B (3 kana 4) haigoni kuitika, saka mukana wayo unova 0. Mukana unochinja, saka hazvizvimiriri.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.1: Pakutanga, mukana waB i chikamu chimwe pa3. Asi kana tikaziva kuti dhayisi inoratidza 1 kana 2, saka 3 kana 4 hazvigoneki, saka mukana waB unochinja kuita 0. Dai zvaizvimiriri hazvaifanira kuchinja, asi zvakachinja, saka hazvizvimiriri.

n-m-h3-prob-08.title: Mari Yemubairo Wemutambo Wakamiswa: Tinofanira Kuigovana Sei?
n-m-h3-prob-08.goal: Ronga ruzivo rwunodiwa kutsvaga probability yekukunda, uye gadzira sample space ine mikana yakaenzana nekufungidzira kuti mutambo waizopera nokukurumidza unotambwa kusvika pakupera.
n-m-h3-prob-08.material: Team A ne Team B vaitamba mutambo apo chikwata chekutanga kukunda mitambo 3 chinotora mubairo wose we80,000 won, asi wakamiswa nechikonzero. Kusvika zvino Team A ine kukunda 2 uye Team B ine kukunda 1. Zvikwata zviviri zvakabvumirana kugovana mubairo zvichienderana ne "probability yekuti chikwata chimwe nechimwe chikunde mumitambo yakasara."
n-m-h3-prob-08.thinking.1: Kugadzira sample space ine mikana yakaenzana
n-m-h3-prob-08.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti nei fungidziro isingachinji mhedzisiro
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.prompt: Team A ne Team B vaitamba mutambo apo chikwata chekutanga kukunda mitambo 3 chinotora mubairo wose we80,000 won, asi wakamiswa. Kusvika zvino Team A ine kukunda 2 uye Team B ine kukunda 1. Mubairo ugovanwe zvichienderana ne probability yekukunda kwechikwata chimwe nechimwe. Sarudza ruzivo rwose rwakakosha kutsvaga ma probability aya. (Hapana chinozivikanwa nezve unyanzvi hwezvikwata.)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.hint.0: Bvisa chikamu cheruzivo chimwe nechimwe uye ufunge kuti probability yekukunda yemangwana ingaverengwa pasina rwo here.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora zvaunoda kuti uzive kuti chikwata chimwe nechimwe chinofanira kukunda mitambo mingani zvakare kuti chive champion.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.a: Kurongeka kwemitambo yakahwinwa kusvika zvino (kuti yaiva A, B, A here)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti kurongeka kunokosha. Probability yekukunda yemangwana inoenderana nehuwandu hwekukunda hwazvino nemitambo yasara; kurongeka kwakaunganidzwa kukunda hakuna mhedzisiro.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.b: Huwandu hwekukunda kwechikwata chimwe nechimwe kusvika zvino (kukunda 2 nekukunda 1)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.c: Huwandu hwekukunda hunodiwa kuti ive champion (chekutanga kukunda 3)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.r.d: Nguva haina chekuita nekukunda nekukundwa kwemangwana. Funga kuti ndiruzivo runokanganisa probability yekukunda here.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.e: Mukana wekuti chikwata chimwe nechimwe chikunde mutambo mumwe
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.explain: Huwandu hwekukunda hwazvino nehwekukunda hunodiwa kuti ive champion zvinotara kuti chikwata chimwe nechimwe chinofanira kukunda mitambo mingani zvakare (A inoda mutambo 1, B inoda mitambo 2), uye mukana wekukunda mutambo mumwe unotara probability yekuti izvozvo zviitike. Kurongeka kwekukunda nenguva yakatorwa hazvikanganisi mitambo yasara, saka hazvidiwi.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.prompt: Ngatitii zvikwata zviviri zvine mukana wakaenzana wekukunda mutambo mumwe uye mitambo haikanganisani. Tsvaga probability yekuti Team A ikunde championship, uye unyorewo mubairo Team A unofanira kugamuchira. Sanganisira mumhinduro yako nyaya dzawakaverenga.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora zvinofanira kuitika mumitambo yasara kuti Team A ikunde nekuti Team B ikunde.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kunyangwe mutambo waizopera nokukurumidza, funga kuti kufungidzira kuti mitambo yose yasara inotambwa kunokubvumira kuita nyaya dzakaenzana here.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakafunga nyaya apo Team A inokunda neapo Team B inokunda zvakaparadzana here?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakasarudza nyaya zvekuti imwe neimwe ine mukana wakaenzana here?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakagovana mari yemubairo uchishandisa ma probability here?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.model.0: Kana tichifungidzira kutamba mitambo yose miviri yasara, mhedzisiro ina (A,A),(A,B),(B,A),(B,B) dzine mikana yakaenzana. Kuti B ikunde, B inofanira kukunda mitambo yose miviri, iyo ndi (B,B) chete, saka B ine 1/4 uye A ine 3/4. Saka A inofanira kugamuchira 60,000 won uye B 20,000 won.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.model.1: Kuti B ikunde, B inofanira kukunda mitambo miviri yasara nenzira inotevedzana, uye probability iyoyo ndi1/2×1/2=1/4. Saka probability yekuti A ikunde ndi3/4, uye A inofanira kugamuchira 60,000 won pamubairo we80,000 won.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.prompt: Minji akati, "Kana A ikakunda mutambo unotevera mutambo unopera, saka hazvina kururama kufungidzira kutamba mitambo yose miviri yasara, nekuti zvakasiyana nezvaizoitika chaizvo." Mhinduro ipi inokodzera zvakanyanya kuchirevo chaMinji?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.hint.0: Tsvaga probability yenzira imwe neimwe pamatatu apo mutambo chaiwo waizopera, uye utarise kuti anowedzera kusvika ku1 here.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.hint.1: Kana mitambo yose miviri yasara ikatambwa, gadzira tafura inoratidza kuti ndiani anokunda championship pamhedzisiro imwe neimwe yemana.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.a: Mitambo miviri yakawanda inotambwa chaizvo, saka mhedzisiro yose mana inogona kuitika.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.a: Tsananguro iyi inopikisana nechokwadi chekuti mutambo unopera nokukurumidza. Havatambi zvose chaizvo.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.b: Huwandu hwemitambo kusvika pakupera hunofanira kuva hwakafanana kuti mubairo ugovanwe zvakarurama.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.b: Wakavakira kuenzana pahuwandu hwemitambo kusvika pakupera. Chiyero ndiyo probability yekukunda.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.c: Ndezvekushevedzera chete, saka hazvina basa chero bedzi kukosha kwakarurama.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.c: Hauna kutaura kuti nei kukosha kwakarurama. Pane chikonzero chekuti zvakanaka kuritarisa nenzira iyi.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.d: Mitambo mushure mekunge mutambo watarwa haichinji chikwata chinokunda, saka mhedzisiro yakafanana kunyangwe ichitambwa yose.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.explain: Kana A ikakunda mutambo unotevera, A ichampion, uye mitambo yakazotevera haichinji anokunda. Saka kunyangwe tichifungidzira kuti mitambo yose miviri yasara inotambwa, "ndiani anokunda championship" hazvichinji, uye mhedzisiro yose mana inova neprobability yakaenzana ye1/4, izvo zvinoita kuti kuverenga kuve nyore. Kana tikatora nzira nhatu dzinopera nadzo mutambo chaiwo ("A inokunda" ne1/2, "B inokunda wobva A yakunda" ne1/4, "B inokunda kaviri nenzira inotevedzana" ne1/4) sedzakaenzana, izvozvo hazvina kururama.

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.0: Kugadzirisa kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.title: Kana Tikaunganidza Ma Term, Huwandu Hwakafanana Here?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.topic: Series: partial sum nema infinite geometric series
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.goal: Nekunyora ma partial sum iwe pachako, tarisa uye utsanangure kuti kuconverge kwe series ine ma term akaunganidzwa hakutibvumiri kuita mhedziso yekuti series yekutanga inoconverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.material: Shamwari nhatu dziri kupokana nezvehuwandu hwe series 1−1+1−1+1−1+… . Ruzivo runoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe. (General term ndi (−1)^(n−1): 1 kana n iri odd, −1 kana n iri even.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.1: Kutonga kuconverge kwe series uchishandisa ma partial sum
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.2: Kuronga kuti nzira ipi inoshanda pakati pe series yakaunganidzwa ne series yekutanga
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.prereq.1: Kutsanangura huwandu hwe series se limit yema partial sum ayo
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.prompt: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, sarudza kutonga uchishandisa zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kana ruzivo rutsva rwunoonekwa, funga zvakare kuti kutonga kwawakasarudza kuchangopfuura kuchiri kwakanaka here.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kuunganidza kwakasiyana kuviri uye uenzanise kuti kukosha kumwe chete kunobuda here zvisinei nekuti ma term akaunganidzwa sei.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Mina akaunganidza ma term maviri panguva imwe chete akanyora (1−1)+(1−1)+(1−1)+…, saka parenthesis imwe neimwe ndi0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unotonga kuti huwandu hwe series iyi ndehupi?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Zvichienderana nekuti ma term akaunganidzwa sei, zvose 0 ne1 zvakabuda. Saka unogona kuona kuti zvakakurumidza kutaura huwandu nekuti "ndakaunganidza nenzira imwe."
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ndi0: nekuti boka rimwe nerimwe ndi0
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakabvuma mhedzisiro yekuunganidza kumwe chete sehuwandu. Uku ndiko kutonga kunouya kutanga.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ndi1: nekuti kusiya term yekutanga 1 uye kuunganidza se 1+(−1+1)+(−1+1)+… kunopa 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaedza kuunganidza kwakasiyana ukawana kukosha kwakasiyana. Asi waigona kutarisa zvakanyanya chokwadi chekuti wakakurumidza kusarudza kuti kukosha ikoko ndihwo huwandu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zvakakurumidza kusarudza: tinofanira kutarisa kuti kukosha kwakafanana here kana tichichinja kuunganidza
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uri kukahadzika kuti mhedzisiro inogona kuchinja zvichienderana nekuti ma term akaunganidzwa sei.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Kunyora ma partial sum nenzira yakarongeka kunopa S_1=1, S_2=0, S_3=1, S_4=0, S_5=1, ….
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Series inotsanangurwa ne limit yema partial sum ayo. Zvino unotonga sei?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Ma partial sum haasvike pakukosha kumwe chete, saka series iyi inodiverge. Huwandu hwayo hahutarwi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Inoconverge ku0: nekuti S_2, S_4, … dzose ndi0
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakatarisa ma partial sum e even-numbered chete. Wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti e odd-numbered ndi1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Inoconverge ku1: nekuti S_1, S_3, … dzose ndi1
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakatarisa ma partial sum e odd-numbered chete. Wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti e even-numbered ndi0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Haiconverge: nekuti ma partial sum anochinjana pakati pe0 ne1 uye haasvike pakukosha kumwe chete
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakatarisa maitiro ema partial sum ose uye wakatonga zvichienderana ne definition ye limit.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Asi series 0+0+0+… yakagadzirwa naMina nekuunganidza yakajeka kuti inoconverge ku0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kubva pachokwadi chekuti series yakaunganidzwa inoconverge, tinogona kutaura chii nezve series yekutanga?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana series yekutanga inoconverge, series yakaunganidzwa inoconverge kukosha kumwe chete. Asi zvakapesana hazvishande, nekuti series yakaunganidzwa inoshandisa S_2, S_4, … chete.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Series yekutanga inoconvergewo, nehuwandu hwakafanana: nekuti takangounganidza ma term chete
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakashandisa intuition yekuti kuunganidza kunochengeta huwandu husina kuchinja munzira mbiri dzose.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Hapana chinogona kutarwa: nekuti ma partial sum e series yakaunganidzwa chete mamwe ema partial sum ekutanga
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakacherekedza kuti series yakaunganidzwa inoshandisa mamwe chete ema partial sum ekutanga.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Huwandu hwe series yekutanga ndi0 ne1 zvose: nekuti nzira imwe neimwe yekuunganidza ine huwandu
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakati series isingaconvergi ine huwandu hwuviri. Huwandu hunotsanangurwa se limit imwe ye ma partial sum.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga kuverenga 0 nekupanga kwaitaridzika kunonzwisisika, asi kutonga kwako kwakashanduka kana wanyora mapartial sums. Kuti series inosvika here hakusarudzwi nekuti yakapangwa sei asi nemafambiro emapartial sums ese S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.prompt: Soyoung akati, "Kupanga nema bracket kwakapa 0+0+0+…, saka huwandu hwe 1−1+1−1+… ndi 0." Nyora tsananguro yekutumira kuna Soyoung. Sanganisira kuti mapartial sums eseries yepakutanga anofamba sei uye kuti mapartial sums eseries yakapangwa anobatana sei nemapartial sums epakutanga.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4 iwe pachako uye unyore kuti makosha anoshanduka sei.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nongedza kuti mapartial sums epakutanga api ndiwo mapartial sums eseries yakapangwa (1−1)+(1−1)+….
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here chaizvo makosha emapartial sums S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4?

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga here kana "series yakapangwa inosvika" ichivimbisa "series yepakutanga inosvika"?

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.1: Mapartial sums anodzokorora 1,0,1,0 uye haasvike. Kana ukashandura kupanga kuva 1+(−1+1)+(−1+1)+…, inopa 1, saka kukosha kunoenderana nekupanga. Series yakapangwa kuva 0 hazvina chekuita nehuwandu hweseries yepakutanga.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.2: Soyoung, S_n yeseries yepakutanga ndi 1 kune n isina kuenzana uye 0 kune n yakaenzana, saka haina muganho (inoparadzana). Kupanga nema bracket kunoreva kutarisa S_2, S_4, … chete, dzinopa 0, saka hakusi humbowo hwokuti series yepakutanga inosvika.

n-m-h3-serieslim-04.topic: Series: partial sum nema infinite geometric series
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.title: 0.999… Iri Pasi Zvishoma Pe 1 Here?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.goal: Tsanangura, uchishandisa muganho wemusiyano, kuti muganho unogona kuva huwandu kunyange mapartial sums asingasviki napo, uye gadzira imwe series ine chimiro chakafanana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.material: Shamwari mbiri dzinopokana kuti 0.999… (ne 9 dzinodzokororwa nokusingaperi) yakaenzana ne 1 here. Yuna: "0.9, 0.99, 0.999, … dzinogara dziri pasi pe 1 zvisinei kuti waenda kure sei, saka 0.999… iri pasi pe 1." Dohyun: "0.999…=9/10+9/100+9/1000+…, igeometric series isingaperi ine izwi rekutanga 9/10 neratio inofanana 1/10, saka huwandu hwayo ndi 1."
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.thinking.0: Kurongera kana humbowo hwechirevo hunotsigira mhedziso yacho
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.prompt: Ongorora zvirevo nehumbowo zveshamwari mbiri, uye usarudze kutonga kunokodzera zvakanyanya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa zvakasiyana kana humbowo hwaYuna huri chokwadi uye kana mhedziso yake inotevera kubva muhumbowo uhwo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kuti huwandu hweseries hunotsanangurwa sei, uye uenzanise kana kuverenga kwaDohyun kuchiwirirana netsananguro iyoyo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.a: Dohyun akarurama: huwandu hweseries ndiwo muganho wemapartial sums ayo, uye mapartial sums anosvika padyo ne 1 zvisingaperi
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakatonga maererano netsananguro yehuwandu (muganho wemapartial sums). Unoonawo kuti humbowo hwaYuna hahutungamiri kumhedziso yake.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.b: Huwandu hahusarudzwi: nokuti mapartial sums anoramba achichinja nokusingaperi uye haagoni kuva nekukosha kumwe chete
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakavhiringidza mapartial sums achiramba achichinja nekusasvika. Kunyange achichinja, series inosvika kana mapartial sums achisvika pakukosha kumwe chete.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.c: Yuna akarurama: hapana partial sum yakaenzana ne 1, saka 0.999… yakasiyana ne 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakatakura chimiro chepartial sum imwe neimwe zvakananga kumuganho. Muganho hausi umwe wemapartial sums.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.d: Vese vakarurama: 0.999… iri pasi pe 1 nehuwandu hudiki zvisingaperi, asi pakuverenga inotorwa se 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.d: Wakati musiyano wakanaka kubva ku 1 unoramba uripo, uye wakatiwo yakaenzana ne 1. Pakati penhamba chaiyo, nhamba mbiri dzakafanana kana musiyano wadzo uri 0 chete.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.explain: Huwandu hweseries ndiwo muganho wemapartial sums S_n. Pano S_n=1−(1/10)^n uye muganho ndi 1, saka 0.999…=1. Humbowo hwaYuna ichokwadi, asi kubva ku "S_n dzese dziri pasi pe 1" hazvitevere kuti "lim S_n iri pasi pe 1" (mumuganho inova ≤).
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.prompt: Chirevo chaYuna chokuti "zvisinei kuti waunganidza kusvika ku n ipi, partial sum iri pasi pe 1" ichokwadi. Asi mhedziso yake yakanganisa. Tsanangura chikonzero uchishandisa 1−S_n, kukosha kwe 1 kubvisa partial sum S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora S_1, S_2, S_3 uye unyore musiyano wazvo wega wega kubva ku 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.1: Batanidza kuti musiyano uwu unofamba sei n painokura nekuti huwandu hweseries hunosarudzwa semuganho we chii.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza here kukosha uku kusvika padyo ne 0 nehuwandu kuva 1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakataura here kuti muganho unogona kuva 1 kunyange mapartial sums asingasviki ku 1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.0: 1−S_n=1/10^n inogara yakakura kupfuura 0, saka ichokwadi kuti S_n iri pasi pe 1. Asi n painokura, 1/10^n inosvika padyo ne 0 zvisingaperi, saka muganho we S_n ndi 1, uye sezvo huwandu hweseries ari muganho uwo, 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.1: Hapana partial sum inosvika ku 1, asi 1−S_n=(1/10)^n inosvika ku 0. Huwandu hweseries ndiwo muganho wemapartial sums, saka ndi 1. Kunyange mapartial sums ese ari pasi pe 1, muganho unogona kuva 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.2: S_n dzese dziri pasi pe 1, asi musiyano 0.00…01 unova mudiki zvisingaperi n painokura, saka muganho ndi 1, saka 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira iwe pachako series ine chimiro chakafanana. Nyora geometric series dzisingaperi mbiri a + ar + ar² + … dzine izwi rekutanga a neratio inofanana r dzine huwandu 1 uye dzine mapartial sums ese ari pasi pe 1, uchishandisa ma ratio inofanana akasiyana. (Unogona kunyora ma decimal.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti equation ipi inofanira kushanda pakati pe a ne r kuti huwandu huve 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga S_1 ne S_2 kutarisa kuti r inofanira kuva nechiratidzo chipi kuti mapartial sums ese ave pasi pe 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c1: Kukosha kwakazara kweratio inofanana kuri pasi pe 1, saka inosvika.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c1: |r|<1 haishande, saka iyi haisi series inosvika ine huwandu 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c3: Mazwi ese akanaka, saka mapartial sums ari pasi pe 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c3: Ratio inofanana haina kunaka, saka partial sum inogona kupfuura 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.explain: Kana a=1−r uye 0<r<1, partial sum S_n=1−r^n inogara iri pasi pe 1 asi muganho wayo ndi 1. a=0.9, r=0.1 ndi 0.999… chaizvo. Kana r isina kunaka, a=1−r>1, saka partial sum yekutanga yatopfuura 1.

n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaSeojin.
n-m-h3-integc-01.title: Tingavimba Nemutengo Wakawanikwa Ne Integration by Parts here?
n-m-h3-integc-01.topic: Integration: ma errors mu integration by parts nekutarisa nechiratidzo che integrand
n-m-h3-integc-01.goal: Wana uye ugadzirise mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso ye integration-by-parts, uye utsanangure kuti ungatarisa sei chiratidzo che definite integral uchishandisa chiratidzo che integrand, nemiganhu yekutarisa uku.
n-m-h3-integc-01.material: Seojin akagadzirisa ∫_0^π x sin x dx achishandisa integration by parts. (∫_0^π i definite integral kubva ku 0 kusvika ku π. [F]_0^π = F(π) − F(0).)
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.1: Fungidzira chiratidzo che definite integral kubva pachiratidzo che integrand
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.2: Ongorora renji apo nzira yekutarisa inoshanda (ma intervals apo chiratidzo chinochinja)
n-m-h3-integc-01.prereq.1: Ma derivatives nema antiderivatives e trigonometric functions
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kune mutsetse wega wega unopa function itsva yakawanikwa (u', v), tarisa function iyoyo nemamiriro ekutanga.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Pamutsetse apo v yakawanikwa, siyanisa v iwe pachako uye utarise kana yakaenzana ne v'.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.0: Kune ∫_0^π x sin x dx, ngatitii u=x ne v'=sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.2: Nefomula ye integration by parts, ∫_0^π x sin x dx = [x cos x]_0^π − ∫_0^π 1·cos x dx.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.3: [x cos x]_0^π = π·cos π − 0 = −π, uye ∫_0^π cos x dx = [sin x]_0^π = 0.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 ndiwo unotanga kukanganisa. Derivative ye cos x i −sin x, saka v ine v'=sin x i −cos x, kwete cos x. Kubva pamutsetse 3, v isina kururama inongoiswa mufomula, saka fomula nekuverenga zvakarurama asi mhedzisiro haina kururama.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mutsara usina kururama uye utsvage kukosha kwe ∫_0^π x sin x dx. Wobva wanyora mumutsara mumwe kana miviri, uchishandisa chiratidzo che x sin x pa 0≤x≤π, kuti nei −π yaSeojin isingagoni kuva kukosha.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga zvakare v ine v'=sin x, uiise mufomula yemutsara 3, uye uverenge pa limit.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa mutafura kuti x ne sin x imwe neimwe ndi0 kana kupfuura pa 0≤x≤π here, uye funga kuti definite integral ye function iri 0 kana kupfuura ine chiratidzo chipi.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso. Kana tikagadzirisa v, ..., uye kukosha ndi .... Asi x sin x ndi ...
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakagadzirisa here v kuita −cos x uye wakaidzorera mufomula?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti sin x ndi0 kana kupfuura pa 0≤x≤π sechikonzero chako?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakabatanidza here maitiro ekuti kana integrand iri 0 kana kupfuura, definite integral ndi0 kana kupfuura?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.0: Kana v'=sin x, ipapo v=−cos x. [−x cos x]_0^π + ∫_0^π cos x dx = π + 0 = π. Pa 0≤x≤π, x≥0 ne sin x≥0, saka x sin x≥0, zvichireva kuti definite integral haigoni kuva negative (−π).
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.1: Kana ukagadzirisa v kuita −cos x, kukosha ndi π. Pa interval x sin x inogara iri 0 kana kupfuura, saka senzvimbo haigoni kubuda pasi pe0, uye −π inegative, izvo zvinopikisa.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.prompt: Zvino function imwe chete inoshandiswa, asi interval yashandurwa kuita [0,2π]. Sarudza chirevo chakarurama nezve nzira yekutarisa chiratidzo che definite integral uchishandisa chiratidzo che integrand.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tarisa chiratidzo che sin x pa [π,2π] uye ufungidzire chimiro che graph ye x sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kana pane zvikamu zvepositive nenegative zvose, funga kuti chiratidzo chehuwandu chinoenderana nei.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.a: x sin x ndi0 kana kupfuura pa [0,2π], saka kukosha kunofanirawo kuva positive.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.a: Tarisa chiratidzo che sin x pa [π,2π]. Hauna kutarisa kuti chiratidzo chinoramba chakadaro kana interval ichichinja.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.b: Kunyangwe chiratidzo chichichinja, chikamu che positive chinotanga, saka kukosha kunogara kuri positive.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakatarisa kurongeka chete usina kuenzanisa hukuru hwezvikamu zvepositive nenegative. Chikamu che negative chingava chikuru.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.c: Chiratidzo che x sin x chinochinja mukati me interval, saka chiratidzo oga hachigoni kusarudza chiratidzo chekukosha.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.c: Wakacherekedza kuti kutarisa chiratidzo chishandiso chinogona kushandiswa pa interval apo chiratidzo chiri cherudzi rumwe.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.d: Kunyangwe interval ichiwedzerwa, chikamu chakawedzerwa chinobvisana, saka kukosha ndi π, chakafanana ne pa [0,π].
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.d: Wakafunga kuti interval yakawedzerwa [π,2π] ichabvisana usina kutarisa integral yayo zvakananga.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.explain: Pa [π,2π], sin x≤0, saka x sin x≤0. Saka chiratidzo hachisi cherudzi rumwe pa interval yose, uye chikamu che positive nechikamu che negative zvinopindirana. Chaizvoizvo, [−x cos x + sin x]_0^{2π} = −2π, iyo inegative. Kutarisa chiratidzo kunokuudza chiratidzo chekukosha chete kana chiratidzo chisingachinji mukati me interval.

n-m-h3-integc-08.title: Nzvimbo Yakafanana: Vanhu Vaviri, Zvigadziriso Zviviri Zvakasiyana
n-m-h3-integc-08.topic: Integration: nzvimbo — kuintegrate maererano ne x nemaererano ne y (kuchinja kuratidza)
n-m-h3-integc-08.goal: Tsanangura, uchishandisa chimiro chenzvimbo, kuti nei kuintegrate maererano ne x nekuintegrate maererano ne y kuchipa nzvimbo imwe chete kunzvimbo imwe chete, uye utonge mamiriro apo nzira yechipiri inogona kushandiswa.
n-m-h3-integc-08.material: Vanhu vaviri vakawana nzvimbo yenzvimbo R yakakomberedzwa necurve y=ln x, x-axis, nemutsetse x=e vachishandisa nzira dzakasiyana. Jian akagadzirisa ∫_1^e ln x dx nekuintegrate by parts ndokuwana [x ln x − x]_1^e = (e−e)−(0−1) = 1. Soyul akabvisa ∫_0^1 eʸ dy = e−1 kubva panzvimbo e yerectangle 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1, ndokuwana e−(e−1)=1. (∫_1^e idefinite integral kubva ku1 kusvika ku e.)
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.1: Tarisa nemufananidzo kuti nzvimbo ipi iri kubviswa
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.2: Tonga mamiriro apo nzira inoshanda (one-to-one correspondence)
n-m-h3-integc-08.prereq.1: Inverse functions nemadefinite integrals emalogarithmic ne exponential functions
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.prompt: Mumufananidzo, ∫_0^1 eʸ dy yaunoibvisa naSoyul kubva ku e inzvimbo yechikamu chipi?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tora hurefu y, dhirowa mutsetse mumwe wakatwasuka wakapfuura rectangle, uye utsvage poinzi apo curve inocheka mutsetse iwoyo.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.1: Pamutsetse iwoyo, ratidza kuti divi rekuruboshwe kana kurudyi recurve ndiro R.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.a: Nzvimbo R pachayo, yatinoda kuwana nzvimbo yayo
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.a: Nzvimbo ye R ndiko kukosha kunowanikwa nekubvisa mutauro uyu kubva ku e. Dai R yakafanana nenzvimbo yemutauro uyu, hapaizovi nechikonzero chekubvisa kubva ku e.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakaona kuti ndicho chikamu kuruboshwe kwecurve x=eʸ, ndiko kuti, chikamu cherectangle chisiri R.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.c: Chikamu chiri pazasi pecurve y=ln x ne 1≤x≤e
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.c: Chikamu chiyoyo ndiR chaizvo. Soyul haabvisi R kubva ku e; anobvisa chikamu chasara.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.d: Chikamu chiri pakati pe x-axis necurve ne 0<x<1
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.d: Kune 0<x<1 curve iri pazasi pe x-axis, saka haisi yeR, uye haina chekuita nemutauro uyu.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.explain: Nzvimbo yerectangle 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1 i e. Pahurefu hwega hwega y, poinzi iri pacurve i x=eʸ, saka upamhi hwechikamu chiri kuruboshwe rwayo i eʸ, uye nzvimbo yayo i ∫_0^1 eʸ dy = e−1. R ichikamu chiri kurudyi recurve, saka nzvimbo yayo i e−(e−1)=1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.prompt: Uchitevera nzira yaSoyul, wana nzvimbo yenzvimbo yakakomberedzwa ne y=ln x, x-axis, nemutsetse x=e². Ratidza upamhi nehurefu herectangle nedefinite integral yaunobvisa, uye unyore mhedzisiro.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Wana hurefu hwecurve pa x=e², y=ln e², kusarudza hurefu herectangle.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Pahurefu hwega hwega y, taura x-coordinate yecurve nenzira ye y, wobva waintegrate mutauro uyu kubva ku0 kusvika kuhurefu herectangle.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso Rectangle ine upamhi ..., hurefu ..., uye ...
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakasimbisa kuti hurefu herectangle i ln e²=2 here?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaongorora kuti inowirirana nekukosha kwakawanikwa nekuintegrate by parts here?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.0: Rectangle ine upamhi e² nehurefu ln e²=2, saka nzvimbo yayo i2e². Chikamu chiri kuruboshwe kwecurve i ∫_0^2 eʸ dy = e²−1. Saka nzvimbo ye R i 2e² − (e²−1) = e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.1: Ne x=e², y inobva ku0 kusvika ku2, saka nzvimbo yerectangle i2e² uye chikamu chekubvisa i ∫_0^2 e^y dy=e²−1. Nzvimbo i 2e²−e²+1=e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.prompt: Nzira yaSoyul inogona kushandiswa "kana curve inogona kunyorwa semutauro mumwe chete wechimiro x=h(y)." Sarudza macurves ose ari pazasi anogona kunyorwa nenzira iyoyo pa interval yakapiwa.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kune curve imwe neimwe, tora kukosha kumwe kwe y uye uverenge kuti x ngani mu interval ine kukosha kwe y uku.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana girafu ichikwira ichidzika mukati meinterval (kana ichikura chete).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.a: Kukosha kwe y kwega kwega kunoenderana nemakoshero maviri e x (x ne −x). Haigoni kunyorwa semutauro mumwe chete wechimiro x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.b: Wakaona kuti y yega yega inoenderana ne x imwe chete (x=ln y), saka inogona kunyorwa semutauro mumwe chete wechimiro x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.c: Kukosha kwe y kwega kwega kunoenderana nemakoshero maviri e x (x ne π−x). Haigoni kunyorwa semutauro mumwe chete wechimiro x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.d: Wakaona kuti y yega yega inoenderana ne x imwe chete (x= cube root ye y), saka inogona kunyorwa semutauro mumwe chete wechimiro x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.explain: y=eˣ (0≤x≤1) ne y=x³ (−1≤x≤1) dziri kukwira pa interval dzadzo, saka y yega yega inoenderana ne x imwe chete (dzine inverse functions). Kune y=x² kana y=sin x, pane x mbiri kune y imwe chete, saka sezvadziri hadzigoni kuva mutauro mumwe chete x=h(y), uye interval inofanira kupatsanurwa.

n-m-h3-vec-04.title: Angle Pakati Pemitsetse Miviri i Imwechete ne Angle Pakati Pema Direction Vectors Avo here?
n-m-h3-vec-04.goal: Nzwisisa musiyano pakati pe angle pakati pema direction vectors ne angle pakati pemitsetse nekugadzirisa kutonga kwako sezvo ruzivo ruchiwedzerwa, uye shandisa fomula yakarurama ye angle pakati pemitsetse.
n-m-h3-vec-04.material: Unoda kuwana angle θ pakati pemitsetse miviri l ne m pa coordinate plane. Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu chimwe panguva imwe. (u·v inoverengwa "u dot v," |u| i magnitude ye u, uye √5 inoverengwa "root 5.")
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.0: Kugadzirisa kutonga kana ruzivo rutsva rwunooneka
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.1: Kutarisa kana mutengo wakafanana kunyange direction vector ikasarudzwa zvakasiyana
n-m-h3-vec-04.prereq.0: Dot product ye plane vectors ne angle pakati pavo
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu chimwe panguva imwe. Padanho rega rega, sarudza kutonga uchishandisa zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva runooneka, tarisa kana kutonga kwapfuura kuchiri kushanda.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kune mutsetse mumwechete, sarudza direction vector yakapesana, ita kuverenga kumwechete, uye uenzanise mhedzisiro.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Wakasarudza u=(1, 2) se direction vector yemutsetse l uye v=(1, −3) se direction vector yemutsetse m. Kuverenga kunopa u·v=−5, |u|=√5, |v|=√10.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unotonga sei angle θ pakati pemitsetse miviri?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Angle pakati pe u ne v ine cos = −1/√2, ndiko kuti, 135°. Asi hazvisati zvasimbiswa kana mutengo uyu ungatorwa seangle pakati pemitsetse miviri.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakatamisa angle pakati pema vectors maviri zvakananga kune angle pakati pemitsetse. Uku ndiko kutonga kwekutanga kunouya mupfungwa.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Tinofanira kutarisa zvakawanda kana mutengo uyu uchitsanangura chaizvo angle pakati pemitsetse, uye kana wakafanana kana ma direction vectors akasarudzwa zvakasiyana
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakarangarira kuti direction vector haisi mutengo mumwe wakagadzirwa kumutsetse mumwe nemumwe.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Sezvo dot product ine negative, tinogona kungotaura kuti mitsetse miviri haisi perpendicular
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakangotaura kuti haisi perpendicular. Hauna kusarudza hukuru hwekona.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Kunyangwe ukatora −v=(−1, 3) se direction vector yemutsetse m panzvimbo ye v, ndiwo mutsetse m umwe chete.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kona iri pakati pe u ne −v ndeyei, uye izvi zvinotiudza chii nezve kona θ iri pakati pemitsetse?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kona iri pakati pe u ne v ndi135°, uye kona iri pakati pe u ne −v ndi45°. Kunyangwe kune mitsetse miviri imwe chete, kukosha kunochinja zvichienderana nekuti direction vector yasarudzwa sei. Kana mitsetse miviri yasangana, makona e45° ne135° anoumbwa, saka tinoda mutemo wekuti ndeipi inonzi kona iri pakati pemitsetse.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: u·(−v)=5 uye cos=1/√2, saka ndi45°. Kune mitsetse imwe chete, makona maviri, 135° ne45°, anobuda, saka dot product ine chiratidzo oga haisarudzi kona iri pakati pemitsetse
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakatarisa zvakananga kuti kukosha kunochinja zvichienderana nekuti direction vector yasarudzwa sei.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kushandura kuita −v kunotsinhira chiratidzo che dot product, saka cos inova +1/√2; izvi hazvisi kukanganisa.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: u·(−v)=5 uye kona ndi45°, saka 135° yekare yaiva isina kururama uye kona iri pakati pemitsetse ndi45°
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakarurama kuti 45° inobuda, asi wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti zvose 135° ne45° zvakabva pamitsetse miviri imwe chete. Tinoda mutemo wekuti ndeipi inotorwa sekona iri pakati pemitsetse.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Tinobvumirana kuti kona θ iri pakati pemitsetse miviri ndiyo iri pakati pemarudzi maviri ekona anoumbwa panosangana (45° ne135°) isiri hombe, ndiko kuti, iri 0°<θ≤90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Fomula ipi inogara ichipa θ chero direction vector dzichisarudzwa sei?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.after: |u·v|=5, saka cosθ=5/(√5·√10)=1/√2 uye θ=45°. Kona iri pakati pemitsetse inofanira kutsvagwa nefomula inotora absolute value ye dot product, kuti kukosha kumwe chete kubude chero direction vector dzichisarudzwa sei.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Chiratidzo chinochinja zvichienderana nesarudzo ye direction vector, saka chingasangani nemutemo wekuti θ iri pakati pe0° ne90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kushandisa absolute value ye dot product kunopa kukosha kumwe chete kunyangwe direction vector ikatsinhirwa, uye cosθ≥0, saka θ ndi90° zvakanyanya.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Izvi zvakarurama kana −v yashandiswa chete; kana yasarudzwa nenzira yakapesana chiratidzo chinosiyana, saka haisi fomula inogara yakarurama.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga wakatakura kona iri pakati pe direction vector zvakananga kuenda kukona iri pakati pemitsetse, asi kutonga kwako kwakachinja kana ruzivo rwakawedzerwa rwekuti kunyangwe mutsetse mumwe chete une direction vector munzira mbiri dzakapesana. Kona iri pakati pemitsetse inofanira kuva huwandu husingachinji nechiratidzo che direction vector, saka tinoitsvaga nekutora absolute value ye dot product.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.prompt: Direction vector yemutsetse p ndi (2, 1) uye direction vector yemutsetse q ndi (1, −3). Tsvaga kukosha kwe cosθ yekona θ iri pakati pemitsetse miviri, uye unyore mumutsara mumwe kuti nei fomula ichida absolute value.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga kukosha kwe dot product nehukuru hwema vector maviri, uye uise mufomula.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ita kuverenga kumwe chete ne (−1, 3), iyo inotsinhira direction vector (1, −3), uye uenzanise mhedzisiro.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso, cosθ = ... Absolute value inodiwa nekuti ...
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here kukosha kwe u·v nehukuru hwema vector maviri?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaenzanisa here kuti kona ipi inobuda kana ukashandisa dot product sezvairi kana iri negative?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakabatanidza here chikonzero che absolute value ne "kuti direction vector yasarudzwa sei"?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.0: (2, 1)·(1, −3) = −1 uye hukuru ndi√5 ne√10, saka cosθ = |−1|/(√5·√10) = 1/(5√2) ≈ 0.14. Kana tikatsinhira direction vector, chiratidzo che dot product chinochinja, saka tinoda absolute value kuti kona iri pakati pemitsetse itarwe kuva imwe chete.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.1: Dot product ndi−1 uye |p|=√5, |q|=√10, saka cosθ=1/√50=√2/10. Tinoshandisa absolute value nekuti takabvumirana kuti kona iri pakati pemitsetse miviri ndi90° zvakanyanya, uye tinoda kukosha kumwe chete chero direction vector dzichisarudzwa sei.

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.topic: Series: partial sum nema infinite geometric series
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.title: Kuongorora Mhinduro Yakawana General Term Kubva Pafomula Yepartial Sum
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.goal: Dzidza kuti a_1 inofanira kuwanikwa zvakasiyana kana uchiwana general term kubva papartial sum S_n, gadzirisa mhinduro yakanganisa, uye uitarise uchishandisa huwandu lim S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.material: Huwandu hwemazwi n ekutanga eseries ndi S_n = 4 − 3·(1/2)^(n−1). Verenga mhinduro yaMinjae yekuwana huwandu hweseries iyi. ((1/2)^(n−1) zvinoreva hafu kusimba n−1.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.3: Kutsvaga mamiriro apo fomula inoshandawo pa n=1
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga unokanganisa mumhinduro yaMinjae.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa mutsetse nemutsetse kana mutsetse wega wega uchitevera chaizvo kubva pamutsetse wapfuura.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana mamiriro (huwandu hwe n) akashandiswa kuwana fomula achichengetwa sezvaari mumutsetse unotevera.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.0: Huwandu hweseries ndi lim S_n, uye kune n ≥ 2, a_n = S_n − S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.2: Tichifungidzira kuti fomula iyi inogona kushandiswawo kune n=1, seta a_n = 3·(1/2)^(n−1) kune n yese.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.3: Iyi igeometric series isingaperi ine izwi rekutanga 3 neratio inofanana 1/2, saka huwandu ndi 3/(1−1/2) = 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.explain: Ndi mutsetse 3. S_n−S_(n−1) inogona kushandiswa kune n≥2 chete, saka kuti fomula yakawanikwa inoshandawo pa n=1 kunofanira kutariswa zvakasiyana. Pano a_1=S_1=4−3=1, asi kuisa n=1 mufomula kunopa 3, iyo yakasiyana. Kuverenga komumitsetse 1 ne 2 kwakarurama, uye mutsetse 4 mhedzisiro inotevera mutsetse 3.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mhinduro yaMinjae uye uwane huwandu hweseries iyi. Wobva wawana izwi rekutanga a_1 zvakananga, uriienzanise nekukosha kwaMinjae, uye unyore kuti sei huwandu hunoshanduka.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.0: Wana muganho we S_n zvakananga uye uuenzanise nekukosha kwakawanikwa naMinjae.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.1: Isa mufomula kuwana a_1 kubva pa S_1, wobva waienzanisa nekukosha kwaunowana nekuisa n=1 mufomula yegeneral-term yaMinjae.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kana fomula yakawanikwa kune n≥2 ichishandawo pa n=1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakatarisa here huwandu zvakare ne lim S_n?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.0: a_1=S_1=4−3=1. Asi kuisa n=1 mu 3·(1/2)^(n−1) kunopa 3, saka a_1 yakasiyana. Saka a_1=1, uye kubva pa n≥2 izwi ndi 3·(1/2)^(n−1). Huwandu ndi 1+(3/2)/(1−1/2)=1+3=4, iyo inoenzanawo ne lim S_n=4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.1: Izwi rekutanga ndi S_1=1, kwete 3 yakabva mufomula yegeneral-term. Kubva pa n=2 zvichienda mberi, izwi rekutanga ndi 3/2 uye ratio inofanana ndi 1/2, saka chikamu ichocho ndi 3/2÷(1/2)=3, uye kuwedzera 1 kunopa huwandu 4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.2: Kutora muganho we S_n zvakananga kunopa 4−0=4, uye 6 yakanyorwa naMinjae ndiko kukosha kune 3 yakawedzerwa nokuti akatora a_1 kuva 3 zvisizvo. a_1 chaiyo ndi S_1=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.3: lim S_n=4. a_1=S_1=1, asi Minjae akaitora kuva 3. Saka mhinduro yakarurama ndi 4, kwete 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.prompt: Kune S_n imwe neimwe pazasi, sarudza iyo yakawana fomula yegeneral-term kune n≥2 inoshandawo sezvayakaita pa n=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kune fomula imwe neimwe, tsvaga S_1 uye uienzanise nekukosha kwaunowana nekuisa n=1 mufomula yakawanikwa kubva pa S_n−S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kune fomula imwe neimwe, tsiva makosha akasiyana e n mu S_n uye uenzanise, uye utsvage chinhu chakafanana pakati pemafomula apo S_1 yakaverengwa zvakananga yakaenzana nekukosha kwefomula ye a_1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.a: Iyi iseries yaMinjae. a_1=1 asi fomula inopa 3, saka haiwirirani.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.b: a_1=S_1=1, asi kuisa n=1 mufomula 2·(1/2)^(n−1) yekune n≥2 kunopa 2, saka haiwirirani.

n-m-h3-serieslim-05.topic: Series: partial sum nema infinite geometric series
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.prompt: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, sarudza kutonga uchishandisa zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.title: Kana x Iri 0, Huwandu Hweseries Hunopiwa Nefomula Imwe Chete Here?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.goal: Kune geometric series ine ratio inofanana inoshanduka ne x, ongorora huwandu hwepanoshanda fomula yehuwandu, uye utsanangure kuti kuverenga zvakasiyana pa x=0 kunoratidza kuti huwandu hwakasiyana papoindi iyoyo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.material: Kune nhamba chaiyo x, rega f(x)=x²+x²/(1+x²)+x²/(1+x²)²+x²/(1+x²)³+…. (Iseries ine izwi rekutanga x² apo izwi rega rega rinotevera rinowanzwa ne 1/(1+x²).) Ruzivo runoratidzwa chimwe pachimwe.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.0: Kugadzirisa kutonga kwako sezvo ruzivo rwuchiwedzera
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.0: Pese painoonekwa ruzivo rutsva, tarisazve kana fomula yawakashandisa kare ichiri kushanda sezvayakaita.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tsiva x=0 zvakananga uye unyore kuti mazwi ekutanga mashoma ndeaya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unotarisira kuti f(x) ive fomula ipi kune nhamba chaiyo x yega yega?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.after: x²/(1−1/(1+x²))=1+x² ifomula yakawanikwa mushure mekudzima. Rangarira kuti pane x apo x² yakadzimwa iri 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: f(x)=1+x²: nokuti makosha ese maviri anowirirana ne 1+x²
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakawedzera fomula inowirirana nemapoindi maviri kune x dzese. Uku ndiko kutonga kwekutanga kunouya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: f(x)=1+x², asi x apo ratio inofanana isiri yakajairika inofanira kuongororwa zvakasiyana
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uri kupokana kana mhedzisiro pamapoindi maviri ichishanda kune x yega yega.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: f(x)=x²+1/x²: nokuti imwe fomula inogona kuwirirana nemakosha maviri
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Pa x=1 inopa 2 uye pa x=2 inopa 4.25, saka haiwirirani nerimwe remakosha maviri. Hauna kutsiva kuti utarise fomula.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Zvino funga nyaya ye x=0. Tsiva x=0 zvakananga mufomula yetsananguro ye f.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.after: f(0)=0. Kunyange ratio inofanana iri 1, kana izwi rekutanga riri 0 saka mapartial sums ese ndi 0, saka inosvika ku 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakashandisa fomula yakawanikwa kune x≠0 pa x=0 sezvayakaita.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 0: nokuti mazwi ose i0, saka partial sums dzose i0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakatanga kubva patsanangudzo ukaverenga partial sums zvakananga.

n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti common ratio ye1 inogara ichidiverge. Wakasiya nyaya apo izwi rekutanga ri0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Kupfupisa, f(x)=1+x² kana x≠0, uye f(0)=0 kana x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ndechipi chirevo chakarurama pamusoro pelimit ye f(x) kana x→0 nekuenderera pa x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Izwi rega rega rinoenderera, asi huwandu f hwakaputsika pa x=0. Kune infinite sum, "kana izwi rega rega rinoenderera, huwandu hunoenderera" hazvigari zvichishanda.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Limit i1 uye f(0)=0, saka f haienderere pa x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakatonga kuenderera nekufananidza kukosha kwelimit nekukosha kwefunction.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Izwi rega rega ricontinuous function, saka huwandu f hunoenderera kune x dzose
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakashandisa chivakwa chinoshanda kumahuwandu akapera kuinfinite sum sezvachakaita.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Zvose limit ne f(0) i0, saka f inoenderera pa x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hauna kuongorora kuti fomula 1+x² yekune x≠0 inoenda kupi kana x→0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga waida kushandisa fomula inokodzera mapoinzi maviri kune x dzose, asi kutonga kwako kwakachinja kana waongorora mamiriro e x²≠0 akashandiswa mukudzima. Kana uchishandisa fomula, unofanira kuedza zvakananga pakukosha kwemuganhu kana mamiriro apo fomula inoshanda anoshanda munyaya iyi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.prompt: Izwi rega rega x²/(1+x²)^n ricontinuous function ye x. Nyora kuti f(0) i chii pa x=0, uye kuti inosiyana sei nefomula 1+x² yekune x≠0, nechikonzero.

n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.0: Kana x=0, izwi rega rega ri0²/1^n=0, saka f(0)=0. Asi kana x≠0, f(x)=1+x², saka padhuze ne x=0 makoshero ayo ari padhuze ne1. Saka limit i1 yakasiyana ne f(0)=0, uye f haienderere pa x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.1: Kuisa x=0 kunopa common ratio ye1, asi mazwi ose kubva kutanga i0, saka huwandu i0. Izvi zvakasiyana ne1, ndiko kuunowana kana ukaisa 0 mu 1+x², uye f yakaputsika pa x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.2: Fomula 1+x² inoshandiswa kune x≠0 chete. Kana x=0, mazwi ose i0 saka huwandu i0, uye izvozvo zvakasiyana ne1+0²=1, saka function haina kubatana papoinzi iyoyo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.3: Kana x=0, common ratio inova 1 saka fomula haigoni kushandiswa, uye izwi rega rega i0, saka f(0)=0. Izvozvo zvakasiyana ne1, iyo yaunowana kana ukaisa 0 mu 1+x².

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.material: Fungidzira infinite geometric series a + ar + ar² + … ine izwi rekutanga a necommon ratio r ine huwandu 6. Zviri nyore kufunga, "Huwandu i6, saka izwi rekutanga rinofanira kuva pazasi pe6."

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.2: Nenr yawakasarudza, verenga S_1, S_2, S_3 zvakananga uye usarudze n iyo yakakura kupfuura 6.

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.ok.c4: Pa n iyi, S_n=6(1−r^n) yakakura kupfuura 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Pa n iyi, S_n haina kukura kupfuura 6. Verenga S_1, S_2, S_3 zvakananga uye uzvifananidze ne6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.explain: Sezvo a=6(1−r), a>6 inoda r<0. Ipapo S_n=6(1−r^n), saka kuti S_n ive huru kupfuura 6 tinoda r^n<0, ndiko kuti, n inofanira kuva odd. n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvose zvinofanira kushanda kuinfinite geometric series ine huwandu 6 neizwi rekutanga rakakura kupfuura 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.hint.0: Rongedza mutebhura zvinofanana mienzaniso yawakagadzira munhanho yapfuura.

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.a: S_1 yakakura kupfuura 6, asi izwi rechipiri inegative, saka S_2 inova diki kupfuura S_1. Mumuenzaniso a=9, r=−1/2, S_2=4.5.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.o.b: Mazwi ose ari positive uye anoramba achidzikira
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.b: Kuti izwi rekutanga ripfuure huwandu, rimwe izwi rinofanira kuva negative. Kana mazwi ose ari positive, huwandu haugoni kuva hudiki kupfuura izwi rekutanga.

n-m-h3-serieslim-07.topic: Series: partial sum nema infinite geometric series
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.title: Huwandu Hweseries Mbiri Hunoconverge Rinhi?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.goal: Rongedza masanganiswa apo kuconverge kwe Σ(a_n+b_n) kunosarudzwa nekuti Σa_n ne Σb_n zvinoconverge here neaya asingasarudzwi, uye ugadzire counterexample.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.material: Pane infinite series mbiri Σa_n ne Σb_n, uye unoda kuziva kana series Σ(a_n+b_n), yakagadzirwa nekuwedzera izwi nenzira, inoconverge kana inodiverge. Zvichienderana nezvaunoziva, dzimwe nguva inosarudzwa uye dzimwe nguva haisarudzwi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.thinking.2: Kutaura mamiriro apo mutemo wekushanda unoshanda
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza ruzivo rwose runosarudza, semhinduro imwe chete, kana Σ(a_n+b_n) inoconverge kana inodiverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kune ruzivo rwega rwega, funga mapairi maviri akasiyana a_n, b_n anokodzera uye utarise kana sum series ichipa mhedzisiro imwe chete.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana kuwedzera kana kubvisa series inoconverge kungaita kuti series inodiverge iconverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.a: Huwandu hweseries mbiri dzinoconverge hunoconverge, saka hunosarudzwa semhinduro imwe chete.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.b: Kana a_n=b_n=1 inodiverge, asi kana a_n=1, b_n=−1 sum series inoconverge, saka haisarudzwi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.c: Kubvisa Σa_n inoconverge kunosiya Σb_n, saka dai sum series yaiconverge, Σb_n yaifanira kuconvergewo; saka sum series inodiverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.o.d: a_n ne b_n dzose dzinoconverge ku0
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.d: Kana a_n=b_n=1/n sum series inodiverge, uye kana a_n=1/n², b_n=1/n² inoconverge. Haisarudzwi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.explain: Kana dzose dzinoconverge, sum series inoconverge, uye kana imwe chete inoconverge, sum series inodiverge (nokuti dai yaiconverge, Σb_n=Σ(a_n+b_n)−Σa_n yaifanira kuconvergewo). Kana dzose dzinodiverge, kana mazwi achienda ku0, izvozvo zvega hazvisarudzi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.prompt: Ratidza nyaya ine ruzivo rusina kukwana. Rega a_n=p·r^n, b_n=q·r^n (p≠0, q≠0, |r|≥1); saka Σa_n ne Σb_n dzose dzinodiverge. Isa p, q, r kaviri, ne r dzakasiyana, kuti Σ(a_n+b_n) iconverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora a_n+b_n yakaunganidzwa nenzira ye r^n, wobva wafunga kuti coefficient inofanira kuva chii kuti series iyoyo iconverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga nzira yekuita coefficient i0 uchichengeta mamiriro ekuti p kana q isina kuva 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Mazwi akajairika e Σa_n ne Σb_n haasi 0, saka imwe neimwe inodiverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p kana q i0, saka series iyoyo haidiverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c2: |r|≥1, saka izwi rakajairika haiti ku0, uye imwe neimwe inodiverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.explain: Sezvo a_n+b_n=(p+q)r^n, kana p+q=0 izwi rega rega i0, saka sum series inoconverge ku0. Asi kana p≠0 uye |r|≥1, a_n ne b_n hadziendi ku0, saka imwe neimwe inodiverge. Ne p=q=1 sum series inodivergewo, uye ne |r|<1 series imwe neimwe inoconverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura kuti nei chirevo che "kana Σa_n ne Σb_n dzose dzinodiverge, saka Σ(a_n+b_n) inodivergewo" chakaipa. Shandisa muenzaniso wenhanho yapfuura, uye unyorewo mamiriro anodiwa kana uchipatsanura series yehuwandu kuita huwandu hweseries mbiri.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora a_n+b_n kumuenzaniso wawakaisa munhanho yapfuura.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kana chikamu chega chega chinofanira kuva nekukosha kana huwandu hwapatsanurwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga a_n+b_n iwe pachako kumuenzaniso wenhanho yapfuura here?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura kuti chii chinogona kuitika kana series mbiri dzinodiverge dzabatanidzwa here?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.0: Kunyange dzose dzichidiverge, seΣa_n ne p·r^n neΣb_n ne −p·r^n, kuvawedzera kunoita kuti izwi rega rega ri0, saka inoconverge. Saka kana dzose dzinodiverge, kuti sum series inoconverge here hakusarudzwi. Kupatsanura huwandu kuita Σa_n+Σb_n, imwe neimwe inofanira kuconverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.1: Pane counterexample. Kana a_n=2^n ne b_n=−2^n, imwe neimwe inodiverge, asi a_n+b_n=0, saka sum series inoconverge ku0. Saka Σ(a_n+b_n)=Σa_n+Σb_n inogona kushandiswa chete kana series mbiri dzose dzinoconverge.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.2: Huwandu hweseries mbiri dzinodiverge hunogona kuconverge nekudzimana (1 ne−1 dzinowedzera ku0), kana kudiverge kana dziine chiratidzo chimwe chete. Saka usati wapatsanura, unofanira kutanga waongorora kuti series imwe neimwe inoconverge.

n-m-h3-serieslim-08.topic: Series: partial sum nema infinite geometric series
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.title: Kushandisa Tebhura Yepartial Sums Kusarudza Kuverenga Kwakarurama
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.goal: Chenesa chirevo chakaipa uchishandisa makoshero enhamba epartial sums, wana huwandu hwetelescoping series nekuziva zvakananga mazwi anosara, uye ita generalization kana gap ichichinja.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.material: Shamwari mbiri dzinopa makoshero akasiyana ehuwandu hweseries 1/(1·3) + 1/(2·4) + 1/(3·5) + … + 1/(n(n+2)) + …. Jiho: "Mazwi anodzimana mberi nshure, saka huwandu i1/2." Seoa: "Huwandu i3/4." Uchishandisa calculator, partial sums S_n dzakabuda S_1=0.333, S_2=0.458, S_3=0.525, S_4=0.567, S_5=0.595.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwaunogona kutaura zvakavimbika zvikuru kubva patebhura yepartial sums oga.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.hint.0: Kana mazwi ose ari positive, tarisa kana partial sums dzichingowedzera kana dzichigona kudzikawo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.hint.1: Fananidza makoshero ari mutebhura nemakoshero ezvirevo zviviri uye utarise kana rimwe ratopfuurwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.a: Seoa akarurama: partial sums dzinoramba dzichiwedzera uye dziri kuswedera pedyo ne3/4
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.a: Wakapedzisa 3/4 kubva pachokwadi chekuti makoshero ari mutebhura anowedzera. Anogona kuva achiwedzera kuenda kune dzimwe nhamba futi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.b: Jiho akaipa: partial sums dzinongowedzera, uye S_3 yatopfuura 1/2
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti mazwi ose ari positive, saka S_n haidzikiri, kubvisa 1/2.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.c: Jiho akarurama: partial sums dzinoita sedziri kufamba kutenderera 1/2
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.c: Kubva pa S_3 zvichienda mberi, dzatopfuura 1/2. Hauna kuverenga tebhura kusvika kumugumo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.d: Kubva patebhura oga, hatigoni kutonga Jiho kana Seoa
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.d: Kunyange tisingagoni kusarudza kuti huwandu i chii, tinogona kubvisa 1/2.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.explain: Mazwi ose ari positive, saka S_n inongowedzera. S_3=0.525 yatokura kupfuura 1/2, saka huwandu hahugoni kuva 1/2. 3/4 yaSeoa haigoni kusimbiswa kubva patebhura yega, saka tinofanira kuiwana zvakananga.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.prompt: Shandisa 1/(n(n+2))=½(1/n−1/(n+2)) kunyora S_n, nyora zvakananga mazwi anosara mushure mekuti mamwe adzimane, uye uwane huwandu hweseries. Nyorawo kuti nei mazwi iwayo achisara.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tambanudza mabhurakiti, rongedza mazwi ekutanga 5 kana 6 mumutsara mumwe, uye dhirowa mitsetse kuburikidza nemapairi anodzimana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga mazwi mangani asara asina kudzimwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatambanudza zvechokwadi ukanyora mazwi mashoma ekutanga here?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti nei mazwi maviri achisara here?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakawana huwandu uchishandisa limit ye S_n here?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.0: Muna S_n=½{(1−1/3)+(1/2−1/4)+(1/3−1/5)+…}, kubva ku1/3 zvichienda mberi izwi rega rega rinodzimana nzvimbo mbiri gare gare, uye 1 ne 1/2 yekutanga ne −1/(n+1) ne −1/(n+2) yekupedzisira zvinosara. S_n=½(1+1/2−1/(n+1)−1/(n+2)) uye limit i½·3/2=3/4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.1: Mazwi ari nzvimbo mbiri kuparadzana, saka mazwi maviri ekutanga, 1 ne 1/2, haana vamwe vekudzimana navo. Mazwi maviri ekupedzisira anoenda ku0 kana n→∞, saka huwandu i½(1+½)=3/4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.2: Sezvo S_n=½(3/2−1/(n+1)−1/(n+2)), inoconverge ku3/4 kana n ichikura. Nokuti mazwi maviri ekutanga 1 ne 1/2 anosara, 3/2 panzvimbo pe1 inoenda mukati memabhurakiti.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.3: 1 ne 1/2 dzekutanga dzinosara dzisina kudzimwa. Huwandu 3/4
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.prompt: Kana tikashandisa nzira imwe chete kuseries 1/(1·4) + 1/(2·5) + 1/(3·6) + … + 1/(n(n+3)) + …, huwandu i chii?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wawana fomula inonyora 1/(n(n+3)) semusiyano wemafractions maviri.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.hint.1: Kana musiyano i nzvimbo 3, verenga ma terms ekutanga mangani asara asina kudzimwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.r.a: Iri i mamiriro apo 1 yekutanga chete inosara. Ne gap 3, ma terms 3 ekutanga anosara.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.r.b: Iri i mamiriro apo ma terms maviri ekutanga chete anosara. Ne gap 3, ma terms matatu anosara.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.r.d: Iri i mamiriro apo ma terms mana ekutanga anosara. Huwandu hwema terms asara i 3, hwakafanana ne gap.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.explain: Kana gap i k, ipapo 1/(n(n+k))=(1/k)(1/n−1/(n+k)) uye ma terms k ekutanga 1, 1/2, …, 1/k anosara. Huwandu i (1/k)(1+1/2+…+1/k). Kune k=2 i 3/4, uye kune k=3 i 11/18.

n-m-h3-est-03.title: Bvunzo yeVanopindura 900 kana Bvunzo Yemukana yeVanhu 60: Ndeipi Yaunofanira Kuvimba Nayo?
n-m-h3-est-03.goal: Siyanisa sample kuva huru nesample kumiririra population, uye utsanangure kuti nei bias inobva panzira yekusarudza sample isingaperi kana sample size ichikura.
n-m-h3-est-03.material: Unoda kuwana avhareji yenguva yekudzidza pazuva yevadzidzi vose 1200 vechikoro. Nzira A yakaisa link yebvunzo pawebhusaiti yechikoro ndokutora mean yevadzidzi 900 vakapindura vega: maawa 3.1. Nzira B yakabvunza vadzidzi 60 vakasarudzwa nenhamba dzemukana kubva pamndandanda wevadzidzi, uye vose vakapindura: mean i2.4 maawa.
n-m-h3-est-03.thinking.0: Ongorora sample size nenzira yekusarudza sample zvakasiyana
n-m-h3-est-03.thinking.1: Ona bias kubva pamaitiro ekusarudza seyekupindura nokuzvipira
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza bvunzo inovimbika zvikuru yekufungidzira avhareji yenguva yekudzidza yevadzidzi vose.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.hint.0: Fananidza kana, munzira imwe neimwe, mudzidzi wega wega muchikoro ane mukana wakafanana wekupedzisira ari musample.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funga, uchishandisa muenzaniso, kana "sample yakakura" ne "sample inomiririra vadzidzi vose" zvichireva zvakafanana.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.a: B: nokuti yakasarudzwa kubva pamndandanda nenhamba dzemukana, saka mudzidzi wega wega aive nemukana wakafanana
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.b: A: nokuti sample ye900 yakakura zvikuru, saka sample mean iri padhuze nepopulation mean
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.r.b: Chokwadi kuti sample yakakura inoderedza kupararira kunokonzerwa nemukana. Asi kana kuti ndiani anopedzisira ari musample kukotama kudivi rimwe, bias iyoyo haidzikiri nehukuru.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.c: Hapana inogona kushandiswa: nokuti vamwe vadzidzi chete, kwete vose, ndivo vakabvunzwa
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.r.c: Bvunzo yesample, nekugadzirwa kwayo, inzira yekufungidzira yose kubva pachidimbu. Mubvunzo ndewekuti nzira yekusarudza chidimbu inomiririra population here.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.d: Shandisa zvose: ingotora avhareji yemeans mbiri, 3.1 ne2.4
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.r.d: Kusanganisa data ine bias nedata rimwe kunosiya bias iyoyo. Unofanira kutanga wabvunza kuti data ripi rinomiririra population.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.explain: Mubvunzo wepawebhusaiti, vadzidzi vanofarira kana vane nguva vanopindura vega, saka mukana wekusarudzwa kubva papopulation unosiyana nemudzidzi nemudzidzi. Mhando iyi yeselection bias haipere kunyange huwandu hwevanopindura ukawedzera. Muna B, sample idiki pa60, saka kupararira kunokonzerwa nemukana kwakakura, asi mudzidzi wega wega akasarudzwa nemukana wakafanana, saka sample mean inopararira kutenderera population mean, izvo zvinoita kuti ive hwaro hunovimbika hwekufungidzira.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.prompt: Nzira A ine sample huru zvikuru ye900, asi zvakaoma kuvimba nemean yayo ye3.1 maawa sekufungidzira kweavhareji yevadzidzi vose. Tsanangura kuti nei, uchiibatanidza nesample kukura.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti vadzidzi vanoona link yebvunzo asi vasingapindure vanogona kusiyana sei nevaya vanopindura.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana musiyano uwu uchidzikira kana ukapetwa kaviri vanopindura vane 900.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso A inosanganisira vadzidzi ... chete, saka ... kunyange sample ikakura
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaratidza kuti ndiani anopedzisira ari musample muna A (maitiro ekusarudza) here?
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti bias inoramba kunyange sample ichikura here?
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakabatanidza nechikonzero chekuti nei B inovimbika (mukana wakafanana) here?
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.model.0: Bvunzo yepawebhusaiti inosanganisira vadzidzi vanopindura vega chete, saka vamwe vadzidzi, seavo vanofarira kudzidza zvikuru, vanogona kuva vakawanda zvakanyanya. Bias iyi inoramba yakafanana kana vanopindura vari 900 kana 9000, saka zvakaoma kuvimba nayo kunyange sample ichikura.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.model.1: A isample inoitwa nevanhu vakapindura nokuzvipira chete, saka haimiriri vadzidzi vose. Kunyange vari vangani musample, kana nzira yekusarudza ikakotama kudivi rimwe, mean inoramba iri kure nepopulation mean.

n-m-h3-conic-01.title: Kutarisa gadziriso nezve area ye triangle PF₁F₂
n-m-h3-conic-01.topic: Conic sections: matsanangudziro nema tangent lines e parabolas, ellipses, ne hyperbolas; kuenderana pakati pezvimiro nema equations
n-m-h3-conic-01.goal: Ziva kuti kunyange gadziriso ine kuverenga kwose kwakarurama inogona kuita mhedziso isina zvainoreva kana usingatarise kana mamiriro edambudziko anogona kuitika chaizvo, uye wana renji apo mamiriro anoshanda.
n-m-h3-conic-01.material: Bhuku rekudzidzira rine dambudziko nemhinduro iyi: "Ngatitii F₁ ne F₂ i ma foci maviri e ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1. Kune poinzi P pa ellipse ine ∠F₁PF₂ = 90°, wana area ye triangle PF₁F₂. (Mhinduro: 16)" Pazasi pane gadziriso inowana mhinduro iyi.
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.0: Siyanisa kana mutsetse wega wega wegadziriso i kuverenga kana kubvuma mamiriro
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.1: Yedza kana mamiriro akapiwa anogona kuitika chaizvo nekuedza nzvimbo yakanyanyisa
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.2: Wana renji ye parameter apo mamiriro anoshanda
n-m-h3-conic-01.prereq.0: Tsanangudziro ye ellipse nema coordinates e ma foci ayo
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.prompt: Mutsetse wega wega wegadziriso iri pazasi wakarurama sekuverenga. Asi mhinduro 16 yedambudziko iri yakaoma kuvimba nayo. Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga unoita kuti mhinduro iome kuvimba nayo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.0: Siyanisa kana mutsetse wega wega wakabva kumutsetse wakapfuura nekuverenga kana kungobvuma mamiriro akatorwa kubva mudambudziko.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isa mhedzisiro yemutsetse unobvuma mamiriro pamwe chete nemhedzisiro yemumwe mutsetse watowanikwa pakutanga, uye uise nhamba kuona kana zvose zvinogona kuitika panguva imwechete.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.0: Kune ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1, a=5 ne b=4, saka c²=a²−b²=9, c=3, uye F₁(−3, 0), F₂(3, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.1: Netsanangudziro ye ellipse, PF₁ + PF₂ = 2a = 10, uye F₁F₂ = 6.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.2: Sezvo ∠F₁PF₂ = 90°, nePythagorean theorem PF₁² + PF₂² = F₁F₂² = 36.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.3: Sezvo (PF₁ + PF₂)² = PF₁² + PF₂² + 2·PF₁·PF₂, tinowana 100 = 36 + 2·PF₁·PF₂, saka PF₁·PF₂ = 32.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.4: Area ye triangle PF₁F₂ i ½·PF₁·PF₂ = 16.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.explain: Imutsetse 3. Mutsetse uyu wakatora "∠F₁PF₂=90°" yakanyorwa mudambudziko seyakapiwa uye wakaseta equation. Asi sezvo PF₁+PF₂=10 kubva pamutsetse 2, PF₁²+PF₂² i diki zvikuru kana kureba kwose kuviri kwakaenzana, saka inofanira kuva 5²+5²=50 kana kupfuura. Haigone kuva 36, saka hapana poinzi yakadaro P pa ellipse. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 i kuverenga kunotevera mhedzisiro yemutsetse 3, saka kunyange kuverenga kwakarurama, hakuna zvakunoreva.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangura, uchishandisa nhamba dzinooneka mugadziriso, nei usingagone kuvimba nemhinduro 16. Nyorawo chii chakarurama kutaura nezve dambudziko iri.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funga mutengo mudiki zvikuru waunogona kutorwa ne PF₁²+PF₂² kana PF₁+PF₂ yakagadzirwa pa 10.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dhonza mufananidzo kufungidzira kuti ∠F₁PF₂ i hombe zvikuru kupi kana P ichifamba pa ellipse, uye ufungidzire angle iyoyo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakashandisa nhamba dzegadziriso (36, 10, 50, nezvimwewo) zvakananga mutsananguro yako here?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura mhedziso yako muchimiro che "mamiriro haagone kuitika" panzvimbo ye "kuverenga kwakanganisa" here?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaziva kuti izvi zvinogonawo kutariswa nemufananidzo kana nzvimbo yakanyanyisa (gumo re minor axis) here?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.0: Kana PF₁+PF₂=10, huwandu hwema squares i hudiki zvikuru kana kureba kuviri kwakaenzana, saka i 5²+5²=50 kana kupfuura. Asi mutsetse 3 wakati 36, saka iko kupokana. Poinzi yakadaro P haipo, uye 16 i mutengo usina zvainoreva.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.1: Pagumo re minor axis (0, 4), PF₁=PF₂=5 ne F₁F₂=6, saka 25+25>36, zvichireva kuti ∠F₁PF₂ i shoma kupfuura 90° papoinzi iyi. Angle iyi i hombe zvikuru ipapo pa ellipse, saka hapana poinzi apo i 90°. Saka area haigone kuwanikwa.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.2: Mhinduro 16 haina kururama. Kana huwandu i 10, huwandu hwema squares i 50 kana kupfuura, asi i 36, saka haienderane. Hapana poinzi yakadaro.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.3: 16 haina kururama. Kana huwandu hwekureba kuviri i 10, huwandu hwema squares hahugone kuva 36, saka P yakadaro haipo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.prompt: Zvino chinja ellipse kuita x²/25 + y²/b² = 1 (0 < b < 5). Wana uye uise mitengo mitatu yakasiyana ye b apo poinzi P ine ∠F₁PF₂ = 90° iripo chaizvo pa ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga watarisa kuti distance pakati pema foci maviri inochinja sei kana b ichikura.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kune mutengo wega wega we b, fungidzira kana angle papoinzi iri pa ellipse apo ∠F₁PF₂ i hombe zvikuru inosvika 90°.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Inofanira kuva nhamba iri mu renji 0<b<5.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.ok.c2: Kune b iyi, poinzi ine ∠F₁PF₂=90° iripo pa ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Kune b iyi, ∠F₁PF₂ haisvike 90° chero kupi pa ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.explain: Kuti ma foci aone poinzi P pa ellipse pa 90°, ∠F₁PF₂ inofanira kuva 90° kana kupfuura pagumo re minor axis, apo angle i hombe zvikuru. Izvi zvinoitika kana c ≥ b, ndiko kuti, kana 25−b² ≥ b². Saka b² ≤ 12.5, uye kune 0<b<5, poinzi P iripo kana b i anenge 3.54 kana pasi. b=3.5 inoshanda, asi 3.6 haishande.

n-m-h3-conic-02.topic: Conic sections: matsanangudziro nema tangent lines e parabolas, ellipses, ne hyperbolas; kuenderana pakati pezvimiro nema equations
n-m-h3-conic-02.title: Tinoda chii chimwe kusarudza equation ye hyperbola?
n-m-h3-conic-02.goal: Tonga kana pane ruzivo rwakakwana rwekusarudza equation ye curve nekuenzanisa huwandu hwema unknowns nehuwandu hwema equations akazvimirira.
n-m-h3-conic-02.material: Bhuku rekudzidzira rine dambudziko "Wana equation ye hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 (a>0, b>0) ine ma foci (5, 0) ne (−5, 0)." Mudzidzisi akati, "Dambudziko iri rakashaya mamiriro mamwe." Unoda kupedza dambudziko nekuzadza mamiriro akashaikwa.
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.0: Verenga ma equations anogadzirwa neruzivo rwakapiwa
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.2: Ratidza kuti ruzivo hurisina kukwana nekushandisa counterexample (curve yakasiyana ine ma foci akafanana)
n-m-h3-conic-02.prereq.0: Chimiro chakajairika x²/a²−y²/b²=1 che hyperbola, nezvinoreva ma foci, ma vertices, nema asymptotes
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvidimbu zvose zveruzivo zvinoita kuti, kana zvawedzerwa kuruzivo rwekuti ma foci i (5, 0) ne (−5, 0) sekuwedzera kwega, zvisarudze a ne b nenzira yega. (a>0, b>0)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora rimwe nerimwe kana chidimbu cheruzivo chimwe nechimwe chinopa equation itsva inobatanidza a ne b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga wawana kuti equation ipi inobatanidza a ne b yatoshanda kana ma foci chete ari kuzivikanwa.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.b: Distance pakati pema foci maviri i 10.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvatoziviswa kubva pa coordinates dzema foci (±5, 0), saka hazvisi ruzivo rutsva. Kuchine equation imwe chete pamaequations anodiwa anobatanidza a ne b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvinogara zvakadaro kune curve ipi neipi yechimiro x²/a²−y²/b²=1. Hazvisi ruzivo rutsva nezve a ne b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.e: Kuisa x=0 kunopa −y²/b²=1, saka hyperbola yechimiro ichi haisangani ne y-axis. Hazvisi ruzivo rutsva nezve a ne b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.explain: Ruzivo rwema foci runopa equation imwe chete, a²+b²=25. Vertex (3, 0) inopa a=3, saka b=4 inosarudzwa, uye slope ye asymptote 4/3 inopa b/a=4/3, saka a=3 ne b=4 zvinosarudzwa. Distance pakati pema foci kuva 10, symmetry pa origin, nekusasangana ne y-axis zvatoziviswa kana zvinogara zvakadaro, saka hazvisi kuwedzera equation.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma hyperbolas maviri ezvimiro zvakasiyana ane ma foci (5, 0) ne (−5, 0) uye ari echimiro x²/a² − y²/b² = 1, uye uise (a, b). (Kana ukanyora ma decimals, shandisa decimal places mbiri.)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isa mutengo we c mu equation inoshanda pakati pe a, b, ne c kune hyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza mutengo mumwe we a unogutsa equation iyoyo uye utarise kuti b inova chii.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b dzinofanira kuva positive.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Iyi i hyperbola ine ma foci (±5, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.explain: Kana ma foci akafanana, c=5, saka a²+b²=25. Kwete (3, 4) ne (4, 3) chete asi mapeya sa (2, anenge 4.58) zvose zvinogoneka, saka kune ma hyperbolas asingaperi ezvimiro zvakasiyana.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangura nei ma hyperbolas akasiyana achibuda kunyange ma foci akafanana.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Verenga kuti kune ma equations mangani anobatanidza a ne b uye ma unknowns mangani.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Verenga a²+b² kune rimwe nerimwe pamapeya maviri awakagadzira uye uaenzanise.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti pane equation imwe chete inoshanda pakati pe a ne b here?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakapa mienzaniso miviri kana kupfuura ye (a, b) inogutsa equation iyoyo here?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana ma foci i (±5, 0), ipapo c=5, uye kune hyperbola equation imwe chete inobuda: a²+b²=c²=25. Kune ma unknowns maviri, a ne b, saka b inochinja zvichienderana nekuti a yasarudzwa sei, uye kune ma curves asingaperi.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Tinongopiwa a²+b²=25, saka (3, 4) inoshanda, (4, 3) inoshanda, uye dzakawanda dzimwe. Saka ma foci oga haasarudze nenzira yega.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, sarudza nzira inogona kushandiswa kuma curves kunze kwema hyperbolas zvakare. Kana wagamuchira ruzivo rutsva, nzira inovimbika zvikuru yekusarudza kana ruzivo rwuchi oga runosarudza curve nenzira yega i ipi?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.0: Isa padivi pedivi huwandu hwema equations anowanikwa kubva pazvidimbu zviviri zveruzivo zvakashandiswa kusvika zvino nehuwandu hwema unknowns.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti chidimbu chimwe chitsva cheruzivo chinochinja sei huwandu uhwu.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.a: Sarudza nekutarisa kana ruzivo rutsva rune nhamba chaidzo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.a: Kunyange pane nhamba, dzinogona kungotaura zvakare chimwe chinhu chatoziviswa (semuenzaniso, distance pakati pema foci). Kuvapo kwenhamba hakugone kuva chiyero.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.b: Tarisa kana inopa equation imwe zvakare inobatanidza a ne b yakasiyana nemamiriro e ma foci.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.c: Tarisa kana curve ingadhonzwa uchishandisa ruzivo rutsva.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.c: Kugona kudhonza mufananidzo hakureve kuti nhamba dzasarudzwa. Unofanira kusarudza kana dzasarudzwa uchishandisa ma equations.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.d: Sarudza nekutarisa kana ruzivo rutsva runotaurwa nenzira imwechete nema foci.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.d: Nzira yekutaura chimwe chinhu haina hukama nehuwandu heruzivo. Chakakosha i kuti equation ipi inowedzerwa.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.explain: Kuti zvisarudzwe nenzira yega, unoda ma equations akazvimirira akawanda sema unknowns. Ma foci akapa equation imwe chete uye a ne b i ma unknowns maviri, saka unofanira kutarisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwunopa equation imwe zvakare yakasiyana neyatozivikanwa. Zvisinei, kunyange nema equations maviri mhinduro ingasava imwe chete, saka pakupedzisira gadzirisa kuti usimbise.

n-m-h3-conic-04.topic: Conic sections: matsanangudziro nema tangent lines e parabolas, ellipses, ne hyperbolas; kuenderana pakati pezvimiro nema equations
n-m-h3-conic-04.title: Kugadzira mitsetse inobata hyperbola iwe pachako
n-m-h3-conic-04.goal: Gadzira mitsetse yakawanda inobata iwe pachako, uwane kuti pane renji ye slope apo tangent line iripo, uye utsanangure izvi uchishandisa discriminant.
n-m-h3-conic-04.material: Pane hyperbola x²/4 − y²/9 = 1. Uchazivisisa nezve mitsetse y = mx + k inobata curve iyi nekuigadzira iwe pachako.
n-m-h3-conic-04.thinking.1: Gadzira tangent line iwe pachako uye utsvage mutsara
n-m-h3-conic-04.prereq.1: Hukama hwenzvimbo pakati pemutsetse ne conic (simultaneous equation)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira mitsetse mitatu yakasiyana y = mx + k inobata hyperbola x²/4 − y²/9 = 1 uye uise (m, k). (Shandisa ma decimal kusvika ku decimal place nhatu.)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.0: Isa equation yemutsetse mu equation ye hyperbola kuti ugadzire equation mu x.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti equation iyoyo inofanira kuva mumamiriro api kuti mutsetse ubate curve papoinzi imwe chete.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.ok.c1: Kuisa mutsetse kunopa quadratic equation mu x.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Neslope iyi, kuisa mutsetse hakupi quadratic equation.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.explain: Kuisa y=mx+k mu 9x²−4y²=36 kunopa (9−4m²)x²−8mkx−4k²−36=0. Discriminant ndi144(k²+9−4m²), saka kuti ibate, k²=4m²−9. Semuenzaniso, kana m=2.5, ipapo k²=16, saka k=±4.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.prompt: Rangarira mitsetse yawakagadzira kare. Sarudza ma slope ose apo mutsetse y = mx + k unobata hyperbola iyi uripo.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mamiriro ekuti discriminant ye equation yawakagadzira kare ive 0 se equation mu k².
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kune slope m imwe neimwe, sarudza kuti k² yaizova negative here.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.a: Mutsetse wakachinjika y=k unoyambuka dutu rimwe nerimwe rema hyperbola kamwe kana kusasangana nawo. Haugoni kubata.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.d: Zvinoita sekuti wakafunga kuti slope diki ine tangent line. Kana ukatakura chiyero che ellipse tangent k²=a²m²+b² sezvayakaita, unowana k=±√13, asi mutsetse uyu unosangana ne hyperbola mumapoinzi maviri.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.explain: Kuti ibate, k²=4m²−9≥0 inodiwa, uye kubvisa nyaya inoenderana ne asymptote (slope ±3/2), 4m²>9, ndiko kuti, |m|>3/2. Ma slope 2 ne−3 anoshanda; kune 0 ne1, k² inegative, saka haashande.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.prompt: Mutsetse une slope 1 haugoni kubata hyperbola iyi. Tsanangura kuti nei, uye utsanangure renji ye slope m apo tangent line iripo.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.0: Isa m=1 uye utsvage k inoita kuti discriminant ive 0.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga kuti m inofanira kuva mu renji ipi kuti k² isave negative.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura here chikonzero uchishandisa discriminant (kana chiratidzo che k²)?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti muganhu werenji wakabatana ne slope dze asymptote?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.0: Kuisa y=x+k kunopa discriminant 144(k²+5), iyo isingambova 0. Kuti ive tangent line, k²=4m²−9≥0 inodiwa, saka absolute value ye m inofanira kuva huru kupfuura 3/2.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.1: Ne slope 1, k²=−5, saka hapana k real uye nekudaro hapana tangent line. Ma slope e tangent line anoda 4m²−9 kuva 0 kana kupfuura, asi ±1.5, dzinoenderana ne asymptote, dzinofanira kubviswa, saka |m|>1.5.

n-m-h3-conic-05.topic: Conic sections: matsanangudziro nema tangent lines e parabolas, ellipses, ne hyperbolas; kuenderana pakati pezvimiro nema equations
n-m-h3-conic-05.title: Kana k ichichinja, rudzi rwe curve runochinjawo here?
n-m-h3-conic-05.goal: Mu equation ye conic ine tsamba, tsvaga nekutarisa zvakananga ma interval apo rudzi rwechimiro runochinja zvichienderana nezviratidzo zve ma denominator.
n-m-h3-conic-05.material: Kune real k, tsvaga kuti chimiro chinoratidzwa ne equation x²/(9−k) + y²/(4−k) = 1 chinochinja sei ne k. Kana ukaisa k=2, inova x²/7 + y²/2 = 1, iyo iellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-05.thinking.2: Tarisa kuti equation inogona kusaratidza chimiro zvachose
n-m-h3-conic-05.prereq.0: Standard form dze ellipse ne hyperbola
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukaisa k=6, unowana x²/3 + y²/(−2) = 1. Equation iyi inoratidza chimiro chipi?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora zvakare term ine denominator ye negative mufomu yekubvisa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa equation yakanyorwa zvakare ne standard form uye utarise kuti term ipi ipositive.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.a: Iellipse, nekuti equation yakanyorwa sehuwandu hwema term maviri.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti chiratidzo che denominator chinogona kuchinja kana ukaisa k. Wakatarisa chitarisiko che equation chete.
