n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.b: Ihyperbola ine transverse axis munzira ye y-axis, nekuti negative iri padivi re y².
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.b: Kana denominator ye negative iri padivi re y², term ye x² ipositive, saka inovhura munzira ye x-axis. Tarisa kuti term ipi ipositive.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.c: Hapana chimiro zvachose, nekuti denominator imwe inegative.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.c: Kana denominator imwe inegative, equation inova kubvisa. Haisi kuti hapana mapoinzi; rudzi rwe curve runochinja.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.d: Ihyperbola, nekuti denominator imwe inova negative uye equation inotora fomu yekubvisa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.explain: y²/(−2) ndi−y²/2, saka equation ndi x²/3 − y²/2 = 1. Term ye x² ipositive, saka ihyperbola inovhura munzira ye x-axis.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise makosha matatu akasiyana e k apo equation x²/(9−k) + y²/(4−k) = 1 inova hyperbola yemufomu x²/A − y²/B = 1 (A>0, B>0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora kuti zviratidzo zve ma denominator maviri zvinofanira kuva chii kuti equation itore fomu yekubvisa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.1: Shandura mamiriro echiratidzo ichocho kuita ma inequality mu k uye utsvage renji.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Denominator ye term ye x² ipositive.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Denominator ye term ye x² haisi positive.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Term ye y² inotora fomu yekubvisa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Term ye y² haishanduki kuita fomu yekubvisa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.explain: Kana denominator 9−k ye term ye x² ipositive uye denominator 4−k ye term ye y² inegative, equation inotora fomu x²/(9−k) − y²/(k−4) = 1. Ndiko kuti, k imwe neimwe ine 4<k<9 inoshanda (k=4 ne9 hazvishande nekuti denominator ndi0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Kana k=2 yaiva ellipse, asi kana k=6 yakava hyperbola. Tsanangura kuti chikamu chipi che equation chakachinja uye sei.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora zviratidzo zve ma denominator maviri kune k=2 nekune k=6 uye uzviwenzanise.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tsvaga kuti denominator ipi yakachinja chiratidzo.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakaenzanisa here shanduko dzezviratidzo dzema denominator maviri pa k=2 ne k=6?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakanongedza here chaizvo kuti denominator ipi yakachinja chiratidzo?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana k=2, ma denominator maviri ndi7 ne2, ose ari positive, saka ine fomu yehuwandu (ellipse). Kana k=6, denominator 4−k padivi re y² inova −2, inegative, saka equation inochinja kuita fomu yekubvisa (hyperbola).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana k ikapfuura 4, 4−k inova negative. Ipapo chiratidzo chiri pamberi pe term ye y² chinochinja, saka ellipse inova hyperbola. 9−k inoramba iri positive.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukaisa k=10, equation inova x²/(−1) + y²/(−6) = 1. Chirevo chipi nezve chimiro chinoratidzwa ne equation iyi chakarurama?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora zvakare divi rekuruboshwe nekubvisa ma denominator.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa renji yemakosha anogona kutorwa nedivi rekuruboshwe nedivi rekurudyi, 1.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.a: Hapana poinzi (x, y) inogutsa equation iyi.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.b: Iellipse, nekuti kunyangwe ma denominator ose maviri akachinja, ichiri mufomu yehuwandu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.b: Kunyangwe ma denominator ose maviri ari negative, ichiri mufomu yehuwandu, asi hauna kutarisa kuti divi rekuruboshwe haringaite rakakura kupfuura 0, saka haringaenzane ne1 kurudyi.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.c: Ihyperbola inovhura munzira ye x-axis, nekuti 9−k inegative.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.c: Ma denominator ose maviri ari negative, saka haisi mufomu yekubvisa. Tarisa zviratidzo kamwe zvakare.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.d: Idenderedzwa, nekuti ma term maviri anoita akafanana.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.d: Ma denominator ane makosha akasiyana, saka haigoni kuva denderedzwa, uye hauna kutarisawo zviratidzo.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.explain: Divi rekuruboshwe ndi−x²−y²/6, iyo ndi0 zvakanyanya. Haigoni kuenzana ne1 kurudyi, saka hapana (x, y) real inogutsa equation iyi. Zvichienderana nekuti ma denominator ari positive kana negative, inoparadzana kuita ellipse, hyperbola, kana hapana chinhu zvachose.

n-m-h3-conic-07.topic: Conic sections: matsanangudziro nema tangent lines e parabolas, ellipses, ne hyperbolas; kuenderana pakati pezvimiro nema equations
n-m-h3-conic-07.title: Huwandu hwenzira mbiri dzinopfuura papoinzi iri pa parabola
n-m-h3-conic-07.goal: Uchishandisa nzvimbo yemapoinzi, ona kuti lower bound kubva pa triangle inequality haisi kukosha kunosvikwa nguva dzose, uye utsvage minimum zvakare uchishandisa definition ye parabola (chinhambwe kuenda ku focus = chinhambwe kuenda ku directrix).
n-m-h3-conic-07.material: Parabola y² = 8x ine focus F(2, 0) ne directrix x = −2. Seoyun anoti, "Kune poinzi P iri pa curve nepoinzi ipi neipi A, minimum ye PA + PF inogara iri AF ne triangle inequality."
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.1: Kunyora zvakare mufomu yakasiyana uchishandisa definition
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.2: Kuparadzanisa kuita nyaya zvichienderana nenzvimbo yepoinzi
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.prompt: Kune parabola y² = 8x ine focus F(2, 0) nepoindi A(4, 2), wakafambisa poindi P iri pakakombama kuti uwane kukosha kushoma kwe PA+PF. Kukosha kupi nechikonzero chipi zvinowirirana zvakanakisa?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza mapoindi akati wandei P pakakombama, verenga PA+PF zvakananga, uye ugadzire tafura.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.1: Rangarira tsananguro uye utarise kana uchigona kunyora patsva PF sekureba kumwe kwepoindi iri paparabola.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.a: 6, nokuti yakaenzana nechinhambwe kubva ku A kuenda kudirectrix.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.b: 2√2, nokuti PA+PF ≥ AF uye pane P apo kuenzana kunoshanda.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.b: Kuenzana mu triangle inequality kunoshanda kana P iri pachikamu AF chete. Hauna kutarisa kana P yakadaro iri pakakombama.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.c: 4, nokuti yakaenzana ne x-coordinate ye A.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.c: Wakatarisa ma coordinate epoindi A chete. Hapana tsananguro yekuti kukosha uku ndiwo huwandu hwezvinhambwe zvipi.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.d: 2+2√5, nokuti ndiko kukosha pa vertex P=(0, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.d: Wakangowana kukosha papoindi imwe uye hauna kutarisa kana ndiko kukosha kushoma.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.explain: Kune poindi iri paparabola, PF yakaenzana nechinhambwe kubva ku P kuenda kudirectrix x=−2. Saka PA+PF ndihwo huwandu hwe PA ne "chinhambwe kubva ku P kuenda kudirectrix," icho chiri 6 kana kupfuura, chinhambwe kubva ku A kuenda kudirectrix. Yakaenzana ne 6 papoindi iri pakakombama pakukwirira kwakafanana na A, sa P=(0.5, 2). 2√2 ndi AF, asi A ne F zvese zviri mukati mekakombama, saka chikamu AF hachiyambuki kakombama uye hachigoni kusvikwa.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino sarudza poindi A(x, y) ine ma coordinate enhamba dzakazara (−10 kusvika 10), uye utsvage unyore mapoindi matatu akasiyana A apo kukosha kushoma kwe PA+PF kwakaenzana ne AF kana P ichifamba pakakombama.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wataura kuti P inofanira kuva papi kuti kuenzana mu triangle inequality kushande.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.1: Patsanura kuva nyaya apo A iri mukati nekunze kwekakombama, uye udhonze kana chikamu AF chichisangana nekakombama.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Aya ndi ma coordinate enhamba dzakazara mukati mehuwandu.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Ma coordinate anofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara kubva pa −10 kusvika pa 10 zvichisanganisirwa.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Chikamu AF chinosangana nekakombama, saka pane P ine PA+PF=AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kune poindi iyi, hapana P pakakombama apo yakaenzana ne AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.explain: PA+PF ≥ AF, uye kuenzana kunoshanda kana P iri pachikamu AF chete. F iri mukati mekakombama, saka kana A iri pakakombama kana kunze kwayo (y² ≥ 8x), chikamu AF chinosangana nekakombama. Kana A iri mukati (y² < 8x), chikamu hachisangani nekakombama, saka kukosha kushoma kwakakura kupfuura AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.prompt: Pa A(4, 2), kukosha kushoma kwakabuda kwakakura kupfuura AF. Tsanangura kuti sei chirevo chaSeoyun "kukosha kushoma kwe PA+PF kunogara kuri AF" chakanganisa.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.0: Taura kuti P yaifanira kuva papi kuti kuenzana kushande muinequality yakashandiswa naSeoyun.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana mamiriro iwayo akasangana pa A(4, 2) uchishandisa nzvimbo dzechikamu AF nekakombama.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here mamiriro ekuenzana e triangle inequality?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti mhedzisiro inosiyana zvichienderana nenzvimbo yepoindi A (mukati/kunze kwekakombama)?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.0: PF yakaenzana nechinhambwe kubva ku P kuenda kudirectrix, saka PA+PF ndi 6 kana kupfuura, chinhambwe kubva ku A kuenda kudirectrix. 6 iyi yakakura zvikuru kupfuura AF=2√2. Chirevo chaSeoyun hachigari chiri chokwadi, sezvo pane nyaya apo AF iri kukosha kushoma.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.1: Kuenzana mu triangle inequality PA+PF≥AF kunoshanda kana P iri pachikamu AF chete. Kana A ne F zvese zviri mukati mekakombama, chikamu AF hachisangani nekakombama, saka hapana P yakadaro. Saka kukosha kushoma kwakakura kupfuura AF.

n-m-h3-diffc-05.title: Kana function yemukati ine kona, composite function ine futi here?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.goal: Edza chirevo che "kana function yemukati isina differentiable, composite function isina differentiable futi" nemienzaniso, uye usimbise mamiriro apo composite function inova differentiable nemienzaniso yaunovaka iwe pachako.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.material: g(x)=|x| haina differentiable pa x=0. (Slope kuruboshwe kwe x=0 i−1, uye slope kurudyi i1.) Minseo anoti, "Kana function yemukati g isina differentiable pa x=0, saka kune function f ipi zvayo iri differentiable, composite function h(x)=f(g(x))=f(|x|) haina differentiable pa x=0."
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.1: Vaka uye uongorore muenzaniso unogutsa mamiriro
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.2: Tsanangura mhedzisiro mumamiriro apo chain rule isingagoni kushandiswa
n-m-h3-diffc-05.prereq.0: Absolute value function |x| haina differentiable pa x=0
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza f dzose dzinoita kuti h(x)=f(|x|) ive differentiable pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kune f imwe neimwe, nyora h(x)=f(|x|) zvakananga nenzira ye |x|.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.1: Padhuze ne x=0, shandisa |x|=x kune x>0 ne |x|=−x kune x<0 kufananidza chimiro che h kuruboshwe nekurudyi.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.a: h(x)=x²+|x|, uye x² haigoni kuvanza kona ye |x|. Kune f iyi, slope pa x=0 haisi 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.b: h(x)=|x|³, saka maslopes ekumativi ose e x=0 anoswedera pedyo ne0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.e: h(x)=(|x|−1)²=x²−2|x|+1, uye nokuda kwe −2|x| ine kona pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.explain: Right derivative ye h pa x=0 i f′(0) uye left derivative i −f′(0). Kuti dzienzane, f′(0)=0 inodiwa. x³ ne x²+3 dzine f′(0)=0, saka dziri differentiable, uye mamwe ane f′(0) yakaenzana ne1, 3, ne−2 zvichiteverana, saka ane makona.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.prompt: Rega f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx. Isa mitatu miviri kana kupfuura yakasiyana (a, b, c) inoita kuti h(x)=f(|x|) ive differentiable pa x=0. Pano a ne b hazvisi 0, uye dzose dzi integers kubva ku−9 kusvika ku9 zvakasanganisirwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora f(|x|) semutauro uye usiyanise mazwi apo |x| inosara semupowers weodd nemazwi ane mapowers eeven, apo |x| inoshaika.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga izwi ripi rinosiya |x| sezvayakaita uye rinopa kona pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Macoefficients ose matatu ndi integers mukati merange.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a, b, ne c dzinofanira kuva integers kubva ku−9 kusvika ku9 zvakasanganisirwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Maslopes ekuruboshwe nekurudyi pa x=0 akaenzana.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana coefficient ye x isiri 0, h ine kona pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.explain: Muna h(x)=a|x|³+bx²+c|x|, a|x|³ ne bx² dziri differentiable pa x=0, uye c|x| ine kona kana c≠0. Saka c inofanira kuva 0. Ndiko kuti, f′(0)=c=0. (1, 2, 1) ine c≠0, saka ine kona; (0, 2, 0) ne (1, 0, −2) dzine a=0 ne b=0 zvichiteverana, saka dzinoputsa mamiriro c2, uye yekupedzisira inoputsawo c3.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura kuti chirevo chaMinseo chakaipa uchishandisa mienzaniso iri pamusoro, uye unyore mamiriro anofanira kugutswa ne f kuti f(|x|) ive differentiable pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.0: Isa padivi nedivi ma f akanga ari differentiable munhanho yapfuura neasina kudaro, uye ufananidze slope ye f pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.1: Taura right slope neleft slope ye h pa x=0 nenzira yeslope ye f.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakapa f imwe chaiyo uye wakaratidza kuti h(x) iri differentiable pa x=0 here?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti left slope neright slope zvinova zvakaenzana sei here?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.0: Kana f(x)=x²+3, saka h(x)=x²+3, iri differentiable pa x=0. Kunyange |x| ichine kona, composite haina. Right slope ye h i f′(0) uye left slope i −f′(0), saka kana f′(0)=0 maslopes maviri akaenzana uye iri differentiable. Saka chirevo chaMinseo chakaipa.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.1: Counterexample i f(x)=x³. h(x)=|x|³ ine slope 0 pa x=0. Zvakajairika, kana f′(0)=0, left ne right derivatives i0 ne0, saka iri differentiable, uye kana f′(0) isiri 0, ine kona.

n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga kunobva pane zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.title: Chii chinoitika kana slope i0 uye huwandu hwekukombama i0 futi?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.topic: Differentiation: kududzira magirafu, makoshero akanyanyisa, nesecond derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.goal: Sezvo ruzivo rwuchiwedzerwa chidimbu nechidimbu, gadzirisa kutonga kwemakoshero akanyanyisa, uye unzwisise kuti kana kukosha kwesecond derivative kuri 0, unofanira kutarisa zvakananga shanduko yechiratidzo cheiderivative.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.material: Polynomial function f inogutsa f′(0)=0 pa x=0. Nguva imwe neimwe kana ruzivo rwuchiratidzwa, tarisa kutonga kwako nezvechimiro chinoita girafu pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.2: Tarisa makoshero akanyanyisa kubva pashanduko yechiratidzo cheiderivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.0: Hukama pakati pemakoshero akanyanyisa neshanduko dzechiratidzo cheiderivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.2: Zvinoreva inflection point (poinzi apo kukombama kunochinja)
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda, sarudza kuti runoshandiswa kutest ipi uye kana mamiriro akarurama kuti test ipe mhedziso.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Fananidza kana zvokwadi zvekuti f′ ne f″ imwe neimwe i0 zvichitaura zvakafanana nezviratidzo kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwepoinzi iyoyo.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f′(0)=0. (Pa x=0, tangent line iri parallel ne x-axis.)
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Tinogona kutaura kuti f ine kukosha kwakanyanyisa pa x=0 here?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: f′(x)=0 inongokuudza munhu anosarudzwa wekukosha kwakanyanyisa. Unofanira kuziva zvakawanda nezvechiratidzo che f′ pamberi nepashure pe x=0, kana chiratidzo che f″.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ilocal minimum: kana tangent line iri horizontal, girafu inoibata ichibva pazasi
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakatora poinzi dzose dzine horizontal tangent line selocal minimum. Horizontal tangent line inogona kuitika palocal maximum, local minimum, kana inflection point.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ilocal maximum: kana tangent line iri horizontal, ndiyo nzvimbo yepamusoro yegirafu
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakatora poinzi dzose dzine horizontal tangent line selocal maximum.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hatisati taziva: inogona kuva kana kusava kukosha kwakanyanyisa, saka tinoda kuziva zvakawanda
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakafunga kuti horizontal tangent line yoga haigoni kusarudza kuti ikukosha kwakanyanyisa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kuona ruzivo urwu, kutonga kwako zvino ndekupi?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Test yekuti f″(0)>0 inopa local minimum uye f″(0)<0 inopa local maximum haikuudzi chinhu kana f″(0)=0. f(x)=x⁴, −x⁴, ne x³ dzose dzine f′(0)=f″(0)=0, asi zvimiro zvadzo zvakasiyana.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Hakusi kukosha kwakanyanyisa: kana f″(0) i0, haisi kukosha kwakanyanyisa
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaverenga f″(0)=0 sehumbowo hwekuti haisi kukosha kwakanyanyisa. Zvinongoreva kuti test ye "positive second derivative inoreva local minimum, negative inoreva local maximum" haigoni kushandiswa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Haigoni kusarudzwa kubva paruzivo urwu: test inoshandisa second derivative inomira kushanda
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakaona kuti kana f″(0)=0, f″ haigoni kushandiswa kusarudza kana ilocal maximum kana minimum.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ilocal minimum: slope i0 uye kukombama i0, saka ndiyo yakaenzana zvikuru
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakasimbisa local minimum kubva pakunzwa kwe "kuenzana." Poinzi yakaenzana haifaniri kuva poinzi yakaderera.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Pakupedzisira, chimiro che f pa x=0 chii?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: f′(x)=4x³ inegative kune x<0 uye ipositive kune x>0, saka f ine local minimum pa x=0. Zvakare f″(x)=12x²≥0, saka kukombama hakuchinji, uye haisi inflection point.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ine local minimum, uye poinzi iyi haisi inflection point
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakaverenga pamwe chete kuti chiratidzo che f′ chinochinja kubva negative kuenda positive uye kuti f″ i0 kana kupfuura uye haichinji chiratidzo.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Haina kukosha kwakanyanyisa, uye poinzi iyi iinflection point
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakasarudza kuti iinflection point nokuti f″(0)=0 chete. Kuti ive inflection point, chiratidzo che f″ chinofanira kuchinja.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ine local minimum, uye poinzi iyi iinflection point futi
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakafunga kuti f″(0)=0 inoreva inflection point. f″(x)=12x² i0 kana kupfuura, saka chiratidzo chayo hachichinji.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, f′(0)=0 yoga yaiita sekukosha kwakanyanyisa, uye kana f″(0)=0 yabuda, test yakamira kushanda. Kunyange zvakadaro, unogona kusvika pamhedziso nekuongorora zvakananga kana chiratidzo che f′ chichichinja. Kukosha kuva 0 kwakasiyana nechiratidzo kuchinja.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza function ine f′(0)=0 ne f″(0)=0 isina kukosha kwakanyanyisa pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Wana derivative yefunction imwe neimwe uye ufananidze chiratidzo chayo kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Patsanura kuita ma functions apo chiratidzo che f′ chinochinja nema functions apo chisingachinji.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.a: x⁴ ine f′(0)=f″(0)=0 asi ine local minimum pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.b: −x⁶ ine f′(0)=f″(0)=0 asi ine local maximum pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.c: x⁶ ine local minimum pa x=0 futi. Tarisa kana exponent iri even.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.d: Kune x³, f′(x)=3x² haichinji chiratidzo, saka hapana kukosha kwakanyanyisa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.explain: Kune x³, f′(x)=3x²≥0, saka f′ ine chiratidzo chakafanana pamberi nepashure pe x=0, uye hapana kukosha kwakanyanyisa. Kune mamwe ma functions matatu, chiratidzo che f′ chinochinja, saka ane makoshero akanyanyisa. Izvi zvinoreva kuti f′(0)=f″(0)=0 yoga haigoni kuudza kuti inyaya ipi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.prompt: Kana f′(0)=0 ne f″(0)=0, nyora zvaunofanira kuongorora, uye kuti sei, kusarudza kana pane kukosha kwakanyanyisa pa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kuti kutaura kuti pane kukosha kwakanyanyisa kunoita sei nenzira yechiratidzo che f′.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora zvakasiyana nzira isingachakwanisi kushandiswa kana f″(0)=0 nenzira ichigona kushandiswa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso Kana f″(0)=0, saka ... panzvimbo pacho ...
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora kuti unofananidza chiratidzo che f′ kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe x=0 here?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti f″(0)=0 hazvireve kuti hapana kukosha kwakanyanyisa here?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.0: Kana f″(0)=0, second derivative haikwanise kukuudza kana ilocal maximum kana minimum. Saka unofanira kutarisa zvakananga kana chiratidzo che f′ chichichinja kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe x=0. Kana chichichinja, pane kukosha kwakanyanyisa, uye kana chisingachinji, hapana.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.1: Kana kukosha kwesecond derivative kuri 0, test inomira kushanda, saka dhirowa sign chart ye f′(x). Kana f′ ichichinja kubva negative kuenda positive (minimum) kana kubva positive kuenda negative (maximum) padhuze ne0, ikukosha kwakanyanyisa, uye kana chiratidzo chikaramba chakafanana, hakusi.

n-m-h3-diffc-08.title: Tangent inosangana nekakombama papoindi yekubata chete here?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b ndi nhamba dzakazara mukati mehuwandu.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.topic: Differentiation: ma equations e tangent lines, tangent lines dze cubic curves
n-m-h3-diffc-08.goal: Vaka muenzaniso wako wetangent line kune cubic curve inosangana ne curve zvakare papoinzi isiri poinzi yekubata, uye usiyanise mapoinzi ekubata apo izvi zvisingaitiki.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.material: Tangent line ku curve y=x³−3x papoinzi A(1, −2) i y=−2. Kune graph ye quadratic function, waona kuti tangent line inosangana ne curve papoinzi yekubata chete. Zvakadaro here kune curve iyi?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.thinking.1: Vaka muenzaniso unogutsa mamiriro iwe pachako
n-m-h3-diffc-08.prereq.2: Hukama pakati pema roots nema coefficients
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukawana ma x-coordinates ose emapoinzi apo tangent line y=−2 inosangana ne curve y=x³−3x, unowana chii?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Mapoinzi apo tangent line ne curve zvinosangana i mhinduro dze equation inoenzanisa ma expressions maviri. Seta equation.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.1: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti x=1 i mhinduro kufactor divi rekuruboshwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti sezvo i tangent line, inosangana ne curve papoinzi yekubata chete. Gadzirisa equation x³−3x=−2 zvakananga.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakatora x=1 ne −1 sepeya. Isa x=−1 mu equation kutarisa.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.c: Iyi i mhedzisiro yekufactor x³−3x+2=0 se (x−1)²(x+2)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.d: Wakasiya double root x=1. x=1 i poinzi yekubata, saka iri pa tangent line.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.explain: x³−3x+2=(x−1)²(x+2), saka mhinduro i x=1 (double root, poinzi yekubata) ne x=−2. Papoinzi (−2, −2), tangent line inosangana ne curve zvakare.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.prompt: Isa mapeya maviri kana kupfuura akasiyana (a, b) kuti tangent line ku curve y=x³−3x papoinzi (a, a³−3a) isangane zvakare ne curve papoinzi (b, b³−3b) isiri poinzi yekubata. (a ne b i integers kubva ku −6 kusvika ku 6 pamwe chete, uye b≠a)
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza mutengo we x-coordinate a yepoinzi yekubata, wana equation ye tangent line, uye unyore equation inowanikwa nekuiita yakaenzana ne curve.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa mhinduro yawatoziva mu equation iyoyo (poinzi yekubata) kuwana mhinduro dzasara.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b dzinofanira kuva integers kubva ku −6 kusvika ku 6 pamwe chete.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c2: b inofanira kuva yakasiyana ne a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Poinzi (b, b³−3b) iri pa tangent line.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Poinzi (b, b³−3b) haipo pa tangent line.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.explain: Kuita equation ye tangent line papoinzi (a, a³−3a) yakaenzana ne curve kunopa (x−a)²(x+2a)=0, saka x-coordinate yepoinzi yekusangana zvakare i b=−2a. (1, −2), (2, −4), ne (−3, 6) i mienzaniso; (1, 1) i poinzi yekubata pachayo, uye (1, −1) haisi poinzi iri pa tangent line.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Uchitarisa mapeya (a, b) awakawana, nyora hukama hunoratidza b maererano ne a, uye utsanangure nei hukama uhu huchishanda.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isa mitengo ye a ne b yemienzaniso yako padivi pedivi mutebhura uye uenzanise kuti b i ka mangani ye a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Funga kuti equation yakabatanidzwa i cubic uye kuti x=a i rudzi rupi rwe root (root imwe kana double root), uye unyore ma roots matatu.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.placeholder: semuenzaniso Kuita tangent line yakaenzana ne curve kunopa ...
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti cubic equation inoumbwa ne tangent line ne curve ine double root papoinzi yekubata here?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakawana b uchishandisa chokwadi chekuti huwandu hwema roots matatu i 0, kana nekufactor here?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.model.0: b=−2a. Kuita tangent line yakaenzana ne curve kunopa cubic equation yechimiro x³−3x=m(x−a)+a³−3a, uye poinzi yekubata x=a i double root, saka inogona kunyorwa se (x−a)²(x−b). Coefficient ye x² i 0, saka huwandu hwema roots matatu i a+a+b=0, zvichipa b=−2a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Ndakatarisa kuti inova (x−a)²(x+2a)=0. Poinzi yekubata i double root, saka kune factor (x−a)², uye hakuna x² term, saka root yasara i −2a, ndiko kuti, b=−2a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.prompt: Pakati pemapoinzi ari pa curve y=x³−3x, kune x-coordinate ipi iyo tangent line papoinzi iyoyo isingasangani ne curve kupi kupi kunze kwepoinzi yekubata?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Uchishandisa hukama hwawakawana mudanho rapfuura, wana x-coordinate yepoinzi yekusangana zvakare kune poinzi yekubata musarudzo imwe neimwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti chii chinoitika kana poinzi yekusangana zvakare yava yakafanana nepoinzi yekubata.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.a: Kana a=−1, tangent line inosangana ne curve zvakare pa x=2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.b: Wakafunga mamiriro apo x-coordinate yepoinzi yekusangana zvakare inova yakafanana nepoinzi yekubata.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.c: Kana a=1, tangent line inosangana ne curve zvakare pa x=−2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.d: Kana a=2, tangent line inosangana ne curve zvakare pa x=−4.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.explain: X-coordinate yepoinzi yekusangana zvakare i −2a, saka izvi zvinoenzana nepoinzi yekubata chete kana −2a=a, ndiko kuti, a=0. Tangent line y=−3x inosangana ne curve papoinzi imwe x=0, kubva ku x³=0. Poinzi iyi i inflection point ye curve zvakare.

n-m-h3-diffc-06.prereq.0: Chiratidzo che derivative nekukwira/kudzikira kwe function
n-m-h3-diffc-06.title: Unofanira kuudza sei mudzidzi mudiki zvinoreva kuti second derivative ipositive?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.topic: Differentiation: kududzira magirafu, second derivative neconvexity
n-m-h3-diffc-06.goal: Tsvaga mutsara wakaipa mutsananguro yemudzidzi mukuru, uuongorore necounterexample, uye uunyore patsva semutsara wakarurama unogona kunzwisiswa nemudzidzi mudiki.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.material: Mudiki wako Haeun akabvunza, "Kana f″(x)>0, girafu inokwira kana ichienda kurudyi here?" Mukuru wako Jihu akapindura sepazasi. Tarisa chinyorwa ichi wobva wachinyora patsva kuti Haeun anzwisise. (f″ iderivative yederivative ye f.)
n-m-h3-diffc-06.thinking.2: Nyora patsva kuti ienderane nemunhu anonzwa
n-m-h3-diffc-06.prereq.2: Zvinoreva convex downward (concave up) ne convex upward (concave down)
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe wakaipa mumhinduro yaJihu.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tevera kuti mutsara wega wega unoenderera sei kubva kumutsara wapfuura, mumwe nemumwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti chiratidzo chefunction ipi chaunofanira kuziva kuti utaure kuti "kukosha kunowedzera."
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.1: f′(x) kuwedzera kunoreva kuti slope yetangent line inoramba ichikura.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.2: Saka pa interval apo f″(x)>0, kukosha kwe f(x) kunokurawo kana uchienda kurudyi.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 wakaipa. Kuti kukosha kwe f(x) kunowedzera kana kudzika kunosarudzwa nechiratidzo che f′(x). f″>0 inongokuudza kuti f′ iri kuwedzera, saka pa interval apo f′ inegative, f(x) inogona kudzika uye ichine f″>0.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.prompt: Ndeipi function ne interval zvinoratidza zvakajeka zvikuru kuti mutsara 3 wakaipa?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.hint.0: Counterexample inyaya apo "mamiriro ekutanga ichokwadi asi mhedziso inhema." Kune function imwe neimwe, tarisa zvakasiyana chiratidzo che f″ nekuti f inokwira here.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, wanawo chiratidzo che f′.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.a: Pa interval iyi f″=2>0 uye f inokwira, saka hapana kupokana nemutsara 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.b: f″=2>0 asi f′=2x<0, saka f inodzikira. Uyu i muenzaniso unopokana nemutsara 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.c: f″=−2<0, saka hausi mamiriro e f″>0.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.d: f″=6x>0 uye f inokwira, saka hapana kupokana nemutsara 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.explain: Kune f(x)=x² ne x<0, f″(x)=2>0 asi f′(x)=2x<0, saka f(x) inodzikira. Graph i convex downward asi inoenda pasi.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare mutsara 3 kuti Haeun anzwisise. Unofanira kusanganisira zvinotaurwa ne f″(x)>0, uye chii chinosarudza kuti f(x) inokwira kana kudzikira.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mumakoramu maviri zvinotaurwa ne f″>0 nezvisingataurwi.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa muenzaniso unopokana wedanho rapfuura uye utarise kana mutengo unosarudza "kukwira kana kudzikira" i chiratidzo che f, f′, kana f″.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso Kana f″(x)>0, ipapo ... asi kana f inokwira ...
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura zvinotaurwa ne f″>0 maererano ne slope kana convexity here?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora kuti chiratidzo che f′ chinosarudza kukwira nekudzikira here?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakapa muenzaniso kuti Haeun atevere nekungotarisa zviratidzo here?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.model.0: Kana f″(x)>0, slope ye tangent line inoramba ichikura uye graph i convex downward. Asi kana f(x) inokwira kana kudzikira kunosarudzwa nechiratidzo che f′(x). Semuenzaniso, f(x)=x² ine f″=2>0 kune x<0, asi f′=2x<0, saka inodzikira.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.model.1: f″>0 zvinoreva kuti f′ i kukwira, ndiko kuti, slope iri kukura. Kana inokwira kurudyi kunosarudzwa nekuti slope i positive, ndiko kuti, f′>0. Kana slope i negative uye iri kukura, iri kuenda pasi uye ichine f″>0.

n-m-h3-prob-04.topic: Mukana: conditional probability, kuzvimiririra nekusazvimiririra, kufunga kwemhando yeBayes, kugadzira sample space
n-m-h3-prob-04.title: Kupfeka Magirazi Nekupinda Mukirabhu: Kugadzira Tebhura Yezvinhu Zvisina Hukama
n-m-h3-prob-04.goal: Gadzira ma 2×2 tables akati wandei apo zviitiko zviviri zvakazvimirira, uye utarise kuti ungaverenga sei independence se "ma rates mukati memapoka akaenzana."
n-m-h3-prob-04.material: Uchagadzira tebhura inoverenga vadzidzi 60 mukirasi se "kana vanopfeka magirazi" ne "kana vakapinda mukirabhu."
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.prompt: Vadzidzi 60 mukirasi vakarongerwa nekuti "kana vanopfeka magirazi" ne "kana vakapinda mukirabhu." Chirevo chipi chinotsanangura zvakanakisa zvinoreva kuti zvinhu zviviri izvi zvakazvimirira?
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kana, pakati pevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi chete, chikamu chevakapinda chakaenzana nechikamu chevakapinda pakazara.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kana zvakazvimirira, "kuziva kana mudzidzi anopfeka magirazi hakuchinji mukana wekupinda" kunofanira kushanda. Enzanisa kana sarudzo imwe neimwe ichitaura izvi.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.a: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi hwakaenzana nehwevasingapfeki.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakaverenga seyuwandu hwemapoka hwakaenzana. Independence i nezve ma rates mukati memapoka, kwete hukuru hwemapoka.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.b: Huwandu hwenhengo pakati pevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi hwakaenzana nehwenhengo pakati pevasingapfeki.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakaenzanisa huwandu hwevanhu. Kana mapoka maviri ane hukuru hwakasiyana, ma rates anosiyana kunyange huwandu hwevanhu hwakaenzana.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.c: Chikamu chenhengo pakati pevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi chakaenzana nechikamu chenhengo pakati pevasingapfeki.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.d: Mudzidzi wese anopfeka magirazi akapinda, uye mudzidzi wese asingapfeki magirazi haana kupinda.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.d: Wakatora zvinhu zviviri zvinogara zvichiuya pamwe chete sezvakazvimirira. Iyo i dependence yakasimba zvikuru, apo kuziva chimwe kunosarudza chimwe.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.explain: Kana chikamu chevakapinda pakati pevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi chakaenzana nechikamu chevakapinda pakati pevasingapfeki, ipapo kuziva kana mudzidzi anopfeka magirazi hakuchinji mukana wekupinda. Ndiko kuti, P(join|glasses)=P(join), izvo zvinoreva zvakafanana ne P(glasses∩join)=P(glasses)P(join).
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira matebhura evadzidzi 60. Ngatitii a = vanopfeka magirazi vakapinda, b = vanopfeka magirazi vasina kupinda, c = vasingapfeki magirazi vakapinda, d = vasingapfeki magirazi vasina kupinda. Nhamba ina dzose dzinofanira kuva natural numbers dzine 1 kana kupfuura dzine huwandu hwe 60, magirazi nekupinda zvinofanira kuva zvakazvimirira, uye huwandu hwevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi hunofanira kusiyana nehuwandu hwenhengo. Isa matebhura 3 akasiyana.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza huwandu hwevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi, x, nehuwandu hwenhengo, y. Kana zvakazvimirira, huwandu a hwevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi vakapinda hunofanira kuva x×y÷60.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza x ne y kuti a ive integer, wobva wazadza b, c, d dzasara kuti huwandu hwuve 60, uye utarise kuti ma rates enhengo emapoka maviri akaenzana.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba ina dzose i natural numbers dzine 1 kana kupfuura.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a, b, c, d dzose dzinofanira kuva natural numbers dzine 1 kana kupfuura.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Hazvizvimiriri. Enzanisa rate yenhengo yevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi neyevasingapfeki.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.ok.c4: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi hunosiyana nehuwandu hwenhengo.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c4: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwenhengo.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.explain: (10,10,20,20): pavadzidzi 20 vane magirazi, 10 vakapinda (1/2), uye pa 40 vasina, 20 vakapinda (1/2), saka ma rates akaenzana. Mu (5,15,10,30) mapoka ose maviri ane rate yenhengo ye 1/4, uye mu (12,18,12,18) ose ane 2/5. Mu (10,10,10,30) rate i 1/2 kuvadzidzi vane magirazi asi 1/4 kune vasina, saka hazvizvimiriri. (15,15,15,15) i yakazvimirira, asi huwandu hwevanopfeka magirazi hwakaenzana nehwenhengo, saka haigutsi mamiriro 4.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza imwe yematebhura ako, wana uye unyore rate yenhengo pakati pevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi nevasingapfeki, uye utsanangure nei izvozvo i humbowo hwe independence.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Mutebhura yawakasarudza, tanga wanyora huwandu hwevadzidzi vane magirazi nevasina, wobva wagovanisa huwandu hwenhengo hweboka rega rega nahwo.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nyora ma rates maviri padivi pedivi, enzanisa kana akaenzana, wobva wabatanidza izvi nezvinoreva independence.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Pakati pevadzidzi vanopfeka magirazi, rate yenhengo i ...
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Kune mapoka maviri rimwe nerimwe, wakawana rate nekugovanisa huwandu hwenhengo nehuwandu hwevadzidzi mubhoka iroro here?
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza ma rates akaenzana nepfungwa yekuti kupfeka magirazi hakuchinji mukana wekupinda here?
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Pavadzidzi 20 vane magirazi, 10 vakapinda, saka rate i 1/2, uye pavadzidzi 40 vasina magirazi, 20 vakapinda, saka i 1/2 zvakare. Sezvo ma rates maviri akaenzana, kuziva kana mudzidzi anopfeka magirazi hakuchinji mukana wekupinda, saka zvakazvimirira.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Zvose boka rinopfeka magirazi neboka risingapfeki zvine rate yenhengo ye 50%. Saka kana mudzidzi anopfeka magirazi hakuna mhedzisiro pamukana wekupinda, zvichireva kuti tinogona kutaura kuti zvakazvimirira.

n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga wakanganisa mumhinduro yaSeoyeon.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.title: Second derivative ye curve inopiwa neparameter
n-m-h3-diffc-07.topic: Differentiation: second derivative ye function inopiwa neparameter
n-m-h3-diffc-07.goal: Kune curve inopiwa neparameter, wana uye ugadzirise kukanganisa mugadziriso inosiyanisa dy/dx zvakare, uye usarudze fomula yakarurama.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.material: Iyi i gadziriso yaSeoyeon yekuwana second derivative d²y/dx² pa t=2 pa curve x=t², y=t³−3t (t>0). (t² i t square uye t³ i t cubed.)
n-m-h3-diffc-07.thinking.2: Enzanisa chimiro che ma expressions kusarudza fomula yakarurama
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.hint.0: Simbisa kuti dy/dx pamutsetse 2 i expression mu t, uye funga kuti unganyora sei maitiro ekuisiyanisa ne x uchishandisa chain rule.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tsanangura nemashoko kuti mutsetse mumwe nemumwe uri kuwana derivative ipi, uye utarise kana unotevera zvakarurama kubva pamutsetse wakapfuura nemuenzaniso nyore sa x=t², y=t³.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama. dy/dx i expression mu t, saka kuisiyanisa ne x, unofanira kutanga waisiyanisa ne t wobva wagovanisa ne dx/dt. Kusiyanisa y ne x kaviri imwe neimwe nekugovanisa hakusi kuverenga uku. Mutsetse 4 unongoshandisa mhedzisiro yemutsetse 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.prompt: Wana mutengo we d²y/dx² pa t=2 uchishandisa nzira yakarurama, uye unyore kuti wakaiwana sei.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ita dy/dx nyore seexpression mu t, wobva wasiyanisa expression iyoyo ne t.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kusiyanisa ne x, shandisa dx/dt kufunga kuti unofanira kugovanisa derivative ne t ne chii.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatanga waita dy/dx nyore seexpression mu t here?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakasiyanisa expression iyoyo ne t wobva wagovanisa ne dx/dt here?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.0: dy/dx=(3t²−3)/(2t)=(3/2)(t−1/t), uye kuisiyanisa ne t kunopa (3/2)(1+1/t²). Kugovanisa izvi ne dx/dt=2t kunopa d²y/dx². Pa t=2, (3/2)(5/4)=15/8, yakagovaniswa ne 4, inopa 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.1: d²y/dx²=(d/dt(dy/dx))÷(dx/dt). Kuisa t=2 mu d/dt{(3/2)(t−1/t)}=(3/2)(1+1/t²) kunopa 15/8, uye kugovanisa ne dx/dt=4 kunopa 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza fomula yakarurama yekuwana d²y/dx² kune curve inopiwa neparameter.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti d²y/dx² inogona kuverengwa se "kusiyanisa chii ne chii."
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa chain rule kufunga kuti unofanira kuwanza kana kugovanisa ne chii kushandura kusiyanisa ne t kuita kusiyanisa ne x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.a: Govanisa y yakasiyaniswa kaviri ne t ne x yakasiyaniswa kaviri ne t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.a: Iyi i nzira yakashandiswa naSeoyeon. Ratio yemitengo yakasiyaniswa kaviri ne t yakasiyana ne dy/dx yakasiyaniswa ne x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.b: Govanisa dy/dx yakasiyaniswa kamwe ne t ne x yakasiyaniswa kamwe ne t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.b: Izvi zvinotaura maitiro ekusiyanisa dy/dx ne x uchishandisa chain rule.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.c: Govanisa dy/dx yakasiyaniswa kamwe ne t ne x yakasiyaniswa kaviri ne t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.c: Waisa second derivative ye x mu denominator. Kushandura kuita kusiyanisa ne x, unogovanisa ne dx/dt kamwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.d: Govanisa dy/dx yakasiyaniswa kamwe ne t ne square ye x yakasiyaniswa kamwe ne t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.d: Wakaita denominator square. Mu chain rule, chega chaunogovanisa nacho kushandura kusiyanisa ne t kuita kusiyanisa ne x i dx/dt, kamwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.explain: d²y/dx²=d/dx(dy/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]·(dt/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]÷(dx/dt). Pa t=2, mafomula ari pamusoro anopa 6, 15/16, ne 15/128 zvichiteverana, izvo zvakasiyana nemutengo wakarurama 15/32.

n-m-h3-conic-03.topic: Conic sections: matsanangudziro nema tangent lines e parabolas, ellipses, ne hyperbolas; kuenderana pakati pezvimiro nema equations
n-m-h3-conic-03.title: Locus yepoinzi P inochinja sei kana poinzi F ichifamba?
n-m-h3-conic-03.goal: Simbisa kubva patsanangudziro kuti mukuvaka kumwechete, kuchinja nzvimbo yepoinzi F kunochinja locus kuita circle, ellipse, kana hyperbola, uye vaka tsika yekusatakura mhedziso kubva pamamiriro mamwe kuenda kune mamwe sezvayakaita.
n-m-h3-conic-03.material: Mu plane kune circle ine center O ne radius 6, nepoinzi F. Kune poinzi Q inofamba pa circle, ngatitii P i poinzi apo perpendicular bisector ye segment FQ inosangana nemutsetse OQ. Tichaongorora chimiro chinodhonzwa ne P apo Q inofamba pa circle, tichichinja nzvimbo ya F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.0: Gadzirisa kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe mamiriro achichinja
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.1: Wana locus uchishandisa huwandu nemusiyano wema distances
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.2: Cherechedza njodzi yekuwanza kubva pamamiriro chaiwo (F=O)
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.0: Matsanangudziro e ma ellipses ne ma hyperbolas (huwandu hwema distances, musiyano wema distances)
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.1: Nhaka yekuti poinzi iri pa perpendicular bisector ye segment ine distance imwechete kumagumo maviri
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu chimwe panguva imwe sezvo nzvimbo yepoinzi F ichichinja. Padanho rega rega, sarudza kutonga kunovakirwa pane zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva runooneka, dhonza mufananidzo unoratidza kwakagara poinzi P pa segment OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.1: Shandisa PF=PQ kutarisa kana huwandu kana musiyano we PO ne PF unoita nyore kuita mutengo wakagara.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Tanga ufunge mamiriro apo F i poinzi imwechete ne center O. Poinzi iri pa perpendicular bisector ye segment FQ ine distance imwechete kubva ku F ne Q, saka PF=PQ. Poinzi P iri pamutsetse OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kana Q yatenderera circle kamwe, P inodhonza chimiro chei?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana F=O, ipapo PO=PQ ne PO+PQ=OQ=6, saka PO=3. P i poinzi iri 3 kure ne O, saka inodhonza circle ine radius 3.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Circle ine center O ne radius 6
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakangodzokorora circle inodhonzwa ne Q. P haisi Q; i poinzi iri pa perpendicular bisector ye FQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Circle ine center O ne radius 3
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waona kuti P iri padistance yakagara kubva ku O.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ellipse ine O nepoinzi imwe semafoci ayo
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Hatisati tiri mumamiriro ane ma foci maviri. F ne O i poinzi imwechete.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.info: F yakatamiswa kupoinzi iri mukati me circle, 4 kure ne O. Chichiri chokwadi kuti PF=PQ. Kana ukadhonza mufananidzo, P iri pa segment OQ (pakati pe O ne Q).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Locus ye P i chii zvino?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Locus ye P i chii zvino?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Sezvo P iri pa segment OQ, PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ=6. Huwandu hwema distances kubva kumapoinzi maviri O ne F i 6 yakagara, saka i ellipse ine ma foci O ne F ne major axis yekureba 6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Chiri circle ine center O: nekuti Q iri pa circle
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kana F yabva ku O, PO haichina kugara. Wakatakura mhedziso yedanho rapfuura sezvayakaita.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Hyperbola ine musiyano wakagara wema distances kubva ku O ne F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hyperbola ine musiyano wakagara wema distances kubva ku O ne F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Hauna kutarisa kana PO ne PF zvichiwedzerwa kana kubviswa. Shandisa chokwadi chekuti P iri pa segment OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ellipse ine huwandu hwakagara hwema distances kubva ku O ne F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waona kuti huwandu hwakagara, sezvo PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Parabola ine mapoinzi akaenzana kubva ku F nemutsetse
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ma distances akaenzana i hukama pakati pe F ne Q (PF=PQ), uye i distance kupoinzi Q, kwete kumutsetse.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Panguva ino F yakatamiswa kupoinzi iri kunze kwe circle, 9 kure ne O. Kana ukadhonza mufananidzo, P haisi pa segment OQ asi pa extension yemutsetse OQ (padivi re Q kana padivi re O). Chichiri chokwadi kuti PF=PQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Pa extension kudivi re Q, PO=OQ+PQ, saka PO−PF=6, uye pa extension kudivi re O, PF−PO=6. Chero zvazvo, |PO−PF|=6 inogara iri constant, saka ihyperbola ine ma focus O ne F uye transverse axis yehurefu 6 (OF=9>6).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ellipse ine huwandu hwakatarwa, sezvinoita mu nyaya yemukati
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatakura mhedzisiro kubva munyaya yemukati sezvayakaita. Kana P isiri pa segment OQ, PO+PQ haisi OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tarisa kuti PO yakatarwa here. Kana F iri kure ne O, haina kutarwa.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Perpendicular bisector nemutsetse OQ zvinosangana pa Q yakati wandei chaizvo.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.reflect: Kana nzvimbo ye F ichichinja, kuvaka kumwe chete kwakapa denderedzwa, ellipse, uye hyperbola nenzira inotevedzana. Kutakura mhedzisiro yemukati kuenda kunze sezvayakaita hakururami. Zvichienderana nekuti poinzi P iri pa segment OQ kana pa extension yayo, zvakachinja kuti huwandu kana musiyano we PO ne PF ndiwo wakatarwa.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangura kuti nei locus ye P ichisiyana kana F iri mukati medenderedzwa nekana F iri kunze kwedenderedzwa, uchishandisa PO, PF, ne radius 6 yedenderedzwa.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.0: Taura kuti P iri papi pamutsetse OQ munyaya yemukati nemunyaya yekunze.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.1: Munyaya imwe neimwe, batanidza hukama pakati pe PO ne PQ nehurefu 6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here kuti PO+PF=6 mukati uye |PO−PF|=6 kunze?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here kuti huwandu nemusiyano zvinoparadzana nekuti nzvimbo ye P (pa segment kana pa extension) yakasiyana?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.0: Kana F iri mukati, P iri pa segment OQ, saka PO+PF=PO+PQ=6, huwandu hwakatarwa, uye iellipse. Kana F iri kunze, P iri pa extension, saka musiyano we PO ne PQ ndi6, musiyano we PO ne PF unogara uri 6, uye ihyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.1: Kana F iri mukati medenderedzwa, huwandu hwezvinhambwe kubva ku O ne F ndi6, saka iellipse, uye kana F iri kunze kwedenderedzwa, absolute value yemusiyano wezvinhambwe inogara iri 6, saka ihyperbola. Izvi ndezvekuti P iri pa segment kana pa extension zvinochinja.

n-m-h3-conic-06.topic: Conic sections: matsanangudziro nema tangent lines e parabolas, ellipses, ne hyperbolas; kuenderana pakati pezvimiro nema equations
n-m-h3-conic-06.title: Focus ne directrix zvinoenda kupi kana parabola yafambiswa?
n-m-h3-conic-06.goal: Verenga nzira ye translation zvakarurama kubva pa equation, fambisa focus ne directrix nenzira imwe chete ye translation, uye unyore tsananguro yemudzidzi mudiki.
n-m-h3-conic-06.material: Junior wako Haeun akakutumira note achiedza kutsvaga focus ne directrix ye parabola (y−1)² = −8(x+2).
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.0: Kuverenga kuti zviratidzo mu equation zvinoenderana sei nenzira yekufambisa
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.2: Kunyora zvakare tsananguro kuti ienderane nemunhu waunotsanangurira
n-m-h3-conic-06.prereq.0: Focus ne directrix ye parabola y²=4px
n-m-h3-conic-06.prereq.1: Ma translation nenzira equation inochinja nayo
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.prompt: Iyi ndiyo note yakatumirwa nejunior wako Haeun. Sarudza mutsara wekutanga unokanganisa.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga tsvaga poinzi mu equation itsva apo mativi ose maviri ari 0. Ienzanise nepakaitirwa basa iroro mu equation yekare.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.1: Paradzanisa kuti kuverenga kwemutsara mumwe nemumwe kunotevera kubva pamutsara wapfuura here kana kuti kutonga kutsva.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.0: Kune y² = −8x, 4p = −8, saka p = −2, focus ndi(−2, 0), uye directrix ndi x = 2.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.1: (y−1)² = −8(x+2) ine x+2 ne y−1, saka ndi y² = −8x yakafambiswa ne +2 munzira ye x ne −1 munzira ye y.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.2: Kufambisa focus nenzira imwe chete kunopa (−2+2, 0−1) = (0, −1).
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.3: Kufambisa directrix nenzira imwe chete kunopa x = 2+2 = 4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.4: Saka focus ndi(0, −1) uye directrix ndi x = 4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.explain: Ndiwo mutsara 2. Kuisa x+2 panzvimbo ye x kunofambisa ne −2 munzira ye x, uye kuisa y−1 panzvimbo ye y kunofambisa ne +1 munzira ye y. Zviratidzo zvakapesana. Zvose kubva pamutsara 3 zvichienda mberi kuverenga kunotevera nzira iri mumutsara 2, saka kana nzira isina kururama, zvose hazvina kururama. Mutsara 1 wakarurama.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza nzira inovimbika zvakanyanya yekutarisa kuti nzira ye translation yaHaeun yakarurama here.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti poinzi inoenderana ne vertex yekare ine maitiro api mu equation itsva yechimiro chakafambiswa.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kutanga rangarira kuti focus ne directrix zviri pa curve here.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.a: Isa focus yawakawana, (0, −1), kuti uone kuti inogutsa equation itsva (y−1)² = −8(x+2) here.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.a: Focus haisi poinzi iri pa curve, saka haidiwi kugutsa equation kana yaiswa. Saka kutarisa uku hakugoni kukuudza nzira ye translation.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.b: Enzanisa kuti coefficient −8 mu equation itsva yakafanana ne coefficient mu equation yekutanga here.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.b: Coefficient inongokuudza chimiro (nzira inovhura nehupamhi). Haikuudzi kuti nzvimbo yakafambiswa kunzira ipi.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.c: Tsvaga poinzi apo mativi ose maviri e equation itsva ari 0 uye utarise kuti ndiyo yakaendwa ne vertex yekare (0, 0) here.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.d: Dhirowa graph nenzira pfupi uye utarise kuti nzira inovhura yakafanana neyekare here.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.d: Translation haichinji nzira inovhura, saka inoita sekuti yakafanana kunyangwe nzira ye translation isina kururama.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.explain: Vertex yaiva poinzi (0, 0) apo mativi ose maviri e equation yekare aiva 0, saka poinzi (−2, 1) apo mativi ose maviri e equation itsva ari 0 ndipo pakaenda vertex. Saka translation ndi −2 munzira ye x-axis ne +1 munzira ye y-axis. Focus ne directrix hazvisi mapoinzi ari pa curve, saka haugoni kuzvitarisa nekuisa mu equation.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.prompt: Haeun mudzidzi wegore rekutanga rechikoro chepamusoro akangodzidza ma translation. Nyora mhinduro yekutumira kuna Haeun. Inofanira kusanganisira pakanganisa, nzira yakarurama ye translation, focus ne directrix zvakarurama, uye nzira yekutarisa.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza kurongeka kwemhinduro: pakanganisa, translation yakagadziriswa, focus ne directrix, nzira yekutarisa.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.1: Uchishandisa translation yakagadziriswa, fambisa vertex, focus, ne directrix ye equation yekutanga.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakacherekedza here pakanganisa nemashoko anonzwisiswa naHaeun?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaratidza here kuti focus ne directrix zvakafambiswa sei kubva panzvimbo dzazvo dzekare?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.0: Haeun, nzira yakapesana pamutsara 2. Kana x+2 ikaiswa panzvimbo ye x, graph inofambiswa ne −2 munzira ye x, uye ne y−1 inofambiswa ne +1 munzira ye y. Poinzi mu equation itsva apo mativi ose maviri ari 0 ndi(−2, 1), saka unogona kuziva kuti vertex yakaenda kubva ku (0, 0) kuenda ikoko. Saka focus (−2, 0) inoenda ku (−4, 1), uye directrix x=2 inoenda ku x=0.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.1: Haeun, nzira ye translation pamutsara 2 haina kururama. (x+2) inofambisa 2 kuruboshwe, uye (y−1) inofambisa 1 kumusoro. Unogona kutarisa nekuisa kuti vertex ndi(−2, 1). Saka focus ndi(−4, 1) uye directrix ndi x = 0.

n-m-h3-diffc-01.title: Tinofanira kuverenga sei slope ine denominator ye 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.topic: Differentiation: implicit differentiation nematangent papoindi apo slope isina kutsanangurwa
n-m-h3-diffc-01.goal: Ongorora kana tangent iripo papoindi apo denominator yeslope inowanikwa nekuimplicit differentiation iri 0, uye utsvage uye ugadzirise mhedziso yakanganisa mumhinduro.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.material: Iyi ndiyo mhinduro yaHayoon yekutsvaga tangent papoindi P(2, −1) pakakombama C: x²+xy+y²=3. (x² ne y² zvinoreva x squared ne y squared. Kuti poindi P iri pa C kwakatariswa ne 4−2+1=3.)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.1: Dudzira tangent apo slope isina kutsanangurwa sechimiro chegirafu
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.0: Implicit differentiation (tora y sebasa re x uye ugadzire mativi ese maviri nokuenderana ne x)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.1: Kutsvaga equation yetangent papoindi iri pakakombama
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga wakanganisa mumhinduro yaHayoon.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mutsetse wega wega kubva kumusoro uye utarise nekuverenga zvakananga kana ichitevera kubva pamutsetse uri pamberi payo.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana mhedziso iri mumutsetse wekupedzisira ichitaura chinhu chimwe chete nechokwadi chakawanikwa mumutsetse wekare (chii chisina kutsanangurwa).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.0: Kugadzira mativi ese maviri nokuenderana ne x kunopa 2x + (y + x·y′) + 2y·y′ = 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.1: Kugadzirisa kwe y′ kunopa y′ = −(2x + y)/(x + 2y).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.2: Kutsiva P(2, −1), denominator x+2y ndi 2+2·(−1)=0, saka slope haina kutsanangurwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.3: Saka hapana tangent iripo papoindi P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 4 wakanganisa. Kuverenga komumitsetse 1 kusvika ku 3 kwakarurama. Asi "chirevo cheslope hachina kutsanangurwa" zvinoreva "hapana nhamba inonzi slope," kwete kuti hapana tangent. Numerator 2x+y=3 haisi 0, saka slope inogona kukura isina muganho, kureva, tangent yakaenderana ne y-axis inogona kuitika.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.prompt: Kana pane tangent kukakombama C papoindi P, nyora equation yayo, uye unyore chikonzero chawakatonga nacho.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga kuti numerator inotora kukosha kupi apo denominator iri 0, uye funga kuti slope inova huru zvakadini.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dhonza kuti mutsetse une slope inokura isina muganho unoratidzika sei pa coordinate plane, uye unyore equation yemutsetse iwoyo unopfuura napoindi P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kuti denominator iri 0 asi numerator isiri 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsiva here x=2 muequation yekakombama uye ukatarisa kuti kakombama nemutsetse zvinosangana sei?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutaura here musiyano pakati pe "hapana slope" ne "hapana tangent"?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.0: Denominator ndi 0 uye numerator ndi 3, saka slope inokura isina muganho. Saka tangent ndiyo mutsetse x=2, wakaenderana ne y-axis. Kutsiva x=2 mukakombama kunopa y²+2y+1=0, saka y=−1 ndiyo mhinduro yega, zvichireva kuti mutsetse unongobata kakombama papoindi P, izvo zvinowirirana zvakare.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.1: Pane tangent. Slope haina kutsanangurwa nokuti tangent yakamira, uye equation yayo ndi x=2. Ndakatarisawo kuti numerator 2x+y ndi 3, isiri 0, saka haisi chimiro che 0/0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Zvinokwana kutarisa numerator, kunyange pasina kushandisa nzira yekutsiva x=2 mukakombama.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.prompt: Unofanira kutarisa chii usati wapedza kuti "pane tangent yakamira" papoindi apo denominator yechirevo cheslope iri 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.0: Muchimiro y′ = (numerator)/(denominator), enzanisa kuti fraction inoratidzika sei zvakasiyana kana denominator iri 0 uye kukosha kwenumerator kwakasiyana.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Zvimiro 0/0 ne 3/0 mamiriro akafanana here? Funga kuti rimwe nerimwe rinoti chii.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.a: Kuti, kana denominator iri 0, numerator isiri 0 zvakare (kureva, kuti haisi chimiro che 0/0)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.b: Kuti kukosha kwe y hakusi kusina kunaka kana poindi iri pakakombama
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.b: Chiratidzo che y hachina chekuita nokuti tangent iripo here. Unogona kunge wakavhiringidza chiratidzo che coordinate nenzira yetangent.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.c: Kuti kukosha kwe y″ yakagadzirwa kaviri hakusi 0
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.c: Second derivative inongotaura nzira iyo kakombama kanokombama; haisarudze kana tangent iripo.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.d: Kuti kakombama kanogona kunyorwa mufomu y = (chirevo che x)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.d: Tangent iripo kunyange implicit function isingagoni kunyorwa mufomu y=f(x). Mamiriro aya haadikanwi.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.explain: Kunyange denominator iri 0, kana numerator isiri 0, slope inokura isina muganho uye tangent yakamira inoonekwa. Kana numerator iri 0 zvakare, ndechimiro che 0/0, saka chirevo ichi oga hachigoni kusarudza, uye unofanira kutarisa chimiro chekakombama papoindi iyoyo nenzira imwe.

n-m-h3-diffc-02.title: Panguva apo velocity iri 0, poindi inotendeuka here?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.topic: Differentiation: velocity ne acceleration, mamiriro ekushandura nzira
n-m-h3-diffc-02.goal: Nzwisisa, kuburikidza neshanduko yechiratidzo chevelocity, musiyano pakati penguva apo velocity iri 0 nenguva apo nzira yekufamba inoshanduka, uye gadzira nekutarisa iwe pachako zvirevo zvevelocity zvinosangana nemamiriro.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.material: Velocity yepoindi P inofamba pamutsetse wenhamba panguva t (t≥0) ndi v(t), uye v(1)=0. Minsu akati, "Panguva apo velocity iri 0, poindi inoshandura nzira zvechokwadi." (Kushandura nzira kunoreva kubva pakufamba kurudyi kuenda pakufamba kuruboshwe, kana kubva pakufamba kuruboshwe kuenda kurudyi. Kana velocity yakanaka, inofamba kurudyi; kana isina kunaka, kuruboshwe.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.1: Gadzira uye tarisa zvirevo zvevelocity zvinosangana nemamiriro
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.2: Rongera zvinogona kutongwa kubva pamakosha evelocity ne acceleration oga
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.0: Hukama pakati penzvimbo, velocity, ne acceleration (velocity iderivative yenzvimbo, acceleration iderivative yevelocity)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pechiratidzo chevelocity nenzira yekufamba
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza chirevo chinoreva chinhu chimwe chete ne "poindi P inoshandura nzira panguva t₀."
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti poindi inofamba nenzira ipi kana velocity yakanaka uye kana isina kunaka.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti chiratidzo chevelocity chinofanira kuitei kuti nzira ishanduke, uye uenzanise nenyaya apo inova 0 wobva wadzoka kuchiratidzo chimwe chete.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.a: Kunyange acceleration isiri 0, kana velocity isiri 0, nzira inoramba yakafanana. Unogona kunge wakavhiringidza velocity ne acceleration.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.b: Nzvimbo pa t₀ yakakura kupfuura nzvimbo dzenguva dzese dziri pamberi nepashure pazvo
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvinofunga nguva apo nzvimbo yakakura zvikuru (magumo ekurudyi) chete. Zvinosiya nyaya yekudzoka kumagumo ekuruboshwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.c: v(t₀)=0 chimwe chinhu chete chenguva yekushandura nzira, kwete chirevo chimwe chete. Funga nyaya apo v=0 asi chiratidzo chinoramba chakafanana.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.d: Zviratidzo zvevelocity pamberi napashure pa t₀ zvakasiyana
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.d: Wakaona kushanduka kwenzira kuburikidza neshanduko yechiratidzo chevelocity.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.explain: Nzira inoshanduka kana chiratidzo chevelocity chichishanduka kubva pakunaka kuenda kusina kunaka kana kubva pakusina kunaka kuenda kunaka. Velocity kuva 0 mamiriro anodikanwa anoitika panguva apo chiratidzo chinoshanduka, asi haikwani.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.prompt: Kana velocity ichipiwa ne v(t)=(t−1)^m (t−p)^n, nyora matatu matatu akasiyana (m, n, p) anosangana nezvose zvinotevera: poindi P haishandure nzira pa t=1, uye inoshandura nzira pa t=p. (m ne n ndi nhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 6, uye p inhamba yechisikigo kubva pa 2 kusvika pa 9.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Edza makosha akati wandei e m ne n uye ugadzire tafura yezviratidzo zve (t−1)^m ne (t−p)^n pamberi napashure pa t=1 ne t=p.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.1: Patsanura kuva nyaya apo exponent yakaenzana neapo isina kuenzana, uye uenzanise kana chiratidzo chakafanana kana chakasiyana pamberi napashure pepoindi iyoyo.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: m, n, ne p ndi nhamba dzechisikigo mukati mehuwandu.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Chiratidzo chevelocity chakafanana pamberi napashure pa t=1.

n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Chiratidzo chevelocity chakafanana pamberi napashure pa t=p, saka poindi haishandure nzira.

Zvimwe zvinhu hazvishandure chiratidzo padyo nepoindi iyoyo (p≥2). Kune (1, 1, 3), chiratidzo chinoshanduka pa t=1 zvakare, uye kune (2, 2, 3), hachishanduki pa t=3.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza umwe wemienzaniso yawakawana uye unyore kuti sei poindi isingashandure nzira pa t=1 kunyange v(1)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora v(t) neye (m, n, p) yawakasarudza, uye uenzanise zviratidzo kana ukaisa kukosha kuri pasi zvishoma pa 1 nekukosha kukuru zvishoma pa 1.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Batanidza kana (t−1)^m yakanaka kana isina kunaka pamberi napashure pa t=1 nekuti m haina kuenzana kana yakaenzana.

n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakaenzanisa here nenyaya apo exponent isina kuenzana?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Ndakasarudza (2, 1, 3). Mu v=(t−1)²(t−3), (t−1)² ndi 0 kana kupfuura kumativi ese e t=1, saka chiratidzo chayo hachishanduki, uye (t−3) inoramba isina kunaka. Saka v ndi 0 pa t=1 asi chiratidzo chayo chinoramba chakafanana, saka nzira haishanduki.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Exponent m yakaenzana, saka (t−1)^m haidzikiri pasi pe 0 kana t ichipfuura 1. Velocity inobata 0 ichidzoka nechiratidzo chimwe chete, saka nzira inoramba yakafanana.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Inosanganisira zvese exponent yakaenzana nechokwadi chokuti chiratidzo hachishanduki.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.prompt: Kana velocity v iri basa rinogona kudifferentiatwa uye acceleration ndi a(t)=v′(t), sarudza zvirevo zvese zvakarurama.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.hint.0: Gadzira iwe pachako zvirevo zvevelocity zvakareruka, sa v=(t−1)² ne v=(t−1)³, verenga v′(1) kune rimwe nerimwe, uye uenzanise nekuti nzira inoshanduka here.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kune chirevo chega chega, tsvaga muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa kutarisa kana chichishanda "nguva dzose."

n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.a: Wakafunga kuti kana acceleration isiri 0, girafu revelocity rinopfuura napa 0 uye chiratidzo chinoshanduka.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.b: Kana v(t₀)=0 uye a(t₀)=0, poindi haishandure nzira pa t₀
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.b: Kunyange a(t₀)=0, munyaya dzakadai sa v=(t−1)³ nzira inoshanduka. Wakashaya kuti kana acceleration iri 0, izvi oga hazvigoni kusarudza.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.c: Kana v(t₀)=0 uye a(t₀)=0, poindi inoshandura nzira pa t₀ zvechokwadi
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.c: Kunyange a(t₀)=0, munyaya dzakadai sa v=(t−1)² nzira inoramba yakafanana.
