n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.d: Wakafunga kuti kuti nzira ishanduke, velocity inofanira kushanduka kuramba ichiita zvakanaka uye ichipfuura napa 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.explain: Kana v(t₀)=0 uye v′(t₀)=a(t₀)≠0, saka v inopfuura napa 0 uye inoshandura chiratidzo. Zvakapesana, kana a(t₀)=0, chiratidzo chingasashanduka, sa (t−1)², kana chinoshanduka, sa (t−1)³, saka unofanira kutarisa chiratidzo chevelocity zvakananga. Kuti nzira ishanduke, v inoenderera inofanira kushandura chiratidzo, saka v=0 panguva iyoyo.

n-m-h3-diffc-03.title: Tinogona kuwana slope yebasa rakabatanidzwa kubva pamakosha ari patafura here?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.topic: Differentiation: derivative yebasa rakabatanidzwa netafura yekukosha kwemabasa nekwema derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-03.goal: Kana uchiwana derivative yebasa rakabatanidzwa, sarudza kuti derivative yebasa rekunze inofanira kuverengwa papoindi ipi, uye rongera zvinogona kuwanikwa kubva pamakosha ari patafura oga.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.material:
Makosha emabasa maviri anogona kudifferentiatwa f ne g ari sepatafura pazasi. Makosha asiri patafura haazivikanwi. (f∘g)(x) zvinoreva f(g(x)), uye (g∘f)(x) zvinoreva g(f(x)).
 x=1: f(1)=3, f′(1)=4, g(1)=2, g′(1)=−3
 x=2: f(2)=5, f′(2)=7, g(2)=1, g′(2)=6
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora derivative yebasa rakabatanidzwa f(g(x)) sechibereko chechikamu chekunze nechemukati, uye utarise kuti chikamu chekunze chinotora kukosha kupi sekupinza kwacho.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Shandisa chokwadi chokuti kana x=1, mhedzisiro yekuisa 1 mu g inova kupinza kwe f kuti usarudze kuti ndezvipi zvikamu zvekuverenga kubva patafura.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.a: Wakaverenga slope ye f pa x=1. Basa rekunze f rinofanira kushandisa slope yaro pakukosha kwebasa remukati, g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.b: Wakaverenga derivative yebasa rekunze pakukosha kwebasa remukati, g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.c: g(1) inodiwa kusarudza kuti function yekunze inodifferentiatewa papoinzi ipi.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga nezvechikamu apo derivative yefunction yemukati inowanzwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.e: g′(2) i slope pa x=2, saka haishandiswi mukukosha kuri kuwanikwa pa x=1.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.f: Kukosha kwefunction f(2) ihurefu, kwete slope, saka hakushandiswi mukuverenga derivative.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.explain: (f∘g)′(1)=f′(g(1))·g′(1). Sezvo g(1)=2, verenga f′(2)=7 uye uwanze ne g′(1)=−3 kuti uwane −21. Poinzi huru ndeyekushandisa f′(g(1)), kwete f′(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.acc.0: g(1)=2 ndiko kukosha kunoshandiswa kusarudza kuti verenga f′ papoinzi ipi, saka hairatidzwi zvakananga mukuwanza, asi kuwanza f′(2) ne g′(1) chete kuverenga kumwe chete.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza makoshero ose anosarudzwa nemakoshero ari mutebhura oga.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kune composite function imwe neimwe, tanga wawana uye wanyora kukosha kwefunction yemukati.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana derivative yefunction yekunze pa input iyoyo iri mutebhura.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.a: Tinoda slope g′(3) pa g(f(1))=g(3), asi haisi mutebhura. Kushandisa g′(1) kubva mutebhura kunoshandisa poinzi yeinput yakasiyana.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.b: Slope f′(2) pa input g(1)=2 yefunction yekunze iri mutebhura.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.c: Tinoda slope g′(5) pa g(f(2))=g(5), asi haisi mutebhura.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.d: Slope f′(1) pa input g(2)=1 yefunction yekunze iri mutebhura.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.explain: Derivative yecomposite function inogona kuwanikwa chete kana tebhura ine slope yefunction yekunze yakaverengwa pakukosha kwefunction yemukati. Kune (f∘g)′, makoshero e g, 2 ne1, ose ari makoshero e x mutebhura, saka zvinogoneka, uye kune (g∘f)′, makoshero e f, 3 ne5, ari makoshero e x asiri mutebhura.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.prompt: Wana kukosha kwe (f∘g)′(2). Nyorawo kuti nei kuverenga f′(2)·g′(2)=42 kwakaipa.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga waverenga kukosha kwe g(2) kubva mutebhura uye usarudze kuti function yekunze inodifferentiatewa papoinzi ipi.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.1: Mukuverenga kwakapa 42, fananidza poinzi iyo wakaverenga derivative ye f nekukosha kunopinda chaizvo mu f.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatanga wawana g(2) ukasarudza poinzi yekuverenga kubva pafunction yekunze here?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti slope yepoinzi ipi yakasanganiswa mukukosha 42 here?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.0: g(2)=1, saka f′ inofanira kuverengwa pa1, zvichipa (f∘g)′(2)=f′(1)·g′(2)=4×6=24. f′(2)·g′(2) inoverenga slope ye f pa x=2, asi kukosha kunopinda mu f hakusi 2 asi g(2)=1, saka kwakaipa.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.1: Derivative yecomposite function i f′(g(2))g′(2). Sezvo g(2)=1, f′(1)=4 ne g′(2)=6, uye product i24. 42 yakaipa nokuti yakashandisa f′(2)=7.

n-m-h3-dist-01.title: Kutarisa gadziriso yaGayoung ye variance
n-m-h3-dist-01.topic: Probability distributions: expected value ne variance ye discrete random variable
n-m-h3-dist-01.goal: Wana mutsetse wekutanga unokanganisa mugadziriso ye variance, wana mutengo wakarurama, uye utarise kana mhedzisiro ichiita musoro.
n-m-h3-dist-01.material: Random variable X inotora mitengo 0, 1, 2, 3 nemikana 0.1, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2 nenhevedzano. Gayoung akagadzirisa sezvakaratidzwa pazasi kuwana variance V(X). (E(X²) i "expected value ye X square," uye {E(X)}² i "square ye expected value.")
n-m-h3-dist-01.thinking.0: Tevera mitsetse yegadziriso rimwe nerimwe uye uwane mutsetse usina kururama
n-m-h3-dist-01.thinking.1: Tarisa kana mhedzisiro ichienderana nechimiro che distribution
n-m-h3-dist-01.prereq.0: Expected value E(X) ye discrete random variable
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yaGayoung.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa nenhevedzano kubva kumusoro kana mutsetse mumwe nemumwe unotevera zvakarurama kubva pamutsetse wakamberi pakarepo.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora matsanangudziro e E(X) ne E(X²) mumashoko, uye uenzanise kana mutsetse mumwe nemumwe wakaverengwa maererano netsanangudziro idzodzo.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.line.2: E(X²) i E(X) yakaitwa square chete, saka E(X²)=1.6²=2.56
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 hauna kururama. E(X²) haisi "square ye expected value"; i mutengo unowanikwa nekutanga waita mitengo ye X imwe neimwe square, wobva wawanza nemikana uye wawedzera. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 inoenderera kubva pamhedzisiro yemutsetse 3, saka kuverenga uko pachako kwakarurama, asi mhedziso haina kururama.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mutsetse usina kururama uye uwane mitengo ye E(X²) ne V(X). Nyorawo mumutsara mumwe nei mhedzisiro yaGayoung V(X)=0 isina zvainoreva kune distribution iyi.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ita mitengo 0, 1, 2, 3 ye X imwe neimwe square uye uiwanze nemikana imwechete.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isa mumashoko zvinoreva variance ye 0 nezve mitengo ye X.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso E(X²) i ... uye V(X) i ...
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga E(X²) zvakananga uchishandisa square yemutengo wega wega here?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Unogona kutaura kuti E(X²) ne {E(X)}² i nhamba dzakasiyana here?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutaura kuti variance ye 0 inogoneka kune rudzi rupi rwe distribution here?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.0: E(X²)=0²×0.1+1²×0.4+2²×0.3+3²×0.2=0.4+1.2+1.8=3.4. V(X)=3.4−1.6²=3.4−2.56=0.84, uye sezvo X ichitora mitengo yakasiyana 0, 1, 2, 3, variance haigone kuva 0.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.1: Unofanira kuita mutengo wega wega square, kuuwanza nemukana, uye kuwedzera, saka E(X²)=3.4 (=17/5) uye V(X)=0.84. Variance ye 0 yaizoreva kuti X inogara ichitora mutengo mumwe chete, asi hazvisi izvozvo pano.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.2: E(X²)=3.4 uye variance i 0.84. Variance ye 0 inoreva kuti mitengo yose yakafanana, izvo zvisiri izvo pano.

n-m-h3-dist-02.title: Tinogona kudaidza binomial distribution riini kana tichidhonza mabhora matatu?
n-m-h3-dist-02.topic: Probability distributions: mamiriro ekuti binomial distribution ishande
n-m-h3-dist-02.goal: Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa chaizvo kutonga kana inogona kutorwa se binomial distribution, uye uratidze nenhamba kuti mukana unochinja sei kana ruzivo urwu rwuchichinja.
n-m-h3-dist-02.material: Bhokisi rine mabhora machena 3 nemabhora matema 2. Seoyun akati, "Huwandu X hwemabhora machena kana mabhora 3 adhonzwa hunotevera binomial distribution B(3, 3/5)." Kana Seoyun akarurama haigone kuzivikanwa kubva pane zvakanyorwa kusvika zvino.
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.0: Siyanisa ruzivo rwakakosha pakutonga neruzivo rusiri rwakakosha
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.1: Tarisa nekuverenga musiyano unoitika kana mamiriro aputsika
n-m-h3-dist-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva binomial distribution B(n,p): ita kuedza n kwakazvimirira, rimwe nerimwe rine mukana wakafanana wekubudirira p
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.prompt: Unofanira kuziva chii kutonga kana Seoyun akarurama?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga warangarira kuti kuedza kunofanira kuva nenhaka dzipi kuti ushandise binomial distribution.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza rimwe nerimwe kana sarudzo imwe neimwe ichitarisa nhaka iyoyo, kana kungobvunza nezvechinhu chatoziviswa.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.a: Verenga zvakare kutarisa kuti bhokisi rine mabhora machena 3 nemabhora matema 2 chaizvo
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.a: Huwandu hwemabhora hwatopiwa. Hunoshandiswa kuwana mukana 3/5, asi hahutiudze kana mukana mumwechete unochengetwa nguva dzose.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.b: Tarisa kana kudhonza mabhora 3 i huwandu hwakakwana hwekuedza
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.b: Binomial distribution haishandi nekuti huwandu hwekuedza hwakakura. Kunyange hwakadzika, sa n=3, i binomial distribution kana mamiriro agutswa.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.c: Tarisa kana bhora rega rega rakadhonzwa rinodzoserwa mubhokisi risati radhonzwa bhora rinotevera
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.c: Uri kutarisa kuti zviri mukati mebhokisi zvinoramba zvakadaro nguva imwe neimwe here. Ndiro mamiriro akakosha e binomial distribution.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.d: Tarisa kuti kurongeka kwekubuda kwema bhora machena kwakatarwa kare here
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.d: Kurongeka hakukoshi pa distribution yehuwandu X yema bhora machena. Chinosarudza kuti ibinomial distribution here ndechekuti kuedza kunokanganisana here.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.explain: Kune B(3, 3/5), probability yebhora jena inofanira kuva 3/5 nguva imwe neimwe bhora rinodhonzwa, pasina kukanganisana pakati pekudhonza. Kana bhora rimwe nerimwe rakadhonzwa rikadzoserwa, izvozvo zvinoshanda, asi kana risingadzoserwi, mhedzisiro dzekare dzinochinja probability dzinotevera. Huwandu hwema bhora hwatozivikanwa, uye huwandu hwekuedza hahuna kudikanwa kuva hukuru.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira kuti ma bhora 3 anodhonzwa pasina kuadzoserwa. Kana bhora rekutanga raiva jena, tsvaga probability yekuti bhora rechipiri ijena, uye uishandise kunyora kuti nei X isingagoni kuva B(3, 3/5) munyaya iyi.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora huwandu hwema bhora asara mubhokisi nehwema bhora machena mushure mekudhonzwa kwebhora rekutanga.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.hint.1: Isa probability iyoyo padivi pe probability yekudhonza kwekutanga uye uzviwenzanise.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso. Kana bhora rekutanga rakachena, ma bhora asara ari ...
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here huwandu hwema bhora asara (4) nema bhora machena (2) iwe pachako?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Unogona kutaura here kuti probability inochinja inobatana sei ne "haina kuzvimirira"?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutsanangura here zvinoitika kana ma bhora adzoserwa?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.0: Kana bhora rekutanga rakachena, ma bhora asara ndima 2 machena pa4, saka probability ndi2/4=1/2. Inosiyana ne3/5 yekutanga, saka mamiriro ekuti probability yakafanana nguva imwe neimwe anoputsika, uye haisi B(3, 3/5).
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.1: Kana ma bhora asingadzoserwi, mhedzisiro yekudhonza kwekare inochinja probability inotevera. Kana bhora jena radhonzwa kutanga, probability yekuti rinotevera rijena ndi2 pa4 (0.5), iyo inosiyana ne3/5, saka kuedza hakuzvimiriri uye hakugoni kuva binomial distribution.

n-m-h3-dist-03.title: Mitambo miviri ine mean imwe chete: kupararira kwakafanana here?
n-m-h3-dist-03.topic: Ma probability distribution: variance yehuwandu nema multiple e random variable
n-m-h3-dist-03.goal: Tonga nekuenzanisa ma distribution zvakananga kuti mean imwe chete inoreva kupararira kwakafanana here, uye utsanangure chikonzero uchishandisa variance.
n-m-h3-dist-03.material: Ngatitii X ndiyo nhamba inoratidzwa kana die yakajairika ine mativi matanhatu yakakandwa. Pane mitambo miviri. Mu Game A, unokanda die kamwe chete uye score yako ndi kaviri nhamba inoratidzwa (2X), uye mu Game B, unokanda die kaviri uye score yako ndihuwandu hwenhamba mbiri (X₁+X₂). Mumitambo yose miviri mean score ndi7 mapoinzi. Youngsu akati, "Sezvo ma mean akafanana, kupararira kwema score kunofanirawo kufanana."
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.1: Vaka umbowo hwemuenzaniso unopikisa uchishandisa ma probability chaiwo
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.2: Ita generalization uchishandisa mitemo yekuti variance inochinja sei
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.0: Expected value ne variance ye discrete random variable
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.1: Variance yehuwandu hwema random variable maviri anozvimiririra V(X+Y)=V(X)+V(Y)
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.prompt: Kuenzanisa kupi kunokodzera zvakanyanya kuyedza chirevo chaYoungsu?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.0: Chirevo chaYoungsu chiri nezve "kupararira," kwete mean. Data ipi yaizochiratidza?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.1: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, funga kuti ingagona kuratidza musiyano pakati pemitambo miviri here.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.a: Verenga zvakare kuti utarise kuti ma mean emitambo miviri akaenzana chaizvo, 7 mapoinzi
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.a: Zvatopiwa kuti ma mean akaenzana. Kutarisa kukosha kumwe chete zvakare hakuzokuudza nezvekupararira.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.b: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti mean yekukanda die kamwe chete ndi3.5 kuenzanisa mitambo miviri
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvinongokuudza kuti mean ye7 mapoinzi mumitambo yose miviri inobva pakukosha uku. Hazvioneswi kupararira.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.c: Isa padivi pemumwe ma score anogoneka mumitambo miviri nemaprobability e score imwe neimwe
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.c: Uri kuenzanisa distribution yose yema score. Iyi inzira yekuona zvakananga kuti chimiro che distribution chinogona kusiyana kunyangwe ma mean akaenzana.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.d: Kanda die kakawanda uye utarise kuti ma average score emitambo miviri anosvika padhuze ne7 mapoinzi here
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.d: Inoratidza kuti average inounganidzwa padhuze ne7 here, asi haikuudzi chinhu nezvekupararira.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.explain: Mean imwe chete pfupiso ye distribution. Kana ukaisa ma score nema probability padivi pemumwe, unogona kuona pakarepo kuti chimiro che distribution chinogona kusiyana kunyangwe mean yakafanana. Kuverenga mean zvakare kana kungotarisa kuti inounganidzwa padhuze ne mean hakugoni kuyedza chirevo chaYoungsu.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga probability yekuti score ndi2 kana 12 mumutambo mumwe nemumwe (probability yakabatanidzwa yenyaya mbiri), uye utsanangure kuti chirevo chaYoungsu hachina kururama.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora kuti nhamba dzipi dze die dzinopa mapoinzi 2 nemapoinzi 12 mu Game A.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.1: Mu Game B, verenga mapeya ose akarongwa enhamba mbiri anopa mapoinzi 2 nemapoinzi 12, uye utsvage kuti ndeemhedzisiro 36 mingani.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso. Mu Game A, kuwana mapoinzi 2 ...
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here nzira dzekuwana mapoinzi 2 nemapoinzi 12 mu Game B semapeya akarongwa iwe pachako?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Unogona kutaura here kuti chimiro che distribution chinogona kusiyana kunyangwe ma mean akaenzana?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutaura here kuti musiyano pakati pema probability maviri unoratidza sei musiyano wekupararira?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.0: Mu Game A, kukanda 1 kana 6 kunopa mapoinzi 2 kana 12, saka ndi2/6=1/3. Mu Game B, pane mhedzisiro mbiri chete, (1,1) ne (6,6), saka ndi2/36=1/18. Nemean imwe chete, ma probability e ma score akanyanya anosiyana zvikuru, saka kupararira hakugoni kunzi kwakafanana.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.1: Probability yekuwana mapoinzi 2 kana 12 ndi chitatu chimwe mu A ne gumi neshanu nechitatu mu B (1/18). Kunyangwe mean iri 7 mumitambo yose miviri, A inopa ma score akanyanya kakawanda zvikuru, saka ma variance akasiyana.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.prompt: Ngatitii V ndiyo variance yenhamba X inoratidzwa nekukanda die kamwe. Ma variance e score ye Game A 2X ne score ye Game B X₁+X₂ (kukanda kuviri hakukanganisani) ndeapi?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.0: 2X ichimwe mhedzisiro yakaitwa kaviri, uye X₁+X₂ mhedzisiro mbiri dzakasiyana dzakawedzerwa. Funga zvaviri izvi zvakaparadzana.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.1: Isa nhamba nyore pa V (semuenzaniso V=1), tsvaga ma variance maviri pasarudzo imwe neimwe, uye uenzanise kuti anowirirana nekupararira kwemitambo miviri yawakaona muhanho yapfuura here.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.a: Variance ye 2X ndi2V, uye variance ye X₁+X₂ ndi2V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.a: Wakatora 2X sekunge "X yakawedzerwa kaviri." Kuwedzera kukosha kumwe chete kaviri kwakasiyana nekuwedzera mhedzisiro yekukanda kuviri kwakaparadzana.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.b: Variance ye 2X ndi4V, uye variance ye X₁+X₂ ndi2V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.b: Kune 2X, kukosha kwose kunoitwa kaviri, saka variance inova 2² nguva yakakura; kune huwandu hwemhedzisiro mbiri dzinozvimiririra, ma variance anowedzerwa, saka inova 2 nguva yakakura.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.c: Variance ye 2X ndi4V, uye variance ye X₁+X₂ ndi4V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.c: Wakashandisa mutemo wekuti kuwedzera ne constant kunoita square factor mu variance kuhuwandu hwekukanda kuviri zvakare. Kune huwandu hunozvimiririra, ma variance anongowedzerwa.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.d: Variance ye 2X ndi2V, uye variance ye X₁+X₂ ndi4V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.d: Wakachinjanisa variance ye multiple ne variance yehuwandu.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.explain: V(2X)=2²V=4V, uye kuhuwandu hwema random variable maviri anozvimiririra, V(X₁+X₂)=V+V=2V. Ma mean ose ndi7, asi ma variance akasiyana: 4V ne2V. (Variance yekukanda die ndi V=35/12, saka ndi35/3 ne35/6.)

n-m-h3-dist-04.title: Expected value ndiko kukosha kunouya kakawanda zvikuru here?
n-m-h3-dist-04.topic: Ma probability distribution: zvinoreva expected value
n-m-h3-dist-04.goal: Ronga definition nezvinoreva expected value, uye ugadzire nekutarisa distribution apo expected value isiri kukosha kunogoneka uye isiri kukosha kune probability huru zvikuru.
n-m-h3-dist-04.material: Pane random variable X inotora makosha 0, 1, 2. Kana wasarudza ma probability emakosha matatu mutafura ye probability distribution, expected value E(X) inotarwa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.0: Ronga zvirevo nezve expected value kuita zvechokwadi nezvenhema
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.1: Gadzira distribution inosangana nemamiriro uye uishandise semuenzaniso unopikisa
n-m-h3-dist-04.prereq.0: Tafura ye probability distribution ye discrete random variable
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvirevo zvose zvakarurama nezve expected value E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.0: Pachirevo chimwe nechimwe, funga kuti unogona kuchiyedza nekugadzira tafura ye probability distribution here.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kutanga edza ne distribution nyore apo makosha ari 0 ne1 chete uye ma probability maviri akaenzana.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.a: E(X) imwe yemakosha anogona kutorwa ne X
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.a: Kunyangwe X ichigona kutora makosha e integer chete, E(X) inogona kuva decimal. Semuenzaniso, mean yehuwandu hwemisoro mukukanda coin inogona kuva kukosha kunge 0.5.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.b: E(X) ihuwandu hwekukosha kwega kwega kwakawedzerwa ne probability yako.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.c: E(X) ndiko kukosha kwe X kune probability huru zvikuru.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakatora expected value ne "kukosha kune probability huru zvikuru" sechinhu chimwe chete. Kukosha kunogoneka zvakanyanya pfungwa yakasiyana, uye zviviri izvi zvinowanzo siyana.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.d: Kana kuedza kukadzokororwa kakawanda, mean yemakosha akaonekwa inounganidzwa padhuze ne E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.d: Wakatsanangura zvakarurama pamunogadzikana mean kana kuedza kuchidzokororwa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.explain: E(X) ihuwandu hwekukosha × probability, uye ndiko kukosha kunogadzikana mean kana kuedza kuchidzokororwa kakawanda. Hapana chivimbiso chekuti ndiko kukosha kunogona kutorwa ne X chaizvo, uye hapana chivimbiso chekuti ndiko kukosha kune probability huru zvikuru.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.prompt: Ngatitii X inotora makosha 0, 1, 2. Sarudza ma probability avo samapesenti enhamba dzakazara (p0, p1, p2). Mamiriro: ① imwe neimwe yema probability matatu ndi1% kana kupfuura uye anowedzera kusvika ku100% ② kukosha kune probability huru zvikuru ndi2 oga ③ E(X)≤1.2 (expected value ndi0.8 kana kupfuura pasi pe2, kukosha kunogoneka zvakanyanya). Gadzira mienzaniso 3 yakasiyana (ine makosha akasiyana e p2).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga sarudza p0, p1, p2 zvekuti zvinowedzera kusvika ku100, uye ita p2 ive huru zvikuru.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100 uye utarise kuti ndi1.2 zvakanyanya here. Kana yakakura zvikuru, edza kuwedzera p0 kana p1.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.2: Chinja p2 kuita makosha akasiyana senge 45 ne39, uye usarudze p0 ne p1 zvakare nguva imwe neimwe.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Ma probability ndenhamba dzakazara dze1% kana kupfuura uye anowedzera kusvika ku100%.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ma probability matatu anofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara dze1% kana kupfuura uye anofanira kuwedzera kusvika ku100.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Kukosha kwe2 chete ndiko kune probability huru zvikuru.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c2: P(X=2) inofanira kuva huru kupfuura imwe neimwe yema probability maviri akasara (haifaniri kuenzana nechero imwe).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.explain: E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100. Semuenzaniso, kune (40, 15, 45), E(X)=1.05, uye kukosha kune probability huru zvikuru ndi2. E(X)=1.05 haisi kukosha kunogona kutorwa ne X, uye inosiyanawo ne2, kukosha kune probability huru zvikuru. Mienzaniso inongochinjanisa kurongeka kwe (p0, p1, p2) haifaniri kuverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza umwe wemienzaniso yako uye, uchishandisa nhamba dzawo, utsanangure kuti nei zvisina kururama kuverenga E(X) se "kukosha kunouya kakawanda zvikuru" kana "kukosha kunouya chaizvo."
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.0: Tsvaga E(X) yemuenzaniso wawakasarudza uye uienzanise nemakosha anogona kutorwa ne X: 0, 1, 2.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kuti kukosha kune probability huru zvikuru kunobatana sei nekukosha kwe E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here E(X) iwe pachako kumuenzaniso wawakasarudza?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here kuti nei E(X) ikukosha kusingagoni kuitika chaizvo?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakatsanangura here kuti kukosha kune probability huru zvikuru kunosiyana sei ne E(X)?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.0: Semuenzaniso, kune (40, 15, 45), E(X)=0.15 + 0.9 = 1.05. Iri haisi kukosha kunogona kutorwa ne X, uye kukosha kune probability huru zvikuru ndi2. Saka E(X) haisi kukosha kunouya kakawanda zvikuru kana kukosha kunogona kuuya.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.1: Kune (37, 24, 39), E(X)=1.02, asi X inogona kuva 0, 1, kana 2 chete, saka 1.02 haigoni kuitika. Kukosha kune probability huru zvikuru ndi2, pa39%, saka kunosiyana ne expected value.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.2: Kune (25, 36, 39), E(X)=1.14 haisi kukosha kunogona kutorwa ne X, uye inosiyanawo ne2, kukosha kunogoneka zvakanyanya.

n-m-h3-dist-05.title: Kana Probability Iri 0, Hazvigoni Kuitika Chaizvo Here?
n-m-h3-dist-05.topic: Ma probability distribution: probability yepoinzi imwe ye continuous random variable
n-m-h3-dist-05.goal: Tonga kuti kukosha kunogona kuitika here kana probability yaro papoinzi imwe ye continuous random variable iri 0, uye utsanangure kutonga uku, nemhedzisiro yekubatanidza kana kusabatanidza magumo, nemashoko anonzwisiswa neshamwari.
n-m-h3-dist-05.material: Bhazi rinosvika zvakaenzana panguva ipi neipi pakati pe0 ne10 maminetsi kubva zvino. Nguva yekumirira X (maminetsi) inogona kuva kukosha kupi nekupi kubva ku0 kusvika ku10 zvichibatanidzwa. Probability ye interval inoenderana nehurefu hwayo: P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10. Jia akanyora zvinotevera.
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.1: Tsanangura pfungwa yakaoma uchishandisa mashoko akapfava nemienzaniso
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.2: Tonga kuti kubatanidza kana kusabatanidza muganhu kunochinja probability here
n-m-h3-dist-05.prereq.0: Zvinoreva continuous random variable ne probability density function (probability ndiyo nzvimbo pamusoro pe interval)
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara usina kururama mukunyora kwaJia.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa nenzira yakarongeka kuti mutsara mumwe nemumwe unotevera zvakarurama kubva pamutsara wapfuura here.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga mitsara inoti "probability ndi0" ne "hazvigoni kuitika," uye uyedze kuti kufunga kunovabatanidza kwakarurama here nekufunga nezvebhazi rinosvika chaizvo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.0: X inogona kutora makosha ose kubva ku0 kusvika ku10, uye P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.1: P(X=4) iprobability ye interval yehurefu 0, saka ndi(4−4)/10=0.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.2: Sezvo probability iri 0, bhazi kusvika pamaminetsi 4 chaizvo chinhu chisingagoni kuitika.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 hauna kururama. Kune continuous random variable, kunyangwe probability papoinzi imwe iri 0, kukosha ikoko hakusi kuti hakugoneki. Pane makosha asingaperi pakati pe0 ne10, saka rimwe nerimwe rine probability 0, asi kukosha kunovapo. Mitsara 4 ne5 inotevera zvakarurama.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora meseji yekutumira yekutsanangurira Jia. Taura kuti chikamu chipi chekufunga kwake chinofanira kugadziriswa, uye kuti P(X≤4) ne P(X<4) zvinoenzaniswa sei muhukuru, uchishandisa mashoko akapfava nemuenzaniso.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti mukana wekusarudza kukosha kumwe chete chaizvo pakati pe0 ne10 uri mudiki sei.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.1: Taura pfungwa imwe chete nenzira yenzvimbo: nzvimbo yemutsetse umwe usina upamhi ndeyei?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakashandisa here mashoko nemuenzaniso unogona kunzwisiswa neshamwari yechikoro chepakati?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakatsanangura here kuti nei probability yakafanana kana muganhu wakabatanidzwa kana kusabatanidzwa?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.0: Pane makosha asingaperi pakati pemaminetsi 0 ne10, saka mukana wekuwana maminetsi 4 chaizvo uri mudiki zvakadai, padhuze ne0, zvekuti unova 0. Asi izvi hazvireve kuti bhazi harimbosvika pamaminetsi 4, nekuti rinosvika panguva imwe. Kunyangwe maminetsi 4 abatanidzwa kana kusabatanidzwa, probability inowedzera ndi0, saka P(X≤4) ne P(X<4) dzakaenzana.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.1: Nekuti icontinuous, kunyangwe poinzi imwe ine probability 0, bhazi rinogona kusvika panguva iyoyo. Zvakafanana nepoinzi imwe pamutsetse ine nzvimbo 0 asi mutsetse uchiri nemapoinzi. Kuwedzera kana kubvisa poinzi imwe hakuchinji probability, saka P(X≤4)=P(X<4)=0.4.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.2: P(X=4)=0, asi nguva yekusvika ikukosha kumwe chaiko, saka hazvisi kuti hazvigoneki kuti kukosha ikoko kuuye. Poinzi imwe haina upamhi, saka kuiwedzera kana kuibvisa hakuchinji probability, uye ma probability maviri akaenzana.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.0: Funga kuti chirevo chimwe nechimwe chinoenderana sei nekukosha kwe P(X=a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kune kukanda die X (discrete), tsvaga P(X≤3) ne P(X<3) uye uzviwenzanise.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.a: Kunyangwe kune continuous random variable, P(X≤a) inogara iri huru kupfuura P(X<a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.a: Wakafunga kuti "≤" inosanganisira nyaya dzakawanda, saka probability yayo inofanira kuva huru. Kune continuous random variable, probability papoinzi imwe ndi0, saka dzakaenzana.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.b: Kune continuous random variable, kana P(X=a)=0, ipapo X haigoni kuenzana ne a.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.b: Wakatora probability 0 sekunge ndiyo hazvigoneki. Kune continuous random variable, kukosha kune probability 0 kunogona kuitika chaizvo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.c: Kune continuous random variable, probability yakafanana kana magumo e interval akabatanidzwa kana kusabatanidzwa.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.c: Probability papoinzi imwe ndi0, saka kubatanidza kana kusabatanidza muganhu hakuchinji probability.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.d: Kunewo discrete random variable, P(X≤a)=P(X<a) inogara ichishanda.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.d: Kune discrete random variable, P(X=a) inogona kusava zero, saka ziviri zvinogona kusaenzana.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.explain: Kune continuous random variable, P(X=a)=0, saka P(a≤X≤b)=P(a<X<b)=P(a≤X<b)=P(a<X≤b). Kune discrete random variable, P(X=a)>0 inogoneka, saka kubatanidza kana kusabatanidza muganhu kunogona kuchinja probability.

n-m-h3-dist-07.title: Kugadzira Binomial Distribution Kubva Paavhareji Nevariance
n-m-h3-dist-07.topic: Probability distributions: avhareji nevariance yebinomial distribution
n-m-h3-dist-07.goal: Shandisa hukama pakati peavhareji nevariance yebinomial distribution kubvisa zvakabatanidzwa zvisingabviri, uye gadzira ma binomial distribution anosangana nemamiriro akapiwa kuti uwane mutemo.
n-m-h3-dist-07.material: Unoda kutsanangura dzimwe data nebinomial distribution B(n,p). Pano n inhamba yechisikigo uye p inhamba iri pakati pe 0 ne 1. Avhareji yebinomial distribution ndi np uye variance ndi np(1−p).
n-m-h3-dist-07.thinking.1: Gadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inosangana nemamiriro uye uwane mutemo
n-m-h3-dist-07.prereq.0: Avhareji np nevariance np(1−p) yebinomial distribution B(n, p)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.prompt: Ndeapi emaviri aya eavhareji nevariance anogona chaizvo kuitika kubinomial distribution B(n, p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.0: Seta avhareji yakaenzana ne np uye variance yakaenzana ne np(1−p), wobva wanatsa chinosara kana ukakamura variance neavhareji.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kune sarudzo imwe neimwe kana p yawawana iri pakati pe 0 ne 1 uye n inhamba yechisikigo.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.a: Pano variance yakakura kupfuura avhareji. Sezvo variance iri np(1−p), haigoni kuva huru kupfuura avhareji np.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.b: Kana ukawana p wobva wawana n=np÷p, n haisi nhamba yechisikigo. Wakashaya mamiriro okuti n inhamba yechisikigo.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.c: Kana variance yakaenzana neavhareji, saka 1−p=1, saka p=0. Ipapo avhareji yaizova 0, izvo zvisingawirirani.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.d: Variance ÷ avhareji = 1−p inosarudza p, uye n inobudawo senhamba yechisikigo, saka izvi zvinogoneka.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.explain: Variance ÷ avhareji = 1−p. Kune (8, 6), 1−p=3/4, p=1/4, uye n=8÷(1/4)=32, saka zvinogoneka. Kune (10, 12), 1−p>1 saka p<0; kune (8, 5), p=3/8 uye n=64/3, isiri nhamba yechisikigo; uye kune (6, 6), p=0.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma binomial distribution akasiyana 3 B(n, p) ane avhareji 12 uye variance ye 8 kana pasi. Nyora n senhamba yechisikigo uye p sepesenti yenhamba yakazara (p%). (semuenzaniso kune p=25%, nyora 25)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga nekunyora maviri e n ne p anosangana neavhareji np=12 (p sepesenti yenhamba yakazara).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kune maviri ega ega, verenga variance 12(1−p) uye utarise kana iri 8 kana pasi.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.ok.c1: n inhamba yechisikigo uye p iri pakati pe 1% ne 99%.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.fail.c1: n inofanira kuva nhamba yechisikigo uye p inofanira kuva pesenti yenhamba yakazara kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 99.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.explain: Kubva pa np=12, p=q/100. Kuti variance np(1−p)=12(1−p) ive 8 kana pasi, p inofanira kuva 1/3 kana kupfuura. Mienzaniso apo n ne p zvese zvinowirirana nemamiriro ndi (30, 40%), (25, 48%), (24, 50%), (20, 60%), (16, 75%), ne (15, 80%).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukatarisa ma distribution ako matatu, nyora kuti hukama hupi huripo pakati pe p nevariance kana avhareji dzakaenzana.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora p nevariance zvema distribution matatu padivi pedzimwe, sematafura.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana variance inova huru kana diki p painokura.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso Kana avhareji yakafanana, 12, p painokura variance ...
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here variance yema distribution matatu?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here hukama pakati pe p nevariance pamwe chete nemamiriro okuti avhareji dzakaenzana?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakashandisa here chokwadi chokuti variance inogona kunyorwa se 12(1−p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.0: Kana avhareji np yakafanana, 12, variance ndi 12(1−p), saka p painokura, variance inodzikira. Semuenzaniso, p=40% inopa 7.2 uye p=75% inopa 3.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.1: Ma distribution ese matatu ane avhareji 12, asi variance yakadzikira p painokura. Semuenzaniso, 6 kana p=50% ne 2.4 kana p=80%: mukana wekubudirira wakakwira, kuparadzirwa kwakawanda.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.2: Kana avhareji dzakaenzana, p painokura, variance 12(1-p) inova diki.

n-m-h3-dist-08.title: Mhinduro Yakapa Mukana 2: Mutsetse Upi Wakanganisa?
n-m-h3-dist-08.topic: Probability distributions: domain yeprobability density function
n-m-h3-dist-08.goal: Ziva kuti haugoni kuita integral kunze kwechikamu apo probability density function isiri 0, tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa, uye utsvage mukana wakarurama.
n-m-h3-dist-08.material: Continuous random variable X ine probability density function f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2), uye f(x)=0 kune x dzimwe dzese. Heyi mhinduro yaMinjun yekutsvaga constant k ne P(1≤X≤3).
n-m-h3-dist-08.thinking.1: Tarisa kana mhedzisiro iri mukati mehuwandu hunogoneka kumukana
n-m-h3-dist-08.prereq.1: Ma definite integral kana nzvimbo dzezvimiro
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaMinjun.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kubva kumusoro kana mutsetse wega wega uchitevera zvakarurama kubva pamutsetse uri pamberi.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kune mutsetse wega wega, enzanisa girafu rakashandiswa pachikamu icho che x nef(x) yakapiwa mudambudziko.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.0: f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2) uye f(x)=0 kumwe kwese, uye nzvimbo yose ndi 1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.2: P(1≤X≤3) ndiyo nzvimbo iri pakati pegirafu re y=x/2 ne x-axis kubva ku x=1 kusvika ku x=3.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 wakanganisa. Kune probability density function, f(x)=0 kana x yakakura kupfuura 2, saka girafu re y=x/2 rinoshandiswa kusvika ku x=2 chete. Saka nzvimbo kubva ku x=2 kusvika ku 3 haifaniri kuwedzerwa. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 inongotakura chikamu chakanganisa kubva pamutsetse 3.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mutsetse wakanganisa uye utsvage kukosha kwe P(1≤X≤3). Nyorawo kuti sei mhinduro yaMinjun ye 2 isingagoni kuva mukana.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wadhonza kuti girafu risi 0 papi.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.hint.1: Funga nezvehuwandu hwemakosha anogona kutorwa nemukana.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso f(x) haisi 0 kana x iri ... chete, saka ...
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here chikamu apo f(x) isiri 0 usati wagadzirisa?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaverenga here 3/4 iwe pachako (neintegration kana setrapezoid)?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakatarisa here mhinduro yako uchishandisa chokwadi chokuti mukana haugoni kupfuura 1?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.model.0: Kana x yakakura kupfuura 2, f(x)=0, saka unongoda kuverenga kubva ku x=1 kusvika ku 2, uye nzvimbo ndi (1/2)×(1/2+1)×1=3/4. Mhinduro yaMinjun ye 2 haigoneki nokuti mukana haugoni kuva mukuru kupfuura 1, asi inopfuura 1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.model.1: P(1≤X≤3)=P(1≤X≤2)=∫₁² x/2 dx=3/4. Sezvo nzvimbo yose iri 1, nzvimbo yechikamu haigoni kuva 2.

n-m-h3-prob-01.title: Kanenge Mumwe Mukunda: Mukana Wekuti Vose Vakunda Ndewupi?
n-m-h3-prob-01.topic: Mukana: conditional probability, kuzvimiririra nekusazvimiririra, kufunga kwemhando yeBayes, kugadzira sample space
n-m-h3-prob-01.goal: Muchigadziriso checonditional probability, tsvaga uye ugadzirise nzvimbo apo nyaya dzisina kuenzana mukana dzakaverengwa sedzakaenzana mukana, uye usimbise kuti nyaya dzasara dzinochinja zvichienderana nenzira yakataurwa mamiriro.
n-m-h3-prob-01.material: Zvose zvatinoziva ndezvekuti mhuri ine vana vaviri. Mwana mumwe nemumwe mukunda nemukana we1/2, uye tinofungidzira kuti ngono dzevana vaviri hadzikanganisani. Seungwoo akagadzirisa "mukana wekuti vana vose vaviri vakunda, kana kanenge mumwe mukunda" sezvakaratidzwa pazasi.
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.1: Vaka patsva sample space kubva panyaya dzinosiyaniswa
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.2: Fananidza mikana inochinja nenzira yakataurwa mamiriro
n-m-h3-prob-01.prereq.0: Zvinoreva conditional probability (chikamu chenyaya dzimwe pakati penyaya dzinokodzera mamiriro)
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama muchigadziriso chaSeungwoo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kubva kumusoro, mutsara mumwe nenguva, kana mutsara mumwe nemumwe unotevera zvakarurama kubva pamutsara wapakarepo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora iwe pachako nyaya dzinodaidzwa "dzakaenzana mukana," uchisiyanisa mwana wekutanga nemwana wechipiri, uye ufananidze kana dziri hukuru hwakafanana chaizvo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.0: Pasi pemamiriro ekuti kanenge mumwe wevana vaviri mukunda, wana mukana wekuti vana vose vaviri vakunda.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.1: Kuumbwa kwevana vaviri imwe yemhando nhatu, "vakunda 2," "mukunda 1 nomukomana 1," ne "vakomana 2," uye mhando nhatu dzakaenzana mukana.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.2: Kubvisa "vakomana 2," isingakodzeri mamiriro ekuti kanenge mumwe mukunda, kunosiya mhando mbiri.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.3: Pamhando mbiri dzasara, imwe iine vana vose vaviri vakunda.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga inoenda kwakaipa. "Mukunda 1 nomukomana 1" une nyaya apo mwana wekutanga ari mukunda nenyaya apo mwana wechipiri ari mukunda, saka kana wekutanga nechipiri vasiyaniswa, haina kuenzana mukana ne "vakunda 2" kana "vakomana 2." Mitsara 3 kusvika ku5 inotevera mhando nhatu dzemutsara 2 nekuvimba, saka kuverenga mukati mazvo kwakarurama asi mhedzisiro yakaipa.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.prompt: Uchishandisa chigadziriso chakagadziriswa, wana mukana wekuti vana vose vaviri vakunda, uye unyore kuti nei kukosha kwakasiyana naSeungwoo. (Mwana mumwe nemumwe mukunda nemukana we1/2, uye vaviri vanofungidzirwa kuti havakanganisani.)
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.0: Siyanisa vana semwana wekutanga newechipiri, uye unyore masanganiswa ose engono. Pane mangani, uye akaenzana mukana here?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga nyaya dzinokodzera mamiriro chete, uye ufananidze kuti mangani acho ane vana vose vakunda.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso Kana tikasiyanisa mwana wekutanga nechipiri, ...
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora nyaya dzose dzinogoneka, uchisiyanisa mwana wekutanga nechipiri here?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakachengeta nyaya dzinokodzera mamiriro chete uye wakawana chikamu chenyaya dzevose vakunda pakati pazvo here?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakataura kuti "mukunda 1 nomukomana 1" haisi nyaya imwe chete here?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.0: Kana tikasiyanisa mwana wekutanga nechipiri, (mukunda, mukunda), (mukunda, mukomana), (mukomana, mukunda), ne (mukomana, mukomana) dzose dzakaenzana mukana. Pakati penyaya 3 apo kanenge mumwe mukunda, 1 ine vana vose vakunda, saka mukana i1/3.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.1: Mukunda mumwe nomukomana mumwe unopatsanurwa kuita nyaya mbiri, (wekutanga mukunda, wechipiri mukomana) ne (wekutanga mukomana, wechipiri mukunda), saka haufanire kuverengwa senyaya imwe. Saka pane nyaya 3 dzinokodzera mamiriro, uye imwe chete pazvo ine vana vose vakunda, saka mukana i chikamu chimwe pa3.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Kunyora nezviratidzo seye G ne B zvakanaka.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.prompt: Dai mamiriro asiri "kanenge mumwe mukunda" asi "mwana wekutanga mukunda," mukana wekuti vana vose vaviri vakunda waizova upi?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nyaya dzinosara pasi pemamiriro aya, uchisiyanisa mwana wekutanga nechipiri.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.1: Isa runyoro rwenyaya dzasara dzedambudziko rapfuura padivi perunyoro urwu uye utsvage chakachinja.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.a: Wakaverenga zvisiri izvo nyaya dzinokodzera mamiriro, kana wakavhiringidza "kanenge mukunda mumwe" ne "vose vakunda."
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakapa mukana pamusoro peyose yekutanga pasina kushandisa mamiriro. Kana pane mamiriro, nyaya dzasara dzinochinja.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.c: Wakatora mamiriro edambudziko rapfuura neaya seakafanana. Panguva ino ngono yemwana wechipiri chete ndiyo inosara yakavhurika.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.explain: Kana mwana wekutanga ari mukunda, nyaya dzasara i (mukunda, mukunda) ne (mukunda, mukomana), dzakaenzana mukana. Pakati peidzi, imwe ine vana vose vakunda, saka mukana i1/2. "Kanenge mumwe mukunda" inobvumirawo (mukomana, mukunda), saka pane nyaya 3 dzasara uye mukana i1/3. Sample space yasara inoenderana nenzira yakataurwa mamiriro.

n-m-h3-est-01.title: Kutarisa Mhinduro Yemukana Wekuti Mabhodhoro 9 Anenge Avhareji 503 mL Kana Kupfuura
n-m-h3-est-01.goal: Enzanisa avhareji nestandard deviation yekuparadzirwa kweavhareji yesampuli nemakosha everuzhinji, tsvaga uye ugadzirise mutsetse wakanganisa mumhinduro, uye utsanangure kuti sei mukana weavhareji yesampuli wakasiyana nemukana wekukosha kwega kwega.
n-m-h3-est-01.material: Pafekitori yezvinwiwa, huwandu hwebhodhoro rimwe hunotevedza normal distribution ine avhareji 500 mL nestandard deviation 6 mL. Haeun, anoshanda pakutarisa hunhu, akasarudza mabhodhoro 9 zvisina kurongeka uye akawana mukana wekuti avhareji yehuwandu X̄ ive 503 mL kana kupfuura. Chikamu chetafura ye standard normal: P(0≤Z≤0.5)=0.1915, P(0≤Z≤1.5)=0.4332, P(0≤Z≤3)=0.4987. (Z ndiyo random variable inotevedza normal distribution ine avhareji 0 nestandard deviation 1.)
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.0: Verenga zvakanaka kuparadzanisa kukosha kumwe chete neavhareji yesampuli
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.1: Enzanisa avhareji nestandard deviation yeavhareji yesampuli nemakosha everuzhinji
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.2: Tsanangura kuti mukana wakagadziriswa wakasiyana sei, uye nenzira ipi, nemukana wekukosha kwega kwega
n-m-h3-est-01.prereq.0: Maitiro ekuita standardize normal distribution nekuverenga tafura ye standard normal
n-m-h3-est-01.prereq.1: Hukama pakati peavhareji nestandard deviation yeavhareji yesampuli neyeveruzhinji
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaHaeun.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mutsetse wega wega uye urongere kana uri pamusoro "pebhodhoro rimwe" kana "peavhareji yemabhodhoro 9."
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kukosha kuviri, avhareji nestandard deviation yekuparadzirwa kwe X̄, rimwe nerimwe nemakosha ekuparadzirwa kwebhodhoro rimwe.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.line.0: Veruzhinji vanotevedza normal ine avhareji 500 nestandard deviation 6, uye avhareji yesampuli yemabhodhoro 9 ndi X̄.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.line.1: Avhareji ye X̄ ndi 500, yakafanana neavhareji yeveruzhinji.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.line.2: Standard deviation ye X̄ ndi 6, yakafanana nestandard deviation yeveruzhinji.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 wakanganisa. Standard deviation yeavhareji yesampuli X̄ ndiyo standard deviation yeveruzhinji yakakamurwa nesquare root yesaizi yesampuli: 6/√9=2. Saka X̄ inotevedza normal distribution ine avhareji 500 nestandard deviation 2, uye P(X̄≥503)=P(Z≥1.5)=0.5−0.4332=0.0668. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 inotakura 6 kubva pamutsetse 3, saka mhedzisiro dzayo dzakanganisa (0.3085 inoenderana nemukana wekuti bhodhoro rimwe ndi 503 kana kupfuura).
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.prompt: Shandisa mhinduro yakagadziriswa kuwana P(X̄≥503). Wobva watsanangura mumutsara mumwe kana miviri kuti mukana uyu wakasiyana sei nemukana wokuti huwandu hwebhodhoro rimwe ndi 503 mL kana kupfuura, uye nei.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora standard deviation ye X̄, wobva wawana kukosha kwakagadziriswa kwe 503.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ienzanise nekukosha kwakagadziriswa kwebhodhoro rimwe, uye ufunge kuti kuparadzirwa kwakashanduka sei.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso Standard deviation ye X̄ ndi ..., saka ... kana yaenzaniswa nebhodhoro rimwe ...
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakabatanidza here standard deviation yakagadziriswa kuva 2, kwete 6, ne √9?
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here nechikonzero kuti sei mukana wakava mudiki kupfuura webhodhoro rimwe (anenge 0.31)?
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaisa here mumazwi pfungwa yokuti kana ukaita avhareji yemabhodhoro 9, akakwira nedzakadzika anodzimana?
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.model.0: Standard deviation yeavhareji yesampuli ndi 6÷√9=2. P(X̄≥503)=P(Z≥1.5)=0.5−0.4332=0.0668. Kana ukaita avhareji yemabhodhoro 9, mabhodhoro akakwira nemabhodhoro akadzika anodzimana, saka avhareji haina kuparadzirwa zvakanyanya kupfuura bhodhoro rimwe, uye mukana wekuva 503 kana kupfuura wakadiki zvikuru.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.model.1: X̄ inotevedza N(500, 2²), saka Z=(503−500)/2=1.5 uye mukana unenge 6.68%. Kubhodhoro rimwe standard deviation ndi 6, asi kuavhareji inodzikira kusvika ku 2 uye inounganidzwa zvakanyanya padyo ne 500, saka mukana wekuva 503 kana kupfuura wakadiki.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Poindi yakakosha ndeyokuti standard deviation yakadzikira kubva ku 6 kusvika ku 2.

n-m-h3-est-04.title: Nguva Yekumirira Yakakotama Inogona Kutorwa Seyenormal Kana Wakatora Mean Yayo here?
n-m-h3-est-04.goal: Tonga, sezvo ruzivo rwuchiratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu, kuti normal distribution inogona kushandiswa rinhi kusample mean kana population isiri normal, uye utsanangure kuti nei kutonga kunochinja.
n-m-h3-est-04.material: Pasnack bar, nguva yekumirira (mumaminitsi) kubva pakuodha kusvika chikafu chasvika ine mean yemaminitsi 10 uye standard deviation yemaminitsi 10. Vatengi vazhinji vanomirira nguva pfupi, asi vashoma vanomirira nguva refu zvikuru, saka distribution yakakotama ine muswe murefu kurudyi uye haisi normal. Chikamu chetebhura yestandard normal: P(0≤Z≤1)=0.3413, P(0≤Z≤1.2)=0.3849.
n-m-h3-est-04.thinking.0: Gadzirisa kutonga kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda
n-m-h3-est-04.thinking.1: Siyanisa mafomula emean nestandard deviation yesample mean nechimiro chedistribution yayo
n-m-h3-est-04.thinking.2: Tsanangura mamiriro apo normal approximation inogoneka
n-m-h3-est-04.prereq.0: Mean nestandard deviation yesample mean (m, σ/√n)
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga uchishandisa zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho imwe neimwe, tanga wanyatsotarisa kana zviri kuverengwa i "nguva yekumirira yemutengi mumwe" kana "mean yevatengi vakawanda."
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.hint.1: Siyanisa zvinogona kutaurwa nefomula (mean nestandard deviation) nezvinoenderana nechimiro (kana iri normal).
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Mushandi anoti, "Ngatitorei nguva yekumirira seN(10, 10²) uye tiverenge mukana wekuti mutengi mumwe anomirira maminitsi 20 kana kupfuura se P(Z≥1)=0.5−0.3413=0.1587."
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ndekupi kutonga kunokodzera zvikuru pamusoro pekuverenga uku?
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ndekupi kutonga kunokodzera zvikuru pamusoro pekuverenga uku?

n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 0.1587 yakarurama nokuti tinoziva mean nestandard deviation.

n-m-h3-est-06.title: Kudhonza Mabhora Maviri: Mukana Wekuti Sample Mean i 5 Kana Kupfuura i Upi?
n-m-h3-est-06.goal: Kune ma samples ehukuru 2 akadhonzwa nekudzoserwa, nyora ma ordered pairs ose ane sample mean inogutsa mamiriro pasina kusiya, uye utsanangure nei unofanira kusiyanisa nhevedzano kuti uverenge mukana zvakarurama.
n-m-h3-est-06.material: Bhegi rine mabhora 4 akanyorwa 1, 3, 5, ne 7, nhamba imwe pabhora rimwe. Unodhonza bhora rimwe, unonyora nhamba yaro, uchariisa kudzoka, wobva wadhonza rimwe zvakare uchinyora nhamba. Ngatitii a i nhamba yekutanga yakadhonzwa uye b yechipiri, uye daidza (a, b) sample imwe; sample mean i X̄=(a+b)/2. Pakudhonza kwega kwega, mabhora ose 4 ane mukana wakaenzana.
n-m-h3-est-06.thinking.0: Nyora ma ordered pairs nenzira yakarongeka
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira ma samples 4 akasiyana (a, b) apo nhamba yekutanga neyechipiri dzakasiyana uye sample mean i 5 kana kupfuura, uye uaise. ((a, b) ne (b, a) dzine nhevedzano yakachinjanisa dzinoverengwa semasamples akasiyana.)
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tora a se 1, 3, 5, 7 imwe panguva imwe, uye uwane b ine a+b i 10 kana kupfuura.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana peya ine a ne b dzakachinjanisa inogutsawo mamiriro.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.ok.c1: a i imwe yenhamba dziri pamabhora (1, 3, 5, 7).
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.fail.c1: a haisi imwe yenhamba dziri pamabhora: 1, 3, 5, 7.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.ok.c2: b i imwe yenhamba dziri pamabhora (1, 3, 5, 7).
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.fail.c2: b haisi imwe yenhamba dziri pamabhora: 1, 3, 5, 7.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s1.explain: Ma ordered pairs ane a≠b ne a+b≥10 i 4 chaizvo: (3,7), (7,3), (5,7), (7,5). (3,7) ne (7,3) i ma samples akasiyana ane yekutanga neyechipiri dzakachinjanisa. (3, 5) ine mean 4, saka haishande, uye (5, 5) yasiiwa mumamiriro aya nekuti nhamba mbiri dzakafanana.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.prompt: Uchisanganisira mamiriro apo a ne b dzakafanana, sarudza mukana wekuti sample mean X̄ i 5 kana kupfuura.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wawana huwandu hwose hwema samples anogona kugadzirwa kana a ne b dzaiswa nenhevedzano.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana ma samples iwayo ose ane mukana wakaenzana, uye uverenge ma samples anogutsa mamiriro, kusanganisira ayo kubva padanho rapfuura.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.o.a: 1/4: verenga ma samples 4 chete ane nhamba dzakasiyana
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.r.a: Wakasiya ma samples ane a ne b dzakafanana, (5,5) ne (7,7), ayo ane ma means ari 5 kana kupfuura zvakare. Dambudziko rakati sanganisira mamiriro akafanana.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.r.b: Iyi i mhedzisiro yekusiya nhevedzano uye kuverenga {3,7} seimwe. Mamiriro 10 aya haauye nemukana wakaenzana.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.o.d: 1/2: hafu yema samples ane mean yakakura kupfuura population mean 4
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.r.d: Wakafunga kuti pamusoro napasi pe population mean 4 i hafu nehafu chaizvo. Kune ma samples ane X̄=4 zvakare, uye unofanira kubvisa chikamu chawo.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.explain: Ma ordered samples 16 (a, b) ose ane mukana wakaenzana, rimwe nerimwe 1/16. Ane mean 5 kana kupfuura i 4 ari pamusoro pamwe ne (5,5) ne (7,7), 6 zvose, saka 6/16=3/8. Kana ukasiya nhevedzano uye ukaverenga mamiriro 10, {3,7} inoverenga mamiriro maviri (3,7) ne (7,3) seimwe, uye mukana unobuda wakanganisa.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura nei mukana uchichinja kana ukasiya nhevedzano uye ukaverenga {3, 7} seimwe, nekutaura kuti (3, 7) ne (7, 3) imwe neimwe inoitika nemukana wei.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.hint.0: Wana mukana wekuwana 3 pakutanga ne 7 yechipiri semukana wemikana yekudhonza bhora rimwe nerimwe.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.hint.1: Wanawo mukana we 7 pakutanga ne 3 yechipiri, uye uuenzanise nemukana wekuwana {5,5}.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora mukana we (3,7) ne (7,3) imwe neimwe here?
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti mukana wemamiriro api unoshaikwa kana {3,7} yaverengwa seimwe here?
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura kuti mukana we {3,7} i mukuru kupfuura we (5,5) here?
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.model.0: (3,7) ne (7,3) i ma samples akasiyana, ane nhamba yekutanga neyechipiri dzakasiyana, uye imwe neimwe inoitika nemukana we 1/16. Saka mamiriro imwe chete {3,7} ane mukana we 2/16. Kana ukasiya nhevedzano uye ukaiverenga semamiriro 1, unoitora seyakafanana ne {5,5} pa 1/16, uye mukana unobuda wakanganisa.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s3.model.1: Mamiriro 16 ane nhevedzano ose ane mukana wakaenzana. Kudhonza 3 pakutanga ne 7 yechipiri i mamiriro akasiyana nekudzoserwa, saka mukana wekuwana {3,7} semamiriro maviri akabatanidzwa i 1/8, ka2 yemukana we (5,5).

n-m-h3-est-02.title: Unofanira Kuziva Chii Kuti Uwane Kureba Kwe Confidence Interval?
n-m-h3-est-02.topic: Statistical estimation: confidence interval yeavhareji yeveruzhinji
n-m-h3-est-02.goal: Paradzanisa zvinosarudza kureba kwe confidence interval yeavhareji yeveruzhinji nezvinosarudza nzvimbo yayo, uye gadzira iwe pachako chirongwa cheongororo chinosangana nemamiriro ekureba.
n-m-h3-est-02.material: Unoda kufungidzira population mean m yeavhareji yenguva yekuverenga pazuva yevadiki (mumaawa). Population inotevera normal distribution uye population standard deviation σ inozivikanwa. Kana sample size i n uye sample mean i x̄, 95% confidence interval i x̄−1.96×σ/√n ≤ m ≤ x̄+1.96×σ/√n. Chikwata chekuongorora hachisati chatanga bvunzo, uye chinoda kutanga chaverenga "kureba kweconfidence interval" chete.
n-m-h3-est-02.thinking.0: Rongedza ruzivo runodiwa kubva kune rusingadiwe
n-m-h3-est-02.thinking.1: Siyanisa zvinhu zvinokanganisa kureba nezvinokanganisa nzvimbo
n-m-h3-est-02.thinking.2: Vaka zvirongwa zvakawanda zvinosangana nemamiriro uye uzviongorore
n-m-h3-est-02.prereq.0: Fomula yeconfidence interval yepopulation mean kubva kunormal distribution ine population standard deviation inozivikanwa
n-m-h3-est-02.prereq.1: Kukosha kwe z kune confidence level yakapiwa mustandard normal distribution (inenge 1.96 ye95%)
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.prompt: Usati watanga bvunzo, sarudza ruzivo rwose rwaunofanira kuziva kuverenga kureba kwe 95% confidence interval. (Usasarudze zvisingadiwe.)
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bvisa mugumo wepazasi kubva pamugumo wepamusoro zvakananga uye unyore mutauro wekureba kutanga.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.hint.1: Rongedza mabhii kuita aya anosara mumutauro uyo neanoshaika.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.a: x̄ inosarudza pakati peinterval. Unogona kuongorora kana x̄ ichisara mudistance pakati pemigumo miviri nekubvisa mugumo wepazasi kubva pamugumo wepamusoro mumutauro.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.b: n inoonekwa mu σ/√n uye inochinja kureba kweinterval. Funga kuti interval inochinja sei kana sample yakakura.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.o.c: Standard deviation s yakaverengwa kubva musample
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.c: Population standard deviation σ yatozivikanwa, saka s haioneki mumutauro wekureba. Tarisa kuti mabhii api anoonekwa mumutauro.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.d: σ inoonekwa mumutauro wekureba σ/√n. Kana usingazivi kupararira, haugoni kutaura kuti interval yakapamhama zvakadii.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.e: Population mean ndiko kukosha kwatiri kuedza kufungidzira, saka hakusati kwaziva, uye hakuoneki mumutauro wekureba kweinterval futi.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.explain: Kubvisa mugumo wepazasi kubva pamugumo wepamusoro kunoita kuti x̄ ishaike uye kusiya 2×1.96×σ/√n chete. 95% confidence level yatogadzikwa, saka kureba kunosarudzwa ne σ ne n, uye sample mean inongosarudza nzvimbo yeinterval. Population mean m ndiko kukosha kunofungidzirwa, uye sample standard deviation s haishandiswi mumutauro wekureba nokuti σ inozivikanwa.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira σ i4 kana kupfuura, uye gadzira zvirongwa zvebvunzo kuti kureba kwe95% confidence interval kuve maawa 2 kana pazasi. Isa σ ne sample size n kune chimwe nechimwe. Zvirongwa zviviri zvinofanira kuva nemakoshero e σ akasiyana; gadzira zvirongwa 2. (n inhamba yechisikwa i400 kana pazasi.)
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.hint.0: Shandura mamiriro ekuti kureba 2×1.96×σ/√n ive 2 kana pazasi kuita inequality mu √n.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wasarudza σ, wobva wasarudza n inogutsa mamiriro iwayo. Ita kamwe zvakare ne σ yakasiyana.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.ok.c2: n inhamba yechisikwa i400 kana pazasi.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.fail.c2: n haisi nhamba yechisikwa i400 kana pazasi.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.explain: Kuti kureba 2×1.96×σ/√n kuve 2 kana pazasi, √n inofanira kuva 1.96σ kana kupfuura. Ne σ=5, n=100 kureba i1.96, uye ne σ=10, n=400 kureba i1.96. Kana σ yakakura, n inofanira kuva huru zvakanyanya. σ=5, n=25 inopa kureba kwe3.92, izvo zvisingashande.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.prompt: Nechirongwa chimwe chete (σ=2, n=64, 95% confidence), bvunzo yakaitwa kaviri uye sample means yaiva 2.7 ne3.2. Wana confidence intervals mbiri, uye ufananidze kureba nenzvimbo dzazvo.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kune sample mean imwe neimwe, wedzera uye ubvise kukosha kwe 1.96×2/√64 kunyora interval.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.hint.1: Wana musiyano pakati pemigumo yepamusoro nepazasi kune interval imwe neimwe, wobva wafananidzawo midpoints.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso Kune 2.7 i ... kusvika ..., kune 3.2 i ... kusvika ..., uye kureba i...
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga iwe pachako interval 2.21 kusvika 3.19 yesample mean 2.7 here?
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakafananidza kureba kweinterval mbiri nenhamba here?
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakabatanidza chokwadi chekuti kureba kunosarudzwa ne σ, n, uye confidence level, apo x̄ inosarudza nzvimbo chete here?
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.model.0: Kune sample mean 2.7, 2.7±1.96×2/8=2.7±0.49, ndiko kuti, 2.21 kusvika 3.19, uye kune 3.2 i2.71 kusvika 3.69. Ma interval ose maviri ane kureba kumwe chete, 0.98, uye zvichienderana nesample mean nzvimbo chete inochinja, ne0.5.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s3.model.1: Kureba kwakafanana, kunenge 0.98, uye pakati chete (sample mean) ndipo pakasiyana, saka interval inofamba 0.5 kurudyi. Kureba kunosarudzwa ne σ, n, ne confidence level chete, uye sample mean inosarudza nzvimbo yeinterval chete.

n-m-h3-est-08.topic: Statistical estimation: confidence interval yeavhareji yeveruzhinji
n-m-h3-est-08.title: Kutarisa mutengo we z mugadziriso ye 90% Confidence Interval
n-m-h3-est-08.goal: Tarisa hukama pakati pe confidence level nemikana mu standard normal table, wana uye ugadzirise mutsetse usina kururama mugadziriso, uye usimbise kukanganisa nekuverenga kuti mutengo we z wakanganisa unoenderana ne confidence level ipi chaizvo.
n-m-h3-est-08.material: Kubva pa population ine normal distribution ine population standard deviation σ=8, random sample ye 64 ine sample mean x̄=50. Jiho akawana 90% confidence interval ye population mean m. Chikamu che standard normal table: P(0≤Z≤1.28)=0.3997, P(0≤Z≤1.645)=0.4500, P(0≤Z≤1.96)=0.4750, P(0≤Z≤2.58)=0.4950. (Z i random variable inotevera normal distribution ine mean 0 ne standard deviation 1.)
n-m-h3-est-08.thinking.1: Shandura confidence level kuita mukana wepakati kuwana mutengo we z
n-m-h3-est-08.thinking.2: Dzokera shure kubva pamutengo wakanganisa uye uutarise
n-m-h3-est-08.prereq.1: Fomula ye confidence interval ye population mean
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yaJiho.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wadhonza mufananidzo wekuti 90% confidence level inoreva chikamu chipi che standard normal distribution.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.hint.1: Govanisa chikamu icho kuita hafu pa 0 uye uchienzanise nechimiro chetebhura P(0≤Z≤z).
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.line.0: Standard deviation ye sample mean i σ/√n=8/√64=1.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.line.1: Confidence level i 90%, saka shandisa z ine P(Z≤z)=0.90.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 hauna kururama. 90% confidence level inoreva mukana pakati pe −z ne z: P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90. Nesymmetry, P(0≤Z≤z)=0.45, uye kubva patebhura z=1.645. Mitsetse 3, 4, ne 5 inotevera mutsetse 2, saka mhedzisiro dzavo hadzina kururama. Interval yakarurama i 50±1.645×1, ndiko kuti, 48.355 ≤ m ≤ 51.645.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.prompt: Wana 90% confidence interval negadziriso yakagadziriswa. Wobva waverenga, uchishandisa tebhura, P(−1.28≤Z≤1.28) kune z=1.28 yaJiho, unyore kuti mutengo uyu unoenderana ne confidence level ipi, uye uratidze nei interval yaJiho isiri 90% interval.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mutengo we P(0≤Z≤z) kuti P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, wobva wawana z patebhura.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kune 1.28, wedzera P(0≤Z≤1.28) kaviri (kamwe kudivi rega rega).
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, saka z=..., uye interval i ... Ne z=1.28 yaJiho, ...

n-m-h3-est-07.title: Survey Inosarudza Kirasi Yose: Tinogona Kuvimba ne Sample Mean here?
n-m-h3-est-07.goal: Nzwisisa kuti kuva nemukana wakaenzana wekusarudzwa kwevadzidzi vose kwakasiyana nekuti sample inomirira population zvakanaka, uye vaka uye utsanangure mamiriro ekufungidzira anoburitsa kusasimba.
n-m-h3-est-07.material: Chikoro chepamusoro chine makirasi 20 evadzidzi 30 imwe neimwe, vadzidzi 600 zvose. Uri kuronga kusarudza vadzidzi 30 vekuongorora nguva yekurara yezuva nezuva.
n-m-h3-est-07.thinking.2: Tsanangura kusasimba kwenzira yekusarudza nekuti ingagadziriswa sei
n-m-h3-est-07.prereq.1: Kuti sample mean i mutengo unoshandiswa kufungidzira population mean
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzose apo vadzidzi vose 600 vane mukana wakaenzana wekusarudzwa musample.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza mudzidzi mumwe uye unyore, seexpression, mukana wekuti mudzidzi iyeye apinde musample pasi penzira imwe neimwe.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tora zvakare mudzidzi wegore rekutanga, wegore rechipiri, nowegore rechitatu rimwe nerimwe uye utarise kuti mikana yakafanana.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.a: Nyora nhamba dzevadzidzi vese pandandanda yose uye usarudze 30 uchishandisa random numbers.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.a: Mudzidzi wega wega anosarudzwa nemukana 30/600, wose wakafanana. Tarisa kana wakasiya nzira iyi.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.b: Dhonza kirasi imwe zvisina nzira pamakirasi 20 uye usarudze vadzidzi vose 30 variri.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.b: Mudzidzi wega wega anosarudzwa nemukana 1/20, mukana wekuti kirasi yavo isarudzwe, wose wakafanana. Tarisa kana wakasiya nzira iyi.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.c: Dhonza 30 zvisina nzira kubva kuvadzidzi 200 vegore rechitatu.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.c: Vadzidzi vegore rekutanga nerechipiri havana mukana wekusarudzwa zvachose. Zvakarurama mukati megore rechitatu chete, kwete kuvadzidzi vose.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.d: Sarudza vadzidzi 30 vekutanga vaunosangana navo muhoro panguva ye lunch.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.d: Vadzidzi vanowanzova muhoro vane mukana mukuru wekusangana navo, saka mukana wekusarudzwa unosiyana kubva kumudzidzi kuenda kumudzidzi.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.explain: Mu A, 30 dzinosarudzwa pa 600, saka mudzidzi wega wega ane mukana 30/600, uye mu B, kirasi imwe pa 20 inosarudzwa, saka mudzidzi wega wega anosarudzwa nemukana 1/20=30/600. Mu C mukana wevadzidzi vegore rekutanga nerechipiri i 0, uye mu D mukana wekusangana navo unosiyana nemudzidzi. Zvisinei, B inopa mikana yakaenzana asi vadzidzi vakasarudzwa pamwe chete vanogona kufanana, saka haigone kutorwa senzira imwechete ne A.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira chikoro chine makirasi maviri chete evadzidzi 30 imwe neimwe. Kana ukadhonza kirasi imwe zvisina nzira uye ukashandisa vadzidzi vayo 30 se sample, kunyange kirasi ipi yakasarudzwa, sample inofanira kusiyana ne avhareji yenguva yekurara yechikoro chose ne awa 1 kana kupfuura. Gadzira mapeya 2 akasiyana enguva dzekurara dzeavhareji yemakirasi maviri a ne b (mumaawa, kubva ku 4 kusvika ku 10 pamwe chete) uye uaise.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.hint.0: Kana makirasi maviri aine huwandu hwakafanana hwevadzidzi, tanga wanyora mean yechikoro chose maererano ne a ne b.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.hint.1: Wana musiyano pakati pe mean yekirasi yakasarudzwa ne mean yechikoro chose, uye usarudze musiyano pakati pe a ne b kuti ive 1 kana kupfuura.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b zvakapoteredzwa pakati pe 4 ne 10 pamwe chete.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.fail.c1: a kana b haisi pakati pe 4 ne 10 pamwe chete.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Kunyange kirasi ipi yakasarudzwa, inosiyana ne mean yechikoro chose ne awa 1 kana kupfuura.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Zvichienderana nekuti kirasi ipi yasarudzwa, kune mamiriro apo inosiyana ne mean yechikoro chose neshoma kupfuura awa 1.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.explain: Sezvo makirasi maviri aine huwandu hwakafanana hwevadzidzi, mean yechikoro chose i (a+b)/2, uye kunyange kirasi ipi yasarudzwa, huwandu hwainosiyana nahwo hwakafanana, |a−b|/2. Kuti izvi zvive 1 kana kupfuura, |a−b|≥2. Semuenzaniso, kana makirasi ane avhareji yemaawa 6 nemaawa 8, mean yechikoro chose i maawa 7, uye kusarudza kirasi imwe kunopa maawa 6 kana 8, rimwe nerimwe rinosiyana ne awa 1 kubva ku 7.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.prompt: Enzanisa nzira yekirasi yose nenzira yekusarudza vadzidzi 30 pa 600 uchishandisa random numbers. Uchishandisa muenzaniso wawakagadzira pamusoro, tsanangura kusasimba kwekusarudza kirasi yose, uye unyore nzira imwe yekudzikisa kusasimba uku.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.hint.0: Mumuenzaniso wawakagadzira, nyora nenhamba kuti sample mean inochinja sei zvichienderana nekuti kirasi ipi yasarudzwa.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti vadzidzi vemakirasi mangani vanopinda musample imwe kana 30 dzasarudzwa nerandom numbers.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso Vadzidzi vekirasi imwechete ... saka ... Kuti udzikise izvi ...
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura kusasimba uchishandisa ma means ekirasi maviri awakagadzira pamusoro here?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti kunyange nemikana yakaenzana yekusarudzwa, sample mean inogona kuva kure here?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Kugadzirisa kwako kunoenda kudirection yekusanganisa vadzidzi vemakirasi akawanda here?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.model.0: Vadzidzi vekirasi imwechete vane tsika dzakafanana, saka kana ukasarudza kirasi yose, sample mean inogona kuva kure ne mean yechikoro chose zvichienderana nekuti kirasi ipi yasarudzwa. Semuenzaniso, nekirasi yemaawa 6 nekirasi yemaawa 8, kunyange ipi yasarudzwa, inosiyana ne awa 1. Unogona kudzikisa izvi nekusarudza nerandom numbers kubva pandandanda yose, kana nekusarudza vadzidzi vashoma kubva pamakirasi ose.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.model.1: Vadzidzi mukirasi imwechete vanofanana, saka kunyange ukasarudza 30, ruzivo haruna kukosha kwevadzidzi 30. Kana makirasi ane ma means akasiyana, mhedzisiro inosiyana zvakanyanya zvichienderana nekuti kirasi ipi yasarudzwa (error inokura), uye inogadziriswa kana ukasarudza zvisina nzira uye zvakaenzana kubva pamakirasi akawanda.

n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga uchishandisa zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h3-integc-04.title: Ma Definite Integral Asina Antiderivative
n-m-h3-integc-04.topic: Integration: ma definite integral uchishandisa substitution nesymmetry ye interval (kutsvaga kukosha pasina antiderivative)
n-m-h3-integc-04.goal: Gadzirisa kutonga kwako sezvo ruzivo ruchikura, usimbise kuti hukama hwe symmetry hunowanikwa nekutsiva hunotara kukosha kwe definite integral pasina kutsvaga antiderivative.
n-m-h3-integc-04.material: Teedzera, danho nedanho, maitiro ekutsvaga kukosha kwe definite integral I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. (∫_0^{π/2} ndiyo definite integral kubva ku0 kusvika ku π/2.)
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.1: Verenga huwandu hwema equation nehuwandu hwema unknown
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.2: Cherekedza nzira ye interval mushure mekutsiva
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.3: Tonga mamiriro apo nzira imwe chete inoshanda
n-m-h3-integc-04.prereq.0: Integration nekutsiva (kushandura ma limit mu definite integral)
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva rwunoonekwa, verenga "ma unknown mangani uye ma equation mangani."
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti fungidziro yako yekutanga nekukosha kwakawanikwa shure hazvisiyani zvikuru here.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Unoda kutsvaga I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Zvakaoma kutsvaga antiderivative ye expression iyi zvakananga. Makosha e integrand h(x)=sin x/(sin x+cos x) ndi h(0)=0, h(π/4)=1/2, h(π/2)=1, uye hurefu hwe interval ndi π/2 (anenge 1.57).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Fungidziro ipi yehukuru hwe I inokodzera zvakanyanya?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kukwira kunokwira kubva ku0 kusvika ku1 nekukosha kwepakati 1/2, saka nzvimbo inenge (1/2)×1.57≈0.8. Fungidziro iyi inogona kushandiswa shure kutarisa kuti kukosha kwawakawana kwakarurama here.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: I inenge 1.57: nekuti unotora kukwira se1 woiwedzera nehurefu 1.57
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kukwira ndi1 pamucheto we interval chete. Fungidziro iyi inotora kukwira se1 pa interval yose.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: I inenge 0.8: nekuti kukwira kunosiyana kubva ku0 kusvika ku1, average inenge 1/2
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafungidzira shanduko yekukwira nekuishandisa average. Haisi kukosha chaiko, asi inogona kushandiswa kuyera hukuru.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: I ndi0: nekuti h(0)=0 papoinzi yekutanga
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kukosha kuva 0 papoinzi imwe hakuiti definite integral ive 0. Tarisa makosha pa interval yose.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Tarisawo J=∫_0^{π/2} cos x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Kuwedzera ma fraction maviri kunoita kuti numerator ienzane ne denominator, saka I+J=∫_0^{π/2} 1 dx=π/2.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: I inogona kutarwa neruzivo urwu oga here?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Pane equation imwe chete, I+J=π/2, saka I ne J hazvigoni kutarwa zvakaparadzana. Unofanira kutsvaga imwe hukama pakati pe I ne J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaiparadzanisa nehafu usina kutarisa kuti I=J here. I+J=π/2 hukama humwe chete pakati pe I ne J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Haigoni kutarwa: I+J=π/2 haibatsiri chose kutsvaga I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kukosha kwe I+J ruzivo rwunobatsira. Rakapa hukama humwe pakati pe I ne J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Hazvisati zvakwana: unofanira kuziva imwe hukama pakati pe I ne J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakacherekedza kuti pane ma unknown maviri, I ne J, asi equation imwe chete.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Mu J, ngatitii x=π/2−t. Ipapo dx=−dt, uye kana x ichienda kubva ku0 kusvika ku π/2, t inoenda kubva ku π/2 kusvika ku0. Sezvo sin(π/2−t)=cos t ne cos(π/2−t)=sin t, J=∫_{π/2}^{0} sin t/(sin t+cos t)·(−dt)=∫_0^{π/2} sin t/(sin t+cos t) dt, iyo inoenzana ne I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: I=J uye I+J=π/2, saka I=π/4 (anenge 0.785). Izvi zvinowirirana zvakanaka nekufungidzira kwekutanga kwe 0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakashandisa equations mbiri I=J ne I+J=π/2 pamwe chete. Inowirirananewo nekufungidzira kwekutanga kwe 0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakavhiringidza kukosha kwe I+J nekukosha kwe I. J inosanganisirawo huwandu hwakafanana.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakavhiringidza kukwirira papoindi imwe yepakati nekukosha kwe definite integral. Unofanira kuwanza kukwirira nekureba kwechikamu.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga kufungidzira chete ndiko kwaigoneka, uye kunyange mushure mekuwana equation ye I+J, zvakanga zvakakosha kuti "kupatsanura nehafu" kwakanga kuchiri nokukurumidza. Mushure mekuti kutsiva kwapa hukama J=I ndipo I yakasarudzwa. Nekushandisa kuenzana kwechikamu mu definite integral, unogona kuwana kukosha pasina kuwana antiderivative.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.prompt: Kana ukatsiva x=π/2−t mu J, dx=−dt, asi J inova +I panzvimbo ye −I. Tsanangura kuti sei, uchitarisa miganho yeintegration (yepamusoro nepasi).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga kukosha kwe t kunoenderana ne x=0 ne x=π/2, uye unyore miganho yepamusoro nepasi yeintegral itsva.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kuti chii chinoitika kuchiratidzo kana ukadzosera definite integral ine muganho wepamusoro uri pasi pemuganho wepasi kunzira yakajairika.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso Chiratidzo chekubvisa kubva pa dx=−dt ...
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora iwe pachako here kuti mushure mekutsiva muganho wepasi ndi π/2 uye muganho wepamusoro ndi 0?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.0: Sezvo x ichienda kubva pa 0 kusvika pa π/2, t inoenda kubva pa π/2 kusvika pa 0, saka miganho yepamusoro nepasi yeintegral yakachinjaniswa. Kudzosera chikamu kunoshandura chiratidzo, uye pamwe chete nekubvisa kubva pa dx=−dt zviratidzo zvinodzimana, saka J=+I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.1: Mushure mekutsiva, chikamu chakadzoserwa, kubva pa π/2 kusvika pa 0. Kugadzirisa chikamu chakadzoserwa kunogadzira chiratidzo chimwe chekubvisa, uye icho nechekubvisa kubva pa dx=−dt zvinodzimana, saka chiratidzo chinopedzisira chakanaka.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza definite integral ine kukosha kunogona kuwanikwa nenzira imwe chete yakashandiswa kuwana I (tsiva x ne π/2−x uye uwedzere chirevo chakabatana).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, nyora kuti chii chinoitika kuchikamu nekudenominator kana x ikatsiviwa ne π/2−x.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana numerator nedenominator zvichiva zvakaenzana kana ukawedzera chirevo chepakutanga nechirevo chakatsiviwa.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.a: Kana chikamu chiri [0,π/3], saka x ne π/2−x hazvina kubatanidzwa mukati mechikamu chimwe chete, saka nzira iri pamusoro haishande sezvayakaita.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.b: Denominator haina kuenzana, saka kunyange ukawedzera chirevo chakabatana fraction haipfupisi kuva nhamba imwe chete.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.c: Wakaona kuti kutsiva x ne π/2−x kunochinjanisa sin³ ne cos³, uye kuti huwandu hwezvirevo zviviri ndi 1.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.d: Denominator inova 0 mukati mechikamu (pa x=3π/4), saka definite integral haina kunyange kutsanangurwa.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.explain: Mu c, chikamu [0,π/2] chinoenda kuchoga pasi pe x→π/2−x, uye denominator sin³x+cos³x yakaenzana, saka kuwedzera chirevo chakabatana kunopa 1. Saka kukosha ndi π/4. Dambudziko mu a ndechikamu, mu b kuenzana kwedenominator, uye mu d poindi apo denominator iri 0 (3π/4).

n-m-h3-est-05.title: Kutsanangurira Shamwari Zvakarurama Musiyano Wemasample Means Emaguta Maviri
n-m-h3-est-05.goal: Kana sample means mbiri dzakasiyana zvishoma chete, verenga confidence intervals kuti utarise kuyambukirana, wobva wanyora patsva chirevo nemashoko asingazivise anokunda, uye utsanangurire shamwari.
n-m-h3-est-05.material: Nyaya yepepanhau yemuno: "Vadzidzi vesekondari muGuta A vanoshandisa smartphone kwenguva yepakati yemaawa 3.4 pazuva, refu kupfuura Guta B (maawa 3.1). Vadzidzi veGuta A vanoishandisa kwenguva refu." Mumaguta ose maviri, vadzidzi 100 vakasarudzwa nemukana, nguva yekushandisa inotevera normal distribution, uye population standard deviation inozivikanwa kuva maawa 1.5 mumaguta ose maviri.
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.0: Verenga confidence intervals iwe pachako uye uzvifananidze
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.1: Siyanisa musiyano wepoint estimates nekuyambukirana kweintervals
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.2: Nyora patsva kururamisa kuti kuenderane nemunhu anokugamuchira
n-m-h3-est-05.prereq.0: Confidence interval yepopulation mean kubva kunormal distribution ine population standard deviation inozivikanwa
n-m-h3-est-05.prereq.1: Kukosha kwe z kwe95% confidence, kunenge 1.96
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.prompt: Wana 95% confidence interval yepopulation mean yeguta rega rega uye uise makoshero akadzikwa pa decimal place yechitatu (saka, kumadecimal places maviri). (Guta A: miganhu yepazasi nepamusoro; Guta B: miganhu yepazasi nepamusoro)
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wawana standard deviation yesample mean yeguta rimwe, 1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.1: Wanza kukosha uku ne1.96 kuti uwane margin of error, wobva waiwedzera nekuibvisa kubva pasample mean yeguta rega rega.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.fail.c1: Interval yeGuta A haina kururama. Tarisa 3.4 ± 1.96×1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Interval yeGuta B haina kururama. Tarisa 3.1 ± 1.96×1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.explain: Sample mean ± 1.96×1.5/√100 = ± 0.294, saka Guta A i3.106 kusvika 3.694 uye Guta B i2.806 kusvika 3.394. Kana usingapatsanuri ne √n, seye 3.4±1.96×1.5, interval yakapamhama zvakanyanya, uye kana ukashandisa z=1.645, unowana 90% interval.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.prompt: Kutarisa confidence intervals mbiri, sarudza kutonga kunokodzera zvikuru pamusoro pepepanhau.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.hint.0: Dhirowa ma interval maviri panumber line uye utarise kana achiyambukirana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana kukosha kuri muchikamu chinoyambukirana kungava population mean yemaguta ose maviri.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.a: Guta A rakareba, nokuti sample mean yaro yakakura ne0.3 maawa.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.a: Wakaenzanisa hukuru hwe sample means chete. Sample mean inochinja kubva pa sample kuenda pa sample, saka kana ukaverenga error, nhevedzano inogona kudzoserwa.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.b: Zvakaoma kutaura nechokwadi kuti Guta A rakareba; ma intervals anopindirana, saka angachaenzana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.c: Maguta maviri akafanana, nekuti ma intervals maviri anopindirana, saka ma population means anogona kutorwa seakaenzana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.c: Wakaverenga kupindirana sehumbowo hwe "akafanana." Kupindirana kunoreva kuti kuenzana kuchiri kugoneka; hakusimbisi kuti akaenzana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.d: Hazvigone kutongwa; nevadzidzi 100 chete pagutawo rimwe nerimwe, hapana kuenzanisa kune zvakakosha.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.d: Sample diki hairatidzi kuti interval haina basa. Ichiri kukuudza kuti ma means ari mukati merenji ipi.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.explain: Ma intervals maviri, 2.806 kusvika 3.394 ne 3.106 kusvika 3.694, anopindirana kubva pa 3.106 kusvika 3.394. Kupindirana i kutarisa kukurumidza chete; nezvakanyatsonaka, unofanira kutarisa kana 95% interval yemusiyano wema means maviri iine 0. Pano interval yemusiyano i anenge −0.12 kusvika 0.72, iyo ine 0, saka zvakaoma kupedza kuti Guta A rakareba. Asi hazvina kuratidzwawo kuti ma means maviri akaenzana.

Zvichienderana nekuverenga kwema intervals pamusoro, nyora meseji yekugadzirisa mumitsara miviri kana mitatu, mumashoko anogona kunzwisiswa neshamwari yechikoro chepamusoro.
