n-m-h3-integc-02.title: Kugadzira Ma Cubic Function Akasiyana Ane Definite Integral 4
n-m-h3-integc-02.topic: Integration: maitiro e ma definite integral — kubvisana kwema odd-degree term pa symmetric interval
n-m-h3-integc-02.goal: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti ma definite integral e odd-degree term pa symmetric interval ndi0 kugadzira ma function akasiyana ane definite integral imwe chete, uye utsanangure chimiro.
n-m-h3-integc-02.material: Funga definite integral ye cubic function f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d pa [−1,1]. (x³ zvinoreva x yakaitwa cube, uye ∫_{-1}^{1} ndiyo definite integral kubva ku−1 kusvika ku1.)
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.0: Tarisa kuti zvikamu ze expression zvinobvisana pa symmetric interval here
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.1: Gadzira ma function akasiyana anopa definite integral imwe chete
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.2: Tarisa mamiriro apo nzira iyi inogona kushandiswa (symmetric interval, odd degree)
n-m-h3-integc-02.prereq.0: Kuverenga ma definite integral e polynomial function
n-m-h3-integc-02.prereq.1: Kuti chiratidzo chekukosha kwe function chinosiyana sei pa x ne −x
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza ma function ose ane definite integral pa [−1,1] iri 0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa expression imwe neimwe kuita ma term uye uratidze kuti ma term api anochinja sei kana ukatsiva −x panzvimbo ye x.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza expression imwe ine definite integral isiri 0 uye uverenge integral ye term imwe neimwe pa [−1,1] kuti utarise.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.a: Ma even-degree term ane kukosha kwakafanana pa x ne −x, saka haabvisani. Verenga definite integral ye term imwe neimwe yemaviri.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.b: Wakaona kuti pane ma odd-degree term chete, saka makosha pa x ne −x akapesana.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.e: Wakaona kuti pane ma odd-degree term chete, saka makosha pa x ne −x akapesana.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.c: Constant term 1 ine kukosha kwakafanana pa x ne −x, saka haibvisani. Tarisa integral ye constant term.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.d: Term ye x inobvisana asi term ye x² haibvisani. Wakatonga expression yose uchitarisa term imwe chete.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.explain: Kune ma term ane makosha akapesana pa x ne −x (x, x³, x⁵, …), nzvimbo yekuruboshwe neyekurudyi pa [−1,1] dzinosiyana nechiratidzo chete, saka definite integral ndi0. Kune x⁴−x² ndi2/5−2/3, kune x³+1 ndi2, uye kune x²+x ndi2/3, hapana ari 0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.prompt: Ngatitii f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (a, b, c, d ndema integer kubva ku−20 kusvika ku20 zvichibatanidzwa) ne ∫_{-1}^{1} f(x)dx = 4, uye ugadzire f nhatu dzakasiyana dzine term ye x³ ne term ye x chaizvo (a≠0, c≠0). Isa a, b, c, d kune imwe neimwe.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga verenga zvaunowana kana wakaintegrate ax³ ne cx zvakaparadzana pa [−1,1].
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kutanga sarudza (b, d) zvekuti expression yasara 2b/3+2d ienzane ne4, wobva wazadza a ne c nenhamba dzisiri zero.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Ma coefficient ose mana ndema integer ari mukati merenji.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ma coefficient mana anofanira kuva ma integer kubva ku−20 kusvika ku20 zvichibatanidzwa.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana a iri 0, hapana term ye x³.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana c iri 0, hapana term ye x.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.explain: Pa [−1,1], ∫ax³dx=0 ne ∫cx dx=0, saka ∫f(x)dx = 2b/3 + 2d. Kana iri 4, ipapo b+3d=6. Mienzaniso ndi (1,0,2,2), (3,3,−1,1), ne (−2,6,5,0). (1,3,2,2) inopa 2+4=6, kwete 4, uye mienzaniso ine a=0 kana c=0 yabviswa nemamiriro.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Mushure mekuwana f nhatu kana kupfuura dzakasiyana, unoona kuti definite integral inoramba yakadaro kunyangwe a ne c dzichichinja zvakasununguka. Tsanangura kuti nei.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Verenga integral ye ax³ ne cx imwe neimwe pa [−1,1].
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nyora se expression kuti integral yema term akasara inoshandisa b ne d chete here.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakabatanidza here kuti nei x³ ne x dzine definite integral 0 pa [−1,1] nekufanana kwe interval?
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakasimbisa here nekushandisa expression kuti integral inotarwa nemamwe b ne d oga?
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.model.0: ax³ ne cx dzine zviratidzo zvakapesana pa x ne −x, saka pa [−1,1] ma definite integral adzo anobvisana uye ndi0. Saka kukosha kunotarwa chete ne integral dze bx² ne d, 2b/3+2d.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ma definite integral e odd-degree term ax³ ne cx ndi0, saka a ne c hazvigoni kukanganisa kukosha. Chete even-degree b ne constant term d ndizvo zvinokanganisa.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.prompt: Maitiro aya anogona kushandiswa kana interval iri symmetric pamusoro pe0, senge [−1,1]. Sarudza definite integral apo nzira iyi yakakodzera.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kutanga tarisa kuti interval iri pakati pa 0 here, ine hurefu hwakaenzana kuruboshwe nekurudyi.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.hint.1: Wobva watarisa kuti kutsiva x ne −x mu integrand kunochinja chiratidzo chete here.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.a: Wakacherekedza kuti interval iri symmetric pamusoro pe0 uye integrand ine odd-degree term chete.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.b: Integrand ieven function, saka hapana kubvisana kunoitika. Verenga kukosha chaiko.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.c: Interval [0,2] haisi symmetric pamusoro pe0. Kunyangwe kune odd function, interval inofanira kuva symmetric kuti kuruboshwe nekurudyi zvibvisane.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.d: Interval [−1,3] haisi symmetric pamusoro pe0. Unofanira kubata chikamu chine symmetric nechisina symmetric zvakaparadzana.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.explain: ∫_{-2}^{2}(x³−4x)dx ndi0 nekuti interval iri symmetric uye integrand ine odd-degree term chete. [0,2] ne [−1,3] hadzisi symmetric, saka haugoni kutaura pakarepo kuti integral ndi0, uye x²−4 ieven function, saka haibvisani (kukosha ndi−32/3).

n-m-h3-integc-03.title: Vhoriyumu Inogadzirwa Nekutenderedza Ruwa Riri Pakati Pema Curve Maviri: Pakaenda Zvisina Kururama Papi?
n-m-h3-integc-03.topic: Integration: vhoriyumu ye solid inogadzirwa nekutenderedza ruwa riri pakati pema curve maviri (chimiro che cross-section)
n-m-h3-integc-03.goal: Mumhinduro yevhoriyumu ye solid of revolution yeruwa riri pakati pema curve maviri, tsvaga nekugadzirisa mutsara une chimiro che cross-section chisina kururama, uye uratidze kuti expression isina kururama inopa vhoriyumu yeruwa ripi chaizvo.
n-m-h3-integc-03.material: Soyoung akatsvaga vhoriyumu ye solid inogadzirwa nekutenderedza ruwa rakakomberedzwa nema curve maviri y=x ne y=x² kamwe kutenderedza x-axis. (x² zvinoreva x yakaitwa square.)
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.0: Dhirowa chimiro che cross-section papoinzi imwe
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.1: Shanda shure kutsvaga ruwa rinomiririrwa ne expression isina kururama
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.2: Simbisa kukanganisa nekuenzanisa nzvimbo dze cross-section zvakananga
n-m-h3-integc-03.prereq.0: Vhoriyumu ye solid of revolution kutenderedza x-axis
n-m-h3-integc-03.prereq.1: Kudhirowa ruwa riri pakati pema curve maviri
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaSoyoung.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza poinzi imwe senge x=1/2 uye udhirowe kuti ruwa riri kure sei ne x-axis ipapo uye rinotambanukira kupi.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza kuti cross-section yakatenderedzwa idisk yakazara here kana disk ine gomba.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.0: Ma curve y=x ne y=x² anosangana pa x=0 ne x=1, uye pa 0≤x≤1, x≥x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.1: Kana ruwa iri ritenderedzwa kutenderedza x-axis, cross-section pa x idenderedzwa re radius x−x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.2: Saka vhoriyumu ndi V = π∫_0^1 (x−x²)² dx.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiwo unotanga kukanganisa. Kana ruwa riri pakati pema curve maviri ritenderedzwa kutenderedza x-axis, cross-section iwasher, disk ine gomba (outer radius x, inner radius x²). Haisi denderedzwa rine radius isiri musiyano wema radius maviri. Kubva pamutsara 3 zvichienda mberi, kuverenga kunotevera cross-section isina kururama yemutsara 2, saka arithmetic yakarurama asi mhedzisiro haina kururama.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mutsara usina kururama uye utsvage vhoriyumu. Wobva washandisa cross-section pa x=1/2 kutsanangura mumutsara mumwe kana miviri kuti nei expression yaSoyoung isina kururama.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Dhirowa cross-section pa x kuti utarise kuti idenderedzwa hombe re radius x rine denderedzwa diki re radius x² rakabviswa here.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.hint.1: Pa x=1/2, nyora uye uenzanise nzvimbo dzedenderedzwa hombe, denderedzwa diki, nedenderedzwa raSoyoung.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here outer radius ne inner radius ye cross-section pa x uye wakatsvaga nzvimbo yayo?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaenzanisa here nzvimbo ye cross-section yaSoyoung neyakarurama pa x=1/2?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaona here kuti (x−x²)² ne x²−x⁴ zvakasiyana?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.model.0: Cross-section pa x iwasher ine outer radius x ne inner radius x², saka nzvimbo yayo ndi π(x²−x⁴). V=π∫_0^1 (x²−x⁴)dx=π(1/3−1/5)=2π/15. Pa x=1/2 cross-section yakarurama ndi π(1/4−1/16)=3π/16, asi expression yaSoyoung idenderedzwa re radius 1/4, iyo ndi π/16 chete.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.model.1: Cross-section inogadzirwa nekutenderedza ruwa riri pakati pema curve maviri idisk hombe kubvisa disk diki, saka ndi π(x²)−π(x²)², uye vhoriyumu ndi2π/15. Kuita square musiyano wema radius hakufanani nemusiyano wenzvimbo dzemadenderedzwa makuru nemadiki.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.prompt: Expression yakawanikwa naSoyoung, π∫_0^1 (x−x²)² dx, ivhoriyumu yekutenderedza ruwa ripi kamwe kutenderedza x-axis?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.hint.0: π∫_0^1 (function imwe)² dx inoronga ma solid disk ane radius ndi "kukosha kwe function iyoyo." Tsvaga kuti function iyoyo ikukwira kwe curve ipi.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.hint.1: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, nyora chimiro che cross-section pa x kana yatenderedzwa kutenderedza x-axis.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.a: Ruwa rakakomberedzwa ne y=x ne y=x²
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.a: Ruwa iri rinogadzira cross-section ine gomba, saka waifanira kuintegrate π(x²−x⁴). Tarisa cross-section pa x=1/2.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.b: Ruwa rakakomberedzwa ne y=x, x-axis, ne x=1
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.b: Cross-section yeruwa iri idenderedzwa rakazara re radius x, saka inova π∫x²dx.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.c: Ruwa rakakomberedzwa ne y=x², x-axis, ne x=1
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.c: Cross-section yeruwa iri idenderedzwa rakazara re radius x², saka inova π∫x⁴dx.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.d: Ruwa rakakomberedzwa ne y=x−x² ne x-axis
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.d: Wakacherekedza kuti iri ndiro ruwa rinogadzira madenderedzwa akazara ane radius ndiko kukwira kwe curve x−x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.explain: y=x−x² ndi0 kana kupfuura pa 0≤x≤1, uye kana ruwa riri pakati pe curve iyi ne x-axis ritenderedzwa kutenderedza x-axis, cross-section idenderedzwa rakazara re radius x−x². Expression yaSoyoung inopa vhoriyumu yeruwa iri (π/30), uye vhoriyumu yeruwa riri mudambudziko (pakati pema curve maviri) ndi2π/15.

n-m-h3-integc-05.title: Ma Definite Integral eMabasa Anodzokorora: Unofanira Kuziva Chii?
n-m-h3-integc-05.topic: Integration: zvimiro zvema definite integral — ma definite integral emabasa anodzokorora nekusarudza ruzivo runodikanwa
n-m-h3-integc-05.goal: Kana uchiwana definite integral yebasa rinodzokorora, rongera ruzivo runodikanwa (nguva, kukosha pamusoro penguva imwe) kubva pane rusingadikanwi, uye usimbise kuti chakakosha ndechokuti kureba kwechikamu chiri kamu renguva here.
n-m-h3-integc-05.material: Pane basa continuous f. Unoda kuwana kukosha kwe definite integral ∫_2^{11} f(x)dx. (∫_2^{11} ndiyo definite integral kubva pa 2 kusvika pa 11.)
n-m-h3-integc-05.thinking.1: Gadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inosangana nemamiriro
n-m-h3-integc-05.prereq.0: Chimiro chekupatsanura chikamu chema definite integral
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.prompt: f ibasa rinoenderera pamanhamba chaiwo ese. Sarudza zvese zveruzivo pazasi zvinodikanwa chaizvo kusarudza kukosha kwe ∫_2^{11} f(x)dx. (Kuziva zvese zvinodikanwa kunokwana; usasarudze zvisingadikanwi.)
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga kureba kwechikamu [2,11], uye ukamure ne 3 kuona kuti chii chinoitika.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bvisa ruzivo rumwe panguva imwe uye utarise kana kukosha kuchiri kusarudzwa pasina rwo.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.a: Chikamu [0,2] hachipfuurane na [2,11]. Funga kuti kukosha uku kwaizoshandiswa sei kukosha pa [2,11].
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.b: Waona kuti ruzivo urwu runoreva kuti chimiro chimwe chete chinodzokorora mayuniti 3 ega ega, saka runobatanidza makosha pazvikamu zvakasiyana.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.c: Chokwadi chokuti f yakaenzana chinongoreva kuti ine kuenzana kuruboshwe nekurudyi pa 0; hachishandiswi kupatsanura [2,11] kuva zvikamu zvinodzokorora.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.d: Waona kuti unoda kukosha kwe definite integral pachikamu chimwe chinodzokorora kuti usarudze kukosha kwose.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.e: Kukosha kwebasa papoindi imwe hakukanganisi kukosha kwe definite integral.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.explain: Kureba kwe [2,11] ndi 9, iri nguva 3 nguva 3. Zvisinei kuti chikamu chenguva chinotangira papi, definite integral pachikamu chimwe chinodzokorora yakafanana, saka ∫_2^{11} f = 3×6 = 18. Kune izvozvo unoda periodicity (b) nekukosha kwe definite integral pamusoro penguva imwe (d), uye hapana chimwe chinodikanwa.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.prompt: Uchishandisa ruzivo rwokuti nguva ndi 3 uye ∫_0^3 f(x)dx=6 chete, tsvaga zvikamu zviviri [p,q] apo kukosha kwe ∫_p^q f(x)dx kunogona kusarudzwa, uye unyore p ne q. (p ne q ndi nhamba dzakazara, p haisi kamu re 3, 0<p, 4≤q−p≤20, q≤40)
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga, uchishandisa periodicity, funga kuti definite integral pachikamu [1,4], chine kureba 3, yaizova chii.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza (p, q) kuti kureba kwechikamu kwakakamurwa ne 3 kuve nhamba yakazara, uye utarise kuti p haisi kamu re 3.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.ok.c1: p ne q ndi nhamba dzakazara mukati mehuwandu.

n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Kureba kwechikamu kuri pakati pe 4 ne 20 zvichisanganisirwa.

n-m-h3-integc-07.title: Kana Definite Integral Iri Diki, Basa Riri Diki Pese Here?
n-m-h3-integc-07.topic: Integration: zvimiro zvema definite integral — converse yechimiro chekuenzanisa inoshanda here?
n-m-h3-integc-07.goal: Simbisa nekugadzira muenzaniso unopikisa iwe pachako kuti chimiro chekuenzanisa che definite integral chinoenda nenzira imwe chete, uye rongera zvinogona kutaurwa munzira imwe (kuvapo).
n-m-h3-integc-07.material: Uku ndiko kufunga kwaMinsu pamusoro pemabasa maviri f ne g akatsanangurwa pachikamu 0≤x≤2. (∫_0^2 ndiyo definite integral kubva pa 0 kusvika pa 2.)
n-m-h3-integc-07.thinking.2: Shandisa contrapositive kusarudza zvinogona kutaurwa zvechokwadi
n-m-h3-integc-07.prereq.1: Ma definite integral emabasa emutsetse neemabasa akamira
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga apo kufunga kunokanganisa mukufunga kwaMinsu.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.hint.0: Mumitsetse 1 ne 2, tsvaga "pfungwa" ne "mhedziso" mune rimwe nerimwe uye uenzanise kana dzakachinjaniswa.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana mutsetse 3 uchiratidza humbowo hwekuti mutsetse 2 unogara uri wechokwadi, kana muenzaniso mumwe chete.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.0: Kana f(x)≤g(x) pa 0≤x≤2, saka ∫_0^2 f(x)dx ≤ ∫_0^2 g(x)dx.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.1: Zvakapesana, kana ∫_0^2 f(x)dx < ∫_0^2 g(x)dx, saka f(x)<g(x) kune x yega yega pa 0≤x≤2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.2: Semuenzaniso, kana f(x)=x ne g(x)=3, saka ∫_0^2 f(x)dx=2 < 6=∫_0^2 g(x)dx, uye f(x)<g(x) pa 0≤x≤2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 unokanganisa. Chimiro chekuenzanisa che definite integral chinoenda nenzira imwe chete: "kana f≤g pa x yega yega, saka integral ye f ndi 2 kana pasi peintegral ye g." Converse yacho (kana integral iri diki, basa riri diki pa x yega yega) haishande kazhinji. Mutsetse 3 wakangoratidza muenzaniso mumwe apo zvinongoitika kuti zvinoshanda; hausi humbowo hwokuti mutsetse 2 wakarurama.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.prompt: Ratidza nemienzaniso kuti sei mutsetse 2 waMinsu wakanganisa. Kune f(x)=px ne g(x)=q (p ne q ndi nhamba dzakazara kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 30 zvichisanganisirwa), tsvaga maviri matatu (p, q) apo ∫_0^2 f(x)dx < ∫_0^2 g(x)dx asi zvakadaro pane x pa 0≤x≤2 ine f(x)>g(x), uye uanyore.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora ∫_0^2 px dx ne ∫_0^2 q dx nemashoko e p ne q, uye ushandure kuenzanisa kwazvo kuva mamiriro.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.hint.1: f(x)=px inokura x painokura. Nyora mamiriro anoenzanisa f(2) ne g(2) pamagumo echikamu, x=2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p ne q dzinofanira kuva integers kubva ku1 kusvika ku30 zvakasanganisirwa.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Pa x=2, f(2)=2p yakakura kupfuura g(2)=q.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.explain: ∫_0^2 px dx = 2p ne ∫_0^2 q dx = 2q. 2p<2q zvinoreva p<q, uye kuti f(2)=2p ive huru kupfuura g(2)=q pa x=2 unoda q<2p. Saka mienzaniso ine p<q<2p, seye (3,4), (5,7), ne (10,11), ndi counterexamples. (3,6) ine q=2p, saka f(2)=g(2) uye f(x)≤g(x) inoshanda pa x yega yega, saka haisi counterexample.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza rimwe re (p, q) rawakaisa, uye, uchipa kukosha kumwe kwe x apo f(x)>g(x) nemakoshero edefinite integrals mbiri, tsanangura kuti nei iri counterexample kumutsara 2 waMinsu.

n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Verenga makoshero edefinite integrals mbiri uye ufananidze kuti ndeapi akakura.

n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana (p, q)=(3,4), saka ∫_0^2 3x dx=6 ne ∫_0^2 4 dx=8, saka ∫f<∫g. Asi pa x=2, f(2)=6 ne g(2)=4, saka f(2)>g(2). Integral ye f idiki, asi pa x imwe f yakakura, saka i counterexample kumutsara 2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Kune (5,7), madefinite integrals i10 ne14, saka eya f idiki. Asi pa x=2, f(2)=10 yakakura kupfuura g(2)=7. Saka kunyange integral ichidiki, function haidiki pa x yega yega.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.prompt: Fungidzira ∫_0^2 f(x)dx < ∫_0^2 g(x)dx inoshanda. Ndechipi chaunogona kutaura zvechokwadi pasi pemamiriro aya?
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kuti kufananidza kwemadefinite integrals kwaizova chii dai wafungidzira "f≥g pa x yega yega."
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti mhedziso ipi inosara kana mhedzisiro iyoyo ichipesana nemamiriro akapiwa.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.o.a: Pane x imwe chete kana pamusoro mu interval apo f(x)<g(x).
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.a: Wakashandisa contrapositive yechivakwa chekuti kana f≥g pa x yega yega, saka integral ye f inofanira kuva yakaenzana kana pamusoro peintegral ye g.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.b: Haugoni kusarudza kukosha papoinzi imwe x=1 kubva pakufananidza madefinite integrals. Unogonawo kuvaka muenzaniso apo f yakakura pa x=1.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.o.c: f(x)<g(x) pa x yega yega mu 0≤x≤2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.c: Counterexample yakagadzirwa kare inoputsa chirevo ichi. Kunyange integral ichidiki, f inogona kuva huru pa x dzimwe.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.o.d: Hapana x mu interval apo f(x)>g(x).
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.d: Mucounterexample, f(2)>g(2) pa x=2. Pangava nemapoinzi apo f yakakura.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.explain: Kana f(x)≥g(x) pa x yega yega, saka ∫f ≥ ∫g yaifanira kushanda. Mamiriro akapiwa ∫f<∫g anopikisa izvi, saka pane x imwe chete kana pamusoro ine f(x)<g(x). Asi haugoni kuziva kuti x iyoyo iri kupi, dzingani, kana kuti pane x dzine f>g.

n-m-h3-integc-06.title: Integration by Parts: Unogona Kusarudza u Nenzira Ipi Neipi Here?
n-m-h3-integc-06.topic: Integration: mwero wekusarudza u ne v' mu integration by parts
n-m-h3-integc-06.goal: Simbisa kuti kuoma kweintegral inosara kunoenderana nekusarudza u ne v' mu integration by parts, uye utsanangure mwero wekusarudza nemazwi anonzwisiswa neshamwari.
n-m-h3-integc-06.material: Hajun akaita integration by parts pa ∫ x eˣ dx ne u=eˣ ne v'=x, uye chirevo chakava chakaoma zvikuru. Hajun anoti, "Haugoni kusarudza u ne v' nenzira ipi neipi mu integration by parts here?" (eˣ ndi e kusimba x, uye ln x ndiyo natural logarithm ye x.)
n-m-h3-integc-06.thinking.0: Enzanisa kuti integral inosara inoshanduka sei zvichienderana nesarudzo
n-m-h3-integc-06.thinking.1: Seta mwero wekusarudza (inova nyore kana yaitwa derivative / iri nyore kuita integral)
n-m-h3-integc-06.prereq.1: Ma derivative nema integral emabasa e logarithmic ne exponential
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.prompt: Hajun akaita integration by parts pa ∫ x eˣ dx ne u=eˣ ne v'=x. Ndechipi pazvinotevera chinotsanangura zvinoitika nesarudzo iyi?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ne u=eˣ ne v'=x, tsvaga u' ne v iwe pachako uye unyore integral iri kudivi rekurudyi refomula uv − ∫u'v dx.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa integral yepakutanga neintegral inosara uye utarise kuti simba re x rakashanduka sei.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.a: Integral inosara ine x², saka simba re x chaizvo rinokwira.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.a: Waona kuti kana u ne v' dzikachinjaniswa, kuita integral ye v' kunokwidza simba, uye semhedzisiro integral inosara inogona kuva yakaoma kupfuura yepakutanga.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.b: Integral inosara inova 0, saka mhinduro inobuda pakarepo.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.b: Kuti integral inosara ive 0, u'v yaifanira kuva 0. Tsvaga u' ne v iwe pachako uye utarise.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.c: Fomula ye integration by parts haishande, saka haigoni kugadziriswa.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.c: Fomula inoshanda zvisinei kuti unotora chinhu chipi se u. Chinoshanduka kuoma kweintegral inosara.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.d: Integral inosara ingori eˣ, saka inova nyore zvikuru.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.d: Chinosara chibereko che u'=eˣ ne v=x²/2. Tsvaga u' ne v iwe pachako.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.explain: Ne u=eˣ ne v'=x, u'=eˣ uye v=x²/2, saka ∫ x eˣ dx = (x²/2)eˣ − ∫ (x²/2)eˣ dx. Integral inosara ine x kusimba rakakwira nerimwe kupfuura yepakutanga, saka yakava yakaoma. Fomula inoshanda, asi sarudzo yakanga isina kunaka. Kana ukatora u=x ne v'=eˣ, integral inosara ingori ∫ eˣ dx.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kuwana ∫ x ln x dx uchishandisa integration by parts. Sarudza zano rakakodzera rekupa Hajun.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, tanga watarisa kana unogona kuwana v pakarepo.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa kana chibereko che u' ne v chiri nyore kupfuura integral yepakutanga.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.a: Chakareruka zvakanyanya kutora u=x ne v'=ln x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.a: Kuwana v kubva pa v'=ln x hakusi pakarepo (v=x ln x−x). Integral inosara inosanganisirawo ln x uye haiiti nyore.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.b: Chakareruka zvakanyanya kutora u=1 ne v'=x ln x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.b: Kuwana antiderivative ye v'=x ln x kwakafanana nedambudziko repakutanga, saka hapana kufambira mberi.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.c: Chakareruka zvakanyanya kutora u=ln x ne v'=x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.c: Wakatora chinhu chinova nyore kana chaitwa derivative (ln x) se u uye chinhu chiri nyore kuita integral (x) se v'.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.d: Hapana musiyano kuti unosarudza sei, sezvo integral inosara yakaoma zvakaenzana, saka sarudza chero.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.d: Zvichienderana nesarudzo, integral inosara inogona kuva nyore kana yakaoma. Rangarira ruzivo rwaHajun mudanho rapfuura.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.explain: Ne u=ln x ne v'=x, u'=1/x uye v=x²/2, uye ∫ x ln x dx = (x²/2)ln x − ∫ (x/2) dx = (x²/2)ln x − x²/4 + C. Integral inosara chirevo chemutsetse mu x, saka iri nyore. Mwero wesarudzo yakanaka ndeokutora chinhu chinova nyore kana chaitwa derivative (ln x → 1/x) se u, uye chinhu chiri nyore kuita integral (x) se v'.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mhinduro kuna Hajun. Hajun akati, "Haugoni kusarudza u ne v' nenzira ipi neipi mu integration by parts here?" Uchishandisa ∫ x ln x dx semuenzaniso, tsanangura nemazwi akareruka kuti ungasarudza sei zvakanaka uye nei.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.hint.0: Mu ∫ x ln x dx, tsvaga kuti ndechipi pa ln x ne x chinova nyore kana chaitwa derivative uye ndechipi chiri nyore kuita integral.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kuti integral inosara ndeyei neiyi sarudzo, uye uishandise sehumbowo hwekuratidza Hajun.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here mwero wekusarudza, mumutsara mumwe, panzvimbo pe "nenzira ipi neipi"?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakashandisa here mwero ku ∫ x ln x dx chaizvo?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora here nemazwi aunogona Hajun kunzwisisa (kwete rondedzero yezviratidzo chete)?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.model.0: Hajun, fomula inoshanda zvisinei kuti unosarudza sei, asi kuti integral inosara inova nyore here kwakasiyana. Kune ∫ x ln x dx, unofanira kutora u=ln x ne v'=x. ln x inova nyore, 1/x, kana yaitwa derivative, uye x iri nyore kuita integral. Ipapo integral inosara inova ∫ x/2 dx iri nyore.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.model.1: Edza u=ln x ne v'=x. Mwero ndeokutora chinhu chinova nyore kana chaitwa derivative se u uye chinhu chiri nyore kuita integral se v'. Ipapo integral inosara ingori x/2, inogadziriswa nekukurumidza. Kana ukatora u=x panzvimbo peizvozvo, unofanira kutanga nekuita integral ye ln x, iyo yakaoma.
