n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa danho nedanho. Padanho rega rega, sarudza kutonga uchishandisa zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva runooneka, tarisa kuti rate yeboka ripi rauri kuenzanisa.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga rate yose nerate yekirasi imwe neimwe, uye funga kuti ndeipi inoenzanisa vadzidzi vari mumamiriro akafanana.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Pachikoro chimwe, vadzidzi vakasarudza study app A kana B pachavo uye vakaishandisa kwe semester imwe. Pavadzidzi 200 vakashandisa A, 132 vakawedzera ma grades avo, uye pavadzidzi 200 vakashandisa B, 152 vakawedzera.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: App ipi inoratidzika kuva nemhedzisiro yakawanda pakuvandudza ma grades?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Rate yose inoratidzika yakakwirira kuna B. Asi kana tisingazive kana mapoka maviri evadzidzi i erudzi rumwechete, zvichiri nekukurumidza kupedza chero chii nezvemhedzisiro dzema apps kubva panhamba idzi oga.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: B: nekuti chikamu chevadzidzi vakavandudza ma grades chakakwirira
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakaenzanisa ma rates ose (66% ne 76%) sezvaakaita. Uku ndiko kutonga kwekutanga kunouya mupfungwa.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A: kunyange vadzidzi vashoma vakashandisa A vakavandudza, nekuti pamwe vadzidzi vanonetseka ndivo vakaishandisa
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafungidzira pasina humbowo kuti vashandisi va A i vadzidzi vanonetseka. Hatigone kuziva kuumbwa kwevadzidzi zvino.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zvichiri nekukurumidza kutaura: nekuti hatizive rudzi rwevadzidzi rwakashandisa app imwe neimwe
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakaziva kuti ruzivo rwakawanda rwunodiwa kunze kwema rates.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Vadzidzi vakapatsanurwa kuita kirasi yepamusoro nekirasi yekutanga uye vakaverengwa zvakare. App A: 36 pa 40 mukirasi yepamusoro ne 96 pa 160 mukirasi yekutanga vakavandudza. App B: 136 pa 160 mukirasi yepamusoro ne 16 pa 40 mukirasi yekutanga vakavandudza.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino, app ipi inoratidzika kuva nemhedzisiro yakawanda?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Mukirasi yepamusoro i 36/40=90% vs 136/160=85%, uye mukirasi yekutanga i 96/160=60% vs 16/40=40%. Rate ya A i yakakwirira mumakirasi ose maviri, asi B yaiita sekunge yakakwirira zvose. Rate yose nema rates ekirasi nekirasi zvinogona kunongedza kumativi akapesana.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: B: rate yayo yose i yakakwirira, saka nhamba dzakapatsanurwa nekirasi hadzina basa
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kunyange data yakapatsanurwa nekirasi yakapiwa, wakatarisa rate yose chete. Hauna kushandisa kuenzanisa pakati pevadzidzi vari mukirasi imwechete.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: A: rate ya A i yakakwirira mukirasi yepamusoro (90% ne 85%) nemukirasi yekutanga (60% ne 40%)
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakaenzanisa vadzidzi vari mukirasi imwechete kutarisa mhedzisiro ye app zvakaparadzana.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zvakafanana: A inotungamira mukirasi imwe uye B mukumwe, saka zvinodzimana
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: A inotungamira mumakirasi ose maviri, asi wakaverenga seB ichitungamira mukirasi imwe. Enzanisa nhamba zvakare.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Vadzidzi vakasarudza ma apps pachavo. Pavadzidzi 200 vakashandisa A, 160 vaiva mukirasi yekutanga, nepo pavadzidzi 200 vakashandisa B, 40 chete vaiva mukirasi yekutanga.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Pakupedzisira, mhedziso ipi inokodzera zvikuru kuitwa kubva pa data iyi?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kirasi yekutanga i boka rine rate yakadzika yekuvandudza ma grades chero app ipi yashandiswa, uye vadzidzi vacho vakaunganidzwa kuna A, izvo zvakadzikisa rate yose ya A. Mukati mekirasi imwechete A inotungamira, asi sezvo vadzidzi vakasarudza ma apps pachavo, kune muganhu wekupedza kuti iyi i mhedzisiro ye app.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: A inoratidzika kuva nemhedzisiro yakawanda. Rate yayo yose i yakadzika nekuti vadzidzi vakawanda vekirasi yekutanga vakaishandisa; mukati mekirasi imwechete A inotungamira, asi zvichiri nekukurumidza kuva nechokwadi
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakatonga nekuenzanisa mukati mekirasi imwechete, uye wakataurawo muganhu wekuti data inobva pakusarudza kwevadzidzi pachavo.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: B inoratidzika kuva nemhedzisiro yakawanda. Rate yayo yose yema grades akavandudzwa i yakakwirira, asi zvichiri nekukurumidza kuva nechokwadi
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatevera rate yose chete. Hauna kushandisa ruzivo rwekuti vadzidzi vekirasi yekutanga vakaunganidzwa kuna A, izvo zvakadzikisa rate yayo yose.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Hatigone kutaura kana kudaro kana kudaro. Kupatsanura nekirasi kwakadzorera mhedzisiro, saka data yose haigone kuvimbwa, uye zvichiri nekukurumidza kuva nechokwadi
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakarasa zvose nekuti data yakadzoserwa. Kuenzanisa mukati mekirasi imwechete kuchiri kupa ruzivo.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga wakatonga kubva pama rates ose kuti B yaiva nani, asi vadzidzi vakangopatsanurwa kuita mapoka, mhedziso yakadzoserwa. "Rate yekuvandudza pakati pevadzidzi vakashandisa app A" ne "rate yekuvandudza pakati pevadzidzi vekirasi yekutanga vakashandisa app A" i conditional probabilities dzakasiyana. Kuenzanisa, tanga watarisa kana mapoka anoenzaniswa aine kuumbwa kumwechete.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangura kushamwari yakatanga yakafunga kuti "B ine mhedzisiro yakawanda" nei rate yose i yakakwirira kuna B nepo ma rates ekirasi nekirasi akakwirira kuna A, uye kuti kuenzanisa kunofanira kuitwa sei.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga kuti vazhinji vevadzidzi vakashandisa A nevakashandisa B vari mukirasi ipi, uye uenzanise.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.hint.1: Batanidza kuti vadzidzi vekirasi ipi vanovandudza nyore zvikuru nekuti vazhinji vavo vakashandisa app ipi.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaratidza kuti kuumbwa kwevashandisi va A kwakasiyana nekwevashandisi va B here?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura nei kuenzanisa mukati mekirasi imwechete kuri kwakarurama zvakanyanya here?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakabatanidza chikonzero chekuti rate yose nema rates ekirasi zvakasiyana mumutsara mumwe here?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.model.0: Vadzidzi vekirasi yekutanga havavandudzi nyore ne app ipi neipi, uye vazhinji vavo vakaunganidzwa kuna A, saka rate yose ya A yakadzika. Ndosaka uchifanira kuenzanisa mukati mekirasi imwechete kuona mhedzisiro ye app.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.model.1: Vazhinji vevadzidzi vakashandisa A vari mukirasi yekutanga, apo zvakaoma kuvandudza ma grades, saka A inoratidzika yakaipa kana ukatarisa rate yose chete. Kana ukapatsanura nekirasi uye ukaenzanisa pasi pemamiriro akafanana, A i yakakwirira.

n-m-h3-prob-05.topic: Mukana: conditional probability, kuzvimiririra nekusazvimiririra, kufunga kwemhando yeBayes, kugadzira sample space
n-m-h3-prob-05.title: Misoro Mishanu Zvichitevana: Mikoyo Yava Nguva Here?
n-m-h3-prob-05.goal: Ziva pfungwa isina kururama nezve mukana mushure mekutevedzana kwemhedzisiro, uye wobva wataura zvakare pfungwa imwechete kuti munun'una wechikoro chepakati anzwisise.
n-m-h3-prob-05.material: Munun'una wako aitamba koini yakarurama uye akati, "Misoro yabuda ka5 zvichitevana! Handizvi nguva yemikoyo here?" Koini yakarurama: misoro nemikoyo zvine mukana wakaenzana. Munun'una wako ari mu 7th grade.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.prompt: Wakakanda koini yakarurama uye wakawana misoro ka5 zvichitevana. Chirevo chipi chakarurama nezve mukana wemisoro pakukanda kwechitanhatu?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kana koini inorangarira kukanda kwapfuura kana kuedza kudzikinura.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti zvatiri kufungidzira zvakasiyana sei pakati pe "kana tisingazive kukanda kwekutanga 5" ne "mushure mekunge misoro 5 yekutanga yaitika."
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.a: Koini iyi inowanzowira pamisoro, saka mukana wemisoro i mukuru kupfuura 1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.r.a: Kunyange koini yakarurama, wakafunga kuti mhedzisiro dzapfuura dzinochinja hunhu hwekoini.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.b: Misoro yabuda kakawanda, saka zvino i nguva yemikoyo, uye mukana wemisoro i mudiki kupfuura 1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga kuti mhedzisiro dzapfuura dzinofanira "kudzikinurwa." Koini hairangariri mhedzisiro dzapfuura uye kuzvigadzirisa kuti dzienderane.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.c: Zvisinei nemhedzisiro dzekukanda kwekutanga 5, mukana wekuti kukanda kwechitanhatu i misoro unoramba uri 1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.d: Mukana wemisoro 6 zvichitevana i 1/64, saka mukana wemisoro pakukanda kwechitanhatu i 1/64 zvakare.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakasanganisa mukana wekufungidzira kukanda kwose kutanhatu kubva pakutanga nemukana wekufungidzira kukanda kumwe mushure mekunge kwekutanga 5 kwaitika.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.explain: Kukanda kwega kwega kwekoini yakarurama kwakazvimirira, saka kunyange tichiziva mhedzisiro dzapfuura, mukana wemisoro pakukanda kwechitanhatu i 1/2. Mukana 1/64 wemisoro 6 zvichitevana i mutengo wekufungidzira kukanda kwose kutanhatu tisati takanda; pasi pemamiriro ekuti misoro 5 yekutanga yatoitika, i (1/64)÷(1/32)=1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kutsanangura kumunun'una wako we 7th-grade "nei kukanda kwechitanhatu kuchinewo 50-50 misoro kana mikoyo." Sarudza tsananguro yakakodzera zvikuru.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kune tsananguro imwe neimwe, nyora mumutsetse mumwe kuti munun'una wako angati chii zvinotevera.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa zvakaparadzana kana zvirimo zvakarurama uye kana munun'una wako angazvitaura zvichinzwisisika.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.o.a: Sezvo zviitiko zvakazvimirira, P(H6 | H1~H5) = P(H6) = 1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.r.a: Pane zviratidzo nemashoko mazhinji, saka zvakaoma kuti munun'una wako atevere. Hazvina danho rekutaura zvakare zvirimo zvimwechete nemutauro wezuva nezuva.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.o.b: Koini haigone kurangarira mhedzisiro dzapfuura. Unoikanda itsva nguva yega yega, saka kukanda kwechitanhatu kuchinewo 50-50 misoro kana mikoyo.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.o.c: Kana ukakanda kakawanda zvakakwana inozoenzana pa 50-50, saka panguva ino mikoyo ine mukana mukuru zvishoma.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.r.c: Wakaverenga "inozoenzana" sekuti kukanda kunotevera kunodzikinura misoro. Izvi chaizvo zvinosimbisa pfungwa isina kururama.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.o.d: Mishanu zvichitevana i inoshamisa chaizvo. Kana wechitanhatu i misoro zvakare, unofanira kufungidzira koini iyi.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.r.d: Izvi zvinoramba mamiriro ekuti koini i yakarurama. Tsananguro iyi haipindure pfungwa isina kururama yemunun'una wako.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.explain: Tsananguro yakanaka inotaura zvakare zvirimo zvimwechete nemashoko anozivikanwa nemunun'una. B inoisa zvinoreva independence mumashoko akareruka ne "haikanganwi" ne "unoikanda itsva nguva yega yega"; A yakarurama asi zviratidzo zvayo zvakaoma; C inosimbisa pfungwa isina kururama; uye D inoramba mamiriro ekuti koini i yakarurama.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.prompt: Munun'una wako anobvunza, "Asi mukana wemisoro 6 zvichitevana i 1/64 chete. Saka kana wechitanhatu i misoro zvakare, iyo i yakashomeka chaizvo!" Pindura nemashoko akareruka kuti munun'una wako anzwisise. (Edza kusashandisa zviratidzo kana mashoko sa P( ) kana "conditional.")
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mumutsara mumwe "riini" mukana 1/64 unoshanda. Ndiyo pamberi pekukanda, kana mushure mekunge 5 abuda?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kuti kukanda kungani kwasara zvino, uye utaure mukana wekuti kukanda kumwe uku i misoro.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti 1/64 i mukana riini (kana uchifungidzira kukanda kwose kutanhatu pamberi pekukanda) here?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti mukana zvino, nekukanda kwechitanhatu chete kwasara, i 1/2 here?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakatsanangura uchishandisa mashoko anozivikanwa nemunun'una wako chete here?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.model.0: 1/64 i mukana wekuti kukanda kwose kutanhatu i misoro, wakaverengwa usati watanga kukanda. Zvino kutanga 5 kwatoitika uye kukanda kwechitanhatu chete kwasara, saka pakukanda kumwe uku, misoro nemikoyo zvine mukana wakaenzana.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.model.1: Kukanda kwekutanga 5 kwatopera, uye koini haikurangarira. Saka kukanda kwechitanhatu kuri misoro kana mikoyo nemukana mumwechete we 1/2. 1/64 i mukana wekuwana kutanhatu kwose zvakarurama pamberi, saka i wakasiyana nemamiriro azvino.

n-m-h3-prob-06.topic: Mukana: conditional probability, kuzvimiririra nekusazvimiririra, kufunga kwemhando yeBayes, kugadzira sample space
n-m-h3-prob-06.title: Ma Multiples Pamakadhi: Kuwana Mapeya Akazvimirira
n-m-h3-prob-06.goal: Wana iwe pachako mapeya ezviitiko zvakawanda zvakazvimirira, uye utsanangure nekuverenga kuti kuva relatively prime hakukwani kune independence.
n-m-h3-prob-06.material: Unodhonza kadhi rimwe kubva pamakadhi 20 akanyorwa 1 kusvika 20. Seunghyeon akafungidzira kuti chiitiko che "multiple ye p" nechiitiko che "multiple ye q" zvaizova zvakazvimirira chero p ne q dziri relatively prime.
n-m-h3-prob-06.thinking.2: Kutsanangura counterexample apo nhamba i relatively prime asi hadzizvimiriri
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.prompt: Unodhonza kadhi rimwe kubva pamakadhi 20 akanyorwa 1 kusvika 20. Ngatitii A i chiitiko chekudhonza multiple ye 3 uye B multiple ye 4. Mukana P(A∩B) wekuti zviitiko zvose zviviri zviitike pamwe chete i upi?
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora makadhi ose ari ma multiples e 3 nemakadhi ose ari ma multiples e 4.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.hint.1: Wana kuti makadhi api anooneka mundandanda dzose.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.o.a: 0: hapana kadhi i multiple ye 3 ne 4 zvose
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti nekuti 3 ne 4 i relatively prime, hapana makadhi anopindirana. Asi 12 i multiple ye 3 ne 4 zvose.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.r.c: Hauna kuverenga ma common multiples uye wakashandisa mutengo we 3×4 se denominator. Hauna kushandisa chokwadi chekuti kune makadhi 20 chete.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.o.d: 1/2: chikamu chemakadhi ari ma multiples e 3 kana ma multiples e 4
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.explain: Ma multiples e 3 i 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 (makadhi 6), ma multiples e 4 i 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 (makadhi 5), uye kadhi rimwe chete, 12, riri mune zvose. Saka P(A∩B)=1/20, nepo P(A)P(B)=6/20×5/20=3/40. Mitengo miviri yakasiyana, saka A ne B hazvizvimiriri.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.prompt: Kune natural number p, q ne 2 ≤ p < q ≤ 20, tsvaga uye uise mapeya (p, q) 3 akasiyana kana kupfuura apo A = "multiple ye p" ne B = "multiple ye q" zvinozvimiririra.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga kuti kadhi mangani pa makadhi 20 ari ma multiple e p, ma multiple e q, nema common multiple e p ne q, uye uenzanise 20×(huwandu hwemakadhi ari ose maviri) ne (huwandu hwema multiple e p)×(huwandu hwema multiple e q).
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga nekuverenga mapeya madiki nemaoko, uye utsvage zvinofanana nemapeya anoshanda.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Hadzizvimiriri. Verenga ma multiple e p, ma multiple e q, nemakadhi ari ose maviri, uye uenzanise P(A∩B) ne P(A)P(B).
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.explain: Nemakadhi 20, mapeya anogoneka ndiwo mapeya mashanu (2,3), (2,5), (2,7), (2,9), (4,5). Semuenzaniso, (2,5) ine ma multiple e2 10, ma multiple e5 4, uye ma multiple e10 2, saka 20×2=40=10×4 inoshanda. (3,4) ine relatively prime, asi 20×1=20 ne 6×5=30, saka haizvimiriri, uye (2,4) inopa 20×5=100 ne 10×5=50, saka haizvimiriri.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.prompt: p=3, q=4 ndedze relatively prime (common divisor yavo yega ndi1), asi hadzizvimiriri. Ratidza nekuverenga kuti nei hadzizvimiriri, uye utaure zvakasiyana ne (2, 5), iyo inozvimiririra.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora kuti makadhi mangani pamakadhi 20 ari ma multiple e3, e4, ne e12, uye uverenge product.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Verenga huwandu hwakafanana kune (2, 5), uenzanise, uye utarise kuti 20 inoparadzaniswa zvakaenzana ne common multiple here.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Pane ma multiple e3 6, uye ma multiple e4 ari ...
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here ma multiple e3 6, ma multiple e4 5, nekadhi 1 riri ose maviri, uye wakaenzanisa makosha maviri?
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here kuti nei kuverenga kumwe chete kuchishanda kune (2,5)?
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakadzivisa here kupedzisa kuti "relatively prime inoreva kuzvimirira"?
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Pane ma multiple e3 6, ma multiple e4 5, uye kadhi rimwe chete, 12, riri ose maviri. P(A∩B)=1/20, asi P(A)P(B)=6/20×5/20=3/40, saka haaenzani. Kune (2,5), common multiple ndi10 uye 20 imultiple ye10, saka huwandu hwemakadhi hunokodzera zvakakwana uye product inoshanda.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.model.1: 12 chete ndiyo inopindirana, saka P(A∩B) ndi chimwe pamakumi maviri, asi 6/20×5/20 ndi3/40, saka dzakasiyana. Kune 2 ne5, pane ma multiple e10 2 mukati me20, saka 10×4=20×2 inoshanda, asi kune 3 ne4, 12 haisi divisor ye20, saka haikodzeri.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.model.2: Pane ma multiple e3 6, ma multiple e4 5, uye kadhi rimwe chete, 12, riri ose maviri. Dai dzaizvimiririra raifanira kuva 6×5÷20=1.5 makadhi, asi ndi1, saka hazvienderani. Kune (2,5), 10×4÷20=2 makadhi, nhamba yakazara, saka inokodzera zvakakwana.

n-m-h3-prob-07.topic: Mukana: conditional probability, kuzvimiririra nekusazvimiririra, kufunga kwemhando yeBayes, kugadzira sample space
n-m-h3-prob-07.title: Bhora Rekutanga Ratisati Taona: Probability Yebhora Rechipiri Ndeyei?
n-m-h3-prob-07.goal: Tarisa kuti ma probability anochinja sei nemamiriro kana ruzivo ruchiratidzwa danho nedanho, uye unzwisise kuti ruzivo rwunodzidzwa shure runogona kuchinja probability yekudhonza kwekutanga.
n-m-h3-prob-07.material: Unoita chiitiko chiri pazasi uchishandisa ma bhora ari mubhegi. Kana bhora rabuda harizodzoserwi, uye bhora rega rega rine mukana wakaenzana wekudhonzwa.
n-m-h3-prob-07.prereq.0: Product ye ma probability ekudhonza pasina kudzosera
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe. Padanho rimwe nerimwe, sarudza probability uchishandisa zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, tarisa kuti pane chatadzidza nyowani here uye kuti chinochinja zvinhu zvakasara here.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kana pane bhora rausingazivi ruvara rwaro, paradzanisa kuita nyaya neruvara uye uwedzere ma probability enyaya.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Bhegi risingaoneki mukati rine ma bhora tsvuku 3 nema bhora bhuruu 5 (akafanana muchimiro). Mina akabvisa bhora rimwe achariviga padivi asina kutarisa ruvara rwaro. Wobva wabvisa rimwe zvakare mubhegi.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Probability yekuti bhora rechipiri rakabviswa ritsvuku ndeyei?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana probability yekuti bhora rakavigwa ritsvuku ndi3/8, ipapo probability tsvuku yakasara ndi2/7, uye kana probability yekuti ibhuruu ndi5/8, ipapo probability tsvuku yakasara ndi3/7. Saka (3/8)(2/7)+(5/8)(3/7)=21/56=3/8. Kana tisingazivi bhora rekutanga, probability yeruvara rwebhora rechipiri yakafanana nechikamu chekutanga.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 3/7: kuverenga sekunge bhora rakavigwa raiva bhuruu
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakaverenga sekunge ruvara rwebhora rakavigwa rwakatarwa kuva bhuruu. Izvozvi hatizivi ruvara irworwo.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: 3/8: kuparadzanisa kuita nyaya neruvara rwebhora rakavigwa uye kuwedzera kunopa zvakafanana nechikamu chekutanga
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 2/7: kuverenga sekunge bhora rakavigwa raiva tsvuku
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakaverenga sekunge ruvara rwebhora rakavigwa rwakatarwa kuva tsvuku. Izvozvi hatizivi ruvara irworwo.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hazvigoni kutarwa: nekuti hatizivi ruvara rwebhora rakavigwa
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hauna kushandisa nzira yekuparadzanisa kuita nyaya nekuzvibatanidza. Kunyangwe usingazivi ruvara, unogona kuriwana kana uchiziva probability yenyaya imwe neimwe.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Mina akazarura bhora raakanga avaga, uye raiva bhora tsvuku. (Bhora rechipiri harisati ratariswa.)
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino, probability yekuti bhora rechipiri rakabviswa ritsvuku ndeyei?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Zvino zvatinoziva kuti bhora rakavigwa ritsvuku, ma bhora asara ndi2 tsvuku ne5 bhuruu, 7 zvose. Saka probability yekuti bhora rechipiri ritsvuku inodzika kusvika ku2/7.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 3/7: pane ma bhora tsvuku 3 pakati pe7 asara
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaziva kuti bhora rakavigwa raiva tsvuku asi hauna kuratidza kuti huwandu hwema bhora tsvuku hwakadzikira.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Hauna kushandisa ruzivo rwekutarisa bhora rakavigwa. Kana ruzivo ruchiwedzera, zvakaumba ma bhora asara zvinochinja.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.o.c: 2/7: pane ma bhora tsvuku 2 pakati pe7 asara
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Rimwe zuva, unoita zvakare nebhegi rimwe chete. Panguva ino, bhora rekutanga richiri ravigwa, wakazarura bhora rechipiri rakabviswa shure, uye raiva bhora tsvuku. Bhora rekutanga harisati ratariswa.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Probability yekuti bhora rekutanga, raiya ravigwa kare, raiva tsvuku ndeyei?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.after: P(rekutanga tsvuku | rechipiri tsvuku) = P(ose tsvuku)÷P(rechipiri tsvuku) = (3/8×2/7)÷(3/8) = 2/7. Kuziva kuti bhora rechipiri ritsvuku kunoverengwa sekunge bhora rimwe tsvuku rabviswa, saka probability yekuti bhora rekutanga ritsvuku inodzikawo kubva ku3/8 kuenda ku2/7.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 2/7: kana tichiziva kuti bhora rechipiri ritsvuku, probability yekuti bhora rekutanga ritsvuku inodzika
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 3/8: bhora rekutanga rakatodhonzwa, saka kuziva bhora rechipiri hakuchinji
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatora kurongeka kwenguva senzira yeruzivo. Ruzivo rwunodzidzwa shure runogona kuchinja probability yemhedzisiro yekare.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 5/7: bhora rechipiri ritsvuku, saka bhora rekutanga pamwe raiva bhuruu
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Mubvunzo unobvunza probability yekuti bhora rekutanga ritsvuku, asi wakapa probability yekuti ibhuruu. Tarisa kuti makosha maviri anowedzera kusvika ku1 here.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.reflect: Kana taive tisati taona bhora rimwe, probability yebhora rechipiri yaiva 3/8, yakafanana neyekutanga, asi kana taziva bhora rekutanga yakachinja ikava 2/7. Zvakare, kudzidza nezvebhora rakadhonzwa shure kwakachinja probability yebhora rakadhonzwa kare. Conditional probability haitarwi nekurongeka kwenguva asi ne "zvatinoziva."
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangurira shamwari kuti nei probability yekuti bhora rechipiri, rakabviswa tisingazivi ruvara rwebhora rekutanga, ritsvuku ndi3/8. (Iyi ishamwari yakati hazvigoni kuverengwa kana usingazivi ruvara rwebhora rekutanga.)
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora nyaya apo bhora rakavigwa ritsvuku nenyaya apo ibhuruu zvakaparadzana, uye utsvage probability yekuti bhora rechipiri ritsvuku munyaya imwe neimwe.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.hint.1: Wedzera ne probability yenyaya imwe neimwe, wedzera nyaya mbiri, uye uverenge kuti kukosha kupi kunobuda.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Kana bhora rakavigwa ritsvuku nekana ibhuruu, ...
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaparadzanisa here kuita nyaya neruvara rwebhora rekutanga, kana kupa chikonzero chekuti dzakaenzana here?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here maitiro ekuwedzera nekuwedzera ma probability enyaya kuti uwane 3/8?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.0: Kana bhora rakavigwa ritsvuku, probability tsvuku yakasara ndi2/7, uye kana ibhuruu, ndi3/7. Saka kuwedzera ne probability yadzo 3/8 ne5/8 uye kuwedzera kunopa (3/8)(2/7)+(5/8)(3/7)=3/8.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.1: Kana tisingazivi bhora rekutanga, ipapo bhora rega rega pa8 rine mukana wakaenzana wekuva rabviswa rechipiri, saka probability yekuti ritsvuku ndiyo chikamu chekutanga, 3/8.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.2: Kana bhora rakavigwa ritsvuku, probability tsvuku yakasara ndi2/7, uye kana ibhuruu, ndi3/7. Saka 3/8×2/7+5/8×3/7=3/8.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.3: Kana tisingazivi ruvara rwebhora rakavigwa, bhora rakabviswa rechipiri rakafanana nebhora ripi neripi rakasarudzwa nenzira isina kurongeka, saka probability yekuti ritsvuku ndiyo chikamu chekutanga, 3/8.

n-m-h3-serieslim-03.topic: Series: partial sum nema infinite geometric series
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.title: Ma Common Ratio eNzvimbo neKutenderera Kana Tichiramba Tichidhonza Masikweya
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.goal: Dzidza kuti kana zvimiro zvakafanana zvichidzokorora, ratio inofanana yenzvimbo yakasiyana neratio inofanana yekutenderera, uye nyora meseji inobvumira shamwari kugadzirisa kanganiso pachayo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.material: Pane sikweya R1 ine rutivi rwekureba 8. Kubatanidza pakati pemativi ayo kunogadzira sikweya R2, kubatanidza pakati pemativi eR2 kunogadzira R3, uye maitiro aya anodzokororwa nokusingaperi. Kuti uwane huwandu hwenzvimbo nehuwandu hwekutenderera kwe R1, R2, R3, …, Jiwon akatumira shamwari meseji iri pazasi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.thinking.1: Kutsvaga ratio inofanana inowirirana nehuwandu hwunoumba sequence
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.thinking.2: Kunyora tsananguro inobatsira shamwari kutarisa pachayo
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.prereq.2: Ratio yekureba neratio yenzvimbo muzvimiro zvakafanana
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumeseji yaJiwon une chinhu chakanganisa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga nzvimbo nekutenderera kwe R1 nekwe R2, uye uwane R2÷R1 zvakasiyana kune rimwe nerimwe.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzira tafura yekuti ratio inofanana ipi yakashandiswa kuhuwandu hupi (nzvimbo kana kutenderera) mumutsetse wega wega.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s1.line.0: R1 ine rutivi 8, saka nzvimbo yayo ndi 64 uye kutenderera kwayo ndi 32.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s1.line.1: Kubatanidza pakati kunoita kuti nzvimbo ive hafu chaizvo nguva dzose, saka ratio inofanana yenzvimbo ndi 1/2, uye huwandu hwenzvimbo ndi 64/(1−1/2)=128.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s1.line.2: Kutenderera kuri kwemasikweya akafanana zvakare, saka ndinogona kungoshandisa 1/2 seratio inofanana,
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s1.explain: Mitsetse 3 ne 4. Rutivi rwe R2 ndi nguva 1/√2 yerutivi rwe R1 (8÷√2), saka ratio inofanana yekutenderera ndi 1/√2. Ratio inofanana yenzvimbo isquare yayo, 1/2. Mitsetse 1 ne 2 yakarurama.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzese dzekutarisa dzaizobatsira Jiwon kuwana kanganiso pachake.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kana, kana achiita nzira imwe neimwe, Jiwon achasangana nechinhu chinopokana ne 64.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana nzira iyoyo ichishandisa ruzivo rwakawanikwa zvakasiyana nemhedzisiro yaJiwon.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.o.a: Tarisa kuti zvinoratidzika zvakanaka here kuti huwandu hwekutenderera 64 ihafu yehuwandu hwenzvimbo 128
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.r.a: Kutenderera nenzvimbo huwandu hwemayuniti akasiyana. Kuenzanisa 128 ne 64 hakutarisi chinhu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.o.b: Tsvaga kureba kwerutivi rwe R2 zvakananga nePythagorean theorem uye uriienzanise nerutivi rwe R1
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.r.b: Iyi nzira yekutarisa zvakananga kuti ratio inofanana yekutenderera ndiyo ratio yekureba kwemativi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.o.c: Sezvo masikweya ese akafanana, seta ratio yekufanana yakaenzana neratio yenzvimbo
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.r.c: Ratio yekufanana ndiyo ratio yekureba, uye ratio yenzvimbo isquare yayo. Kuiseta yakaenzana ndicho chikonzero chekanganiso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.o.d: Wedzera chaizvo kutenderera kwe R1, R2, R3 uye utarise kana kuchipfuura 64
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.r.d: 32+22.6+16 yatopfuura 70, iyo inopokana ne 64, huwandu hweseries ine mazwi ese akanaka.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.explain: B inomuita kuti awane ratio inofanana zvakananga, uye D inomubvumira kuona kupokana apo partial sum yatopfuura huwandu hwaJiwon hwe 64. A inongosimbisa kanganiso, uye C inodzokorora chikonzero chekanganiso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.prompt: Nyora meseji yekutumira kuna Jiwon. (1) Tsanangura kuti sei ratio inofanana yekutenderera isiri 1/2, uchishandisa rutivi rwesikweya diki, (2) sanganisira nzira imwe yaanogona kutarisa nayo pachake, asi (3) usanyore kukosha kwehuwandu hwakapedzwa hwekutenderera.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.hint.0: Dhonza mufananidzo wekuti rutivi rwe R2 nerutivi rwe R1 zvinoumba triangle yekona yakarurama yakadini (hypotenuse nerutivi).
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora hukama pakati peratio yenzvimbo neratio yemativi, wobva wafunga kana kukosha kumwe chete kuchishandiswa kukutenderera zvakare.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakabvuma here chikamu chaJiwon akaita zvakarurama (nzvimbo)?
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here kuti sei ratio inofanana yekutenderera isiri 1/2 uchishandisa ratio yekureba?
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakamutungamira here kunzira yekutarisa, pasina kumupa mhinduro?
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.model.0: Wakarurama kuti ratio yenzvimbo ndi 1/2. Asi kutenderera kureba, saka ratio yaro yakasiyana. Rutivi rwesikweya itsva ihafu yedhayagonari, saka inova pfupi, kusvika pa 8÷√2, uye ratio yekureba ndi 1/√2. Ratio yenzvimbo isquare yeratio yekureba, ndosaka iri 1/2. Tsvaga rutivi rwe R2 iwe pachako uye uriienzanise ne R1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.model.1: Jiwon, wakaita kuverenga kwenzvimbo zvakanaka! Asi kushandisa 1/2 seratio inofanana yekutenderera kwakatakura ratio inofanana yenzvimbo. Ratio yenzvimbo isquare yeratio yekureba, saka ratio yekutenderera ndi 1 pa √2. Tsvaga rutivi rwe R2 nePythagorean theorem uye uriienzanise ne 8, uye kana ukawedzera kutenderera kwe R1, R2, R3, unogonawo kuona kana kuchipfuura mhinduro yako ye 64.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.model.2: Nzvimbo iri mumayuniti esikweya uye kutenderera kuri mumayuniti ekureba, saka ratio dzavo dzakasiyana. Shandisa square root ye 2 kutanga kuwana kuti rutivi rwe R2 ndinguva ngani rutivi rwe R1. Wobva washandisa kukosha uku seratio inofanana.

n-m-h3-vec-01.title: Kutarisa Gadziriso ye Renji ye k Inopa Obtuse Angle
n-m-h3-vec-01.goal: Wana uye ugadzirise mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yakashandura mamiriro e obtuse angle kuita chiratidzo che dot product, uye utonge kana kutarisa kumwechete kunodiwa kumamiriro e acute-angle.
n-m-h3-vec-01.material: Iyi i gadziriso yaDain yerenji ye real numbers k kuti angle pakati pema vectors maviri a=(1, 2) ne b=(k, −1) i obtuse. (k i real number, θ inoverengwa "theta," −1 i "negative one," uye a·b inoverengwa "a dot b.")
n-m-h3-vec-01.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa direction ye "kana" ne "saka" (necessary ne sufficient)
n-m-h3-vec-01.prereq.0: Components ne dot product ye plane vectors
n-m-h3-vec-01.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pe dot product ne angle pakati pema vectors maviri a·b=|a||b|cosθ
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga unokanganisa mugadziriso yaDain.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ratidza kana mutsetse mumwe nemumwe unotevera zvakanyatsonaka kubva pamutsetse wakapfuura, kana i chirevo chine converse inofanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora renji ye θ apo cosθ<0, kubva ku 0° kusvika ku 180°, kusanganisira magumo.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.line.1: Kana angle i obtuse, ipapo cosθ<0 uye |a|, |b| i positive, saka a·b<0.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.line.2: Zvakapesana, kana a·b<0 ipapo angle i obtuse, saka mamiriro chete e obtuse angle i a·b<0.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.line.4: Saka renji ye k i k < 2.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.explain: Unotanga kukanganisa pamutsetse 3. Mutsetse 2 unotaura direction imwe chete: "kana angle i obtuse, ipapo a·b<0." Mutsetse 3 wakatakura direction yakapesana ("kana a·b<0, ipapo angle i obtuse") sezvayakaita, asi a·b<0 inosanganisira mamiriro ose apo θ i yakakura kupfuura 90° uye 180° kana pasi, saka 180° (parallel mumadirection akapesana chaizvo) yakasanganisirwawo. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 inotevera mutsetse 3, saka mhedziso i kwakanganisa. Kuverenga mumutsetse 1 kwakarurama.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mutsetse usina kururama uye unyore renji yakarurama ye k. Ipapo, kana pane mutengo wekubvisa kubva murenji, nyora mutengo iwoyo uye utsanangure kuti ma vectors maviri anoratidzika sei panguva iyoyo.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wawana k apo b i real multiple ye a (ma vectors anofanana).
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kune k iyoyo, nyora chiratidzo che a·b nema directions emavectors maviri padivi pedivi uye uenzanise.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso, a·b<0, asi inosanganisira mamiriro apo ..., saka ...
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakawana mutengo we k apo b i parallel ku a here?
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Pamutengo iwoyo, wakatarisa zvose chiratidzo che a·b nehukuru hwe angle here?
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutaura mumutsara mumwe nei "a·b<0" ne "obtuse angle" zvisiri chirevo chimwechete here?
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.model.0: Kuti b ive parallel ku a, kubva ku (k, −1)=λ(1, 2) tinowana λ=−1/2 uye k=−1/2. Ipapo a·b=−5/2 i negative, asi b inonongedza kudirection yakapesana chaizvo ne a, saka angle i 180° uye haisi obtuse. Saka renji i k<2, k≠−1/2.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.model.1: Kana a·b<0 ipapo 90°<θ≤180°, saka 180° yakasanganiswa. Kana k=−1/2, b=(−1/2, −1)=−(1/2)a, saka ma vectors i parallel mumadirection akapesana. Kubvisa mutengo uyu, k<2 uye k haisi −1/2.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Unogona kuinyorawo nezviratidzo se k<−1/2 kana −1/2<k<2.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.prompt: Uchishandisa nzira imwechete, renji ye m apo angle pakati pe a=(1, 2) ne c=(m, 4) i acute yakagadziriswa ne "a·c>0." Sarudza mutengo mumwe unofanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana kana kubviswa kubva murenji.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wawana mutengo we m apo c i positive real multiple ye a.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana m iyoyo i pakati pemitengo inogutsa a·c>0.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.a: m=−8 i mutengo apo a·c=0, wakatobviswa nechiratidzo ">". Hausi mutengo mutsva wekutarisa.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.b: Sarudzo iyi inoongorora kana, pakati pemitengo ine a·c>0, kune mamiriro apo c inova parallel ku a mudirection imwechete.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.c: c=(8, 4) haisi parallel ku a. I mutengo wakajairika unopa acute angle.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.d: c=(−2, 4) ine a·c>0 uye haisi parallel ku a. I mutengo wakajairika unopa acute angle.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.explain: Kana a·c=m+8>0, ipapo m>−8. Pakati peizvi, mamiriro apo c=(m, 4) i parallel ku a=(1, 2) mudirection imwechete i c=2a, ndiko kuti, m=2, uye ipapo angle i 0°, iyo isiri acute. Saka m>−8, m≠2. Kune obtuse angle, direction yakapesana chaizvo (180°) inopinda pamuganhu, uye kune acute angle, direction imwechete (0°) ndiyo inopinda.

n-m-h3-vec-02.title: Tinoda Kuziva Chii Kuwana Distance Pakati Pepoinzi Ne Plane?
n-m-h3-vec-02.goal: Rongera kuti ruzivo rupi rwakakwana nerupi rusina kukwana kusarudza distance kubva papoinzi kuenda ku plane, tsanangura mamiriro asina kukwana nema counterexamples, wobva wasetawo equation chaiyo ye plane uye uwane distance.
n-m-h3-vec-02.material: Unoda kuwana distance kubva papoinzi P(1, 1, 1) mu space kuenda ku plane α. Fungidzira kuti chidimbu cheruzivo chimwe nechimwe pazasi chinopiwa nezve plane α zvakaparadzana. (Normal vector i vector i perpendicular ku plane. Ma coordinates anoverengwa se (x, y, z).)
n-m-h3-vec-02.thinking.1: Kutsanangura nema counterexamples nei ruzivo rusina kukwana
n-m-h3-vec-02.thinking.2: Kuseta equation ye plane kubva pamapoinzi matatu
n-m-h3-vec-02.prereq.0: Equation ye plane ax+by+cz+d=0 ne normal vectors
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.prompt: Pakati peruzivo runotevera, sarudza rwose runoita kuti, kana rwega rwapiwa, distance kubva ku P kuenda ku α isarudzwe semutengo mumwe chete.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kune chidimbu cheruzivo chimwe nechimwe, fungidzira kuti ma planes mangani angagutsa.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kana ukawana ma planes maviri ane ma distances akasiyana, ruzivo irworwo harwuna kukwana.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.a: Ma planes anopfuura mapoinzi maviri anogona kutenderedzwa kutenderedza mutsetse unopfuura napo, saka kune asingaperi. Distance haisarudzwi.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.o.b: Poinzi imwe pa α ne normal vector ye α
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.b: Poinzi inogadzirisa nzvimbo ye plane uye normal vector inogadzirisa kurereka kwayo. Waona kuti uyu i ruzivo runosarudza plane nenzira yega.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.c: Normal vector inotaura kurereka kwe plane chete. Kune ma planes anofanana asingaperi ane normal vector imwechete.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.o.d: Mapoinzi matatu pa α asiri pamutsetse mumwe
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.d: Mapoinzi matatu asiri pamutsetse mumwe anosarudza plane nenzira yega. Kana plane yasarudzwa, distance inosarudzwawo.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.o.e: Mapoinzi matatu pa α ari pamutsetse mumwe
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.e: Kana mapoinzi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe, i ruzivo rwe mutsetse chete, saka plane haisarudzwi.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.explain: Kuti distance isarudzwe semutengo mumwe chete, plane α inofanira kusarudzwa nenzira yega. Plane inosarudzwa ne "poinzi ne normal vector" kana ne "mapoinzi matatu asiri pamutsetse mumwe." Mapoinzi maviri akasiyana kana mapoinzi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe anosiya ma planes asingaperi, uye normal vector oga inosiya ma planes anofanana asingaperi.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.prompt: Ruzivo rwekuti "normal vector ye α chete yakapiwa" harusarudze distance. Tsanangura nekupa muenzaniso wema planes maviri ane normal vector imwechete asi ma distances akasiyana kubva ku P.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora ma equations maviri e ma planes ane normal vector (0, 0, 1).
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.hint.1: Wana distance kubva papoinzi P kuenda kuplane imwe neimwe yemaviri uye uienzanise.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Kunyange ma normal vectors akafanana, ...
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora ma equations ema planes maviri zvakajeka here?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaverenga distance kubva ku P kuenda kuplane imwe neimwe uye wakaratidza kuti dzakasiyana here?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutsanangura nemashoko e "kurereka kumwechete, nzvimbo yakasiyana" here?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.0: Kunyange normal vector i imwechete, (1, 0, 0), ma planes x=2 ne x=5 i ma parallel planes akasiyana. Ma distances avo kubva ku P(1, 1, 1) i 1 ne 4, akasiyana.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.1: Kune ma parallel planes asingaperi ane normal vector imwechete, uye nzvimbo dzavo dzakasiyana. Semuenzaniso, z=0 ne z=3 zvine normal imwechete, asi ma distances avo kubva ku P anobuda akasiyana, 1 ne 2.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.2: Ma planes z=0 ne z=3, ane normal (0,0,1), ari pa distances 1 ne 2 kubva papoinzi P(1,1,1).
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.3: Ma planes z=1 ne z=4 ane normal vector imwechete (0,0,1). Ma distances avo kubva ku P i 0 ne 3, saka akasiyana.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.prompt: Fungidzira α inopfuura mapoinzi matatu A(1, 0, 0), B(0, 2, 0), C(0, 0, 3). Sarudza distance kubva ku P(1, 1, 1) kuenda ku α.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.hint.0: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti mapoinzi matatu ari pama coordinate axes kuseta equation ye plane pakutanga, uye utarise nekuisa mapoinzi matatu.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kuti denominator mufomula ye distance i magnitude ye normal vector.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.a: Pamwe wakashandisa mutengo wakaitwa square 49 mu denominator panzvimbo ye magnitude ye normal vector √(36+9+4)=7.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.b: Wakaseta plane se 6x+3y+2z=6, wakawana 6+3+2−6=5, uye wakagovanisa ne magnitude ye normal 7.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.c: Pamwe hauna kubvisa constant term ye plane 6 kubva pamutengo wakaiswa 6+3+2.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.d: Pamwe wakanganisa ma intercepts 1, 2, 3 se coefficients uye wakaseta plane se x+2y+3z=1 kana chimwe chakadai.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.explain: Mapoinzi matatu ane x-intercept 1, y-intercept 2, z-intercept 3, saka plane i x/1+y/2+z/3=1, ndiko kuti, 6x+3y+2z−6=0. Distance kubva ku P i |6+3+2−6|/√(36+9+4)=5/7.

n-m-h3-vec-03.title: Kana Ma Direction Vectors i Parallel, Mitsetse Yakafanana here?
n-m-h3-vec-03.goal: Rongera kuti humbowo hupi kubva pama direction vectors nemapoinzi emitsetse miviri hwakakwana kutonga kana i mutsetse mumwechete, uye utarise iwe pachako mamiriro apo humbowo husina kukwana.
n-m-h3-vec-03.material:
Mitsetse mitatu mu space inonyorwa neparameters t ne s. (t ne s i real numbers. l₁ inoverengwa "l one," uye (2, −1, 1) i vector ine components 2, −1, 1.)
l₁: (x, y, z) = (1, 0, 2) + t(2, −1, 1)
l₂: (x, y, z) = (3, −1, 3) + s(−4, 2, −2)
l₃: (x, y, z) = (3, −1, 4) + s(−4, 2, −2)
Mina, Hajun, Seoyun, naDohyun vakaita zvirevo zvinotevera nezve hukama pakati pe l₁ ne l₂.
n-m-h3-vec-03.thinking.1: Kutarisa kana mitsetse i imwechete kunyange ma expressions akasiyana
n-m-h3-vec-03.thinking.2: Kusiyanisa necessary conditions ne sufficient conditions
n-m-h3-vec-03.prereq.0: Vector equation (parametric form) yemutsetse mu space
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.prompt: Pakati pezvirevo zvevanhu vana nezve l₁ ne l₂, sarudza chirevo chine kufunga kusina mikaha.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga watarisa kuti unowanza direction vector imwe nenhamba ipi kuwana imwe.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ipapo isa ma coordinates epoinzi inopfuurwa ne l₂ mufomula ye l₁ uye utarise kana t inokodzera iripo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.a: Mina: Ma direction vectors (2, −1, 1) ne (−4, 2, −2) haaenzani, saka l₁ ne l₂ i mitsetse yakasiyana.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.a: Wakatarisa chete chokwadi chekuti ma direction vectors haasi expression imwechete. Pakusarudza mutsetse, direction vector inogona kunyorwa nekureba nedirection (chiratidzo) zvakasiyana.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.b: Hajun: Ma direction vectors (2, −1, 1) ne (−4, 2, −2) i parallel, saka l₁ ne l₂ i mutsetse mumwechete.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.b: Mhedziso yakarurama asi kufunga hakukwani. Mitsetse ine ma direction vectors anongova parallel ingava mitsetse yakafanana yakasiyana.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.c: Seoyun: Ma direction vectors (2, −1, 1) ne (−4, 2, −2) haasi parallel, saka l₁ ne l₂ i skew.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.c: (−4, 2, −2) i −2 yakawanzwa ne (2, −1, 1), saka i parallel. Hauna kunyange kutarisa kuverenga kwekuti i parallel here.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.d: Dohyun: Ma direction vectors i parallel uye poinzi (3, −1, 3) inopfuurwa ne l₂ iri pa l₁, saka mitsetse miviri i mutsetse mumwechete.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.d: Ma directions akafanana uye vanogovana poinzi, saka mitsetse inopindirana. Mamiriro ose maviri akatariswa sehumbowo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.explain: (−4, 2, −2)=−2(2, −1, 1), saka ma direction vectors i parallel. Uyewo, kuisa t=1 mu l₁ kunopa (3, −1, 3), saka poinzi ye l₂ iri pa l₁. Kana ma directions i parallel uye poinzi imwe yapindirana, mitsetse i imwechete. Ma direction vectors anongova parallel haakwani, uye ma direction vectors kusava expression imwechete hazvireve kuti mitsetse yakasiyana.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino, enzanisa l₃ (poinzi (3, −1, 4), direction vector (−4, 2, −2)) ne l₁. Sarudza kana mitsetse miviri i imwechete, uye unyore kufunga kwekutonga kwako pamwe chete nekuverenga kwako.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa ma x ne y coordinates epoinzi ye l₃ (3, −1, 4) nefomula ye l₁ uye uwane t.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa t iyoyo kuverenga z coordinate zvakare uye uienzanise nepoinzi ye l₃.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Direction vector ye l₃ i ... uye poinzi ye l₃ i ...
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatanga watarisa kuti ma direction vectors i parallel here?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaisa poinzi ye l₃ mufomula ye l₁ uye wakaenzanisa ma coordinates ose matatu here?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakataura kuti "mitsetse inogona kuva ne directions dzakafanana pasina kuva mutsetse mumwechete" here?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.model.0: Direction vector ye l₃ i −2 yakawanzwa ne ye l₁, saka i parallel. Asi kana tikaisa poinzi ye l₃ (3, −1, 4) mu l₁, x ne y zvinopa t=1, uye ipapo z=3, iyo yakasiyana ne 4, saka poinzi haisi pa l₁. Saka i parallel asi haisi mutsetse mumwechete.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.model.1: Kunyange nedirection imwechete, hatigone kutaura kuti i mutsetse mumwechete. Kubva ku (1+2t, −t, 2+t)=(3, −1, 4), ma equations maviri ekutanga anopa t=1 asi wechitatu unopa t=2, kupokana. Poinzi haisi pa l₁, saka i mitsetse yakafanana yakasiyana.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza hukama pakati pemutsetse l₄: (x, y, z) = (5, −2, 4) + u(−6, 3, −3) ne l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wawana hukama hwe multiple pakati pema direction vectors.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.hint.1: Isa poinzi ye l₄ mufomula ye l₁ kutarisa kana iri pa l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.o.a: I parallel ku l₁ asi i mutsetse wakasiyana
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.a: Wakatarisa chete kuti ma direction vectors i parallel uye hauna kutarisa kana poinzi iri pa l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.b: Sarudzo iyi yakatarisa zvose kuti ma direction vectors i parallel uye kuti poinzi iri pa l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.o.c: Inosangana ne l₁ papoinzi imwe chete
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.c: Mitsetse miviri ine ma direction vectors akafanana haigone kusangana papoinzi imwe chete. Kana ichisangana, inopindirana; kana kwete, haisangani.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.d: Mitsetse miviri ine ma direction vectors akafanana haigone kuva skew. Mitsetse skew haisi parallel kana intersecting.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.explain: (−6, 3, −3)=−3(2, −1, 1), saka i parallel. Kuisa t=2 mu l₁ kunopa (5, −2, 4), saka poinzi ye l₄ iri pa l₁. Saka l₄ i mutsetse mumwechete ne l₁. Mutsetse mumwechete unogona kutaurwa nesarudzo ipi neipi yepoinzi ne direction vector.

n-m-h3-vec-05.title: Kugadzira Mutsetse Usingasangani Nendege
n-m-h3-vec-05.goal: Usafunga mamiriro ekuti mutsetse usasangane nendege semamiriro mumwe chete pa direction vector; funga nyaya apo mutsetse uri mundege, uye ugadzire mienzaniso.
n-m-h3-vec-05.material: Mu space pane ndege α: x + y − 2z = 0. Unoda kugadzira mutsetse l unopfuura papoinzi (p, 1, 1) une direction vector (a, b, c) zvekuti usasangane ne α. (l inoverengwa "el," p iinteger, uye direction vector (a, b, c) ivector ine zvikamu a, b, c.)
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.0: Kugadzira mienzaniso inogutsa mamiriro iwe pachako
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.1: Kutarisa muganhu pakati pe parallel ne contained
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.2: Kutara nzvimbo yemutsetse zvichienderana nendege nemamiriro maviri
n-m-h3-vec-05.prereq.0: Equation yemutsetse ne equation yendege mu space
n-m-h3-vec-05.prereq.1: Normal vector yendege ne dot product
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza (p, a, b, c) zvekuti mutsetse l: (x, y, z) = (p, 1, 1) + t(a, b, c) usasangane nendege α: x + y − 2z = 0. p, a, b, c ndema integer uye (a, b, c) haifaniri kuva zero vector. Kuti ma direction vector enzira imwe chete asadzokororwa, greatest common divisor ye a, b, c inofanira kuva 1, uye kana a>0 kana (a=0 ne b>0). Gadzira mienzaniso mitatu ine ma direction vector akasiyana.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga sarudza hukama hwaunofanira kuva pakati pe direction vector ne normal vector yendege kuti mutsetse uenderane nendege.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.hint.1: Mushure mekugadzira muenzaniso mumwe, tarisawo kuti poinzi iri pamutsetse iri pandege here.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c1: p, a, b, c ndema integer ane absolute value ye50 zvakanyanya.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c1: p, a, b, c zvinofanira kuva ma integer ane absolute value ye50 zvakanyanya.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c2: Direction vector haisi zero vector, greatest common divisor yayo ndi1, uye mamiriro echiratidzo anoshandawo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Direction vector haifaniri kuva zero vector, greatest common divisor yayo inofanira kuva 1, uye kana a>0 kana (a=0 ne b>0).
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c3: Direction vector iperpendicular ku normal vector yendege.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c3: Tarisa hukama pakati pe direction vector ne normal vector yendege (1, 1, −2) kuti nzira yemutsetse ienderane nendege.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c4: Tarisa kuti mutsetse hausangani nendege kunyangwe papoinzi imwe here, uye kuti poinzi (p, 1, 1) iri pamutsetse iri pandege here.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.explain: Normal vector yendege ndi (1, 1, −2). Kuti mutsetse usasangane nendege, direction vector yawo inofanira kuva perpendicular ku normal vector, saka a+b−2c=0. Asi izvozvo oga zvingasiya mutsetse uri mundege. Kana poinzi (p, 1, 1) iri pamutsetse iri pandege (p+1−2=0, ndiko kuti, p=1), mutsetse wose uri mundege. Saka p≠1 inodiwawo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.prompt: Tsanangura kuti nei usingagoni kushandisa direction vector inogutsa a+b−2c=0 kana p=1.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.hint.0: Kana p=1, isa coordinates dzepoinzi yainopfuura mutsetse mu equation yendege.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.hint.1: Funga kuti chii chinoitika kumapoinzi mamwe ari pamutsetse kana mamiriro e direction vector ashandiswawo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Kana p=1, poinzi iri pamutsetse ...
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here kuti poinzi (1, 1, 1) iri pamutsetse iri pandege x+y−2z=0 kana p=1?
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Unogona kutaura here kuti nei mamiriro e direction vector oga asingavimbisi "hausangani"?
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.model.0: Kana p=1, poinzi (1, 1, 1) yainopfuura mutsetse iri pandege. Uye kana nzira inoenderanawo nendege, poinzi yose iri pamutsetse iri pandege, saka mutsetse uri mundege. Ipapo hauna kusasangana nendege; unosangana nayo mumapoinzi asingaperi.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.model.1: Kana p=1, (1,1,1) inogutsa ndege x+y−2z=0, saka poinzi iri pamutsetse iri pandege. Direction vector iperpendicular ku normal, saka mutsetse wose uri mundege, izvo zvinoita kuti uve contained panzvimbo ye parallel.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza hukama pakati pemutsetse m: (x, y, z) = (1, 0, 0) + t(0, 1, 1) nendege β: y − z = 0.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga verenga dot product ye direction vector ne normal vector yendege.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isa coordinates dzepoinzi yainopfuura mutsetse mu equation yendege.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.a: Pamwe hauna kutarisa kuti dot product ye direction vector ne normal vector (0, 1, −1) ndi0 here.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.b: Pamwe wakangotarisa kuti nzira inoenderana nendege uye hauna kutarisa kuti poinzi iri pamutsetse iri pandege here.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.c: Sarudzo iyi yakatarisa kuti direction vector iperpendicular ku normal uye kuti poinzi (1, 0, 0) iri pamutsetse iri pandege.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.d: Kana direction vector iperpendicular ku normal vector, mutsetse unoenderana nendege. Kuti uve perpendicular kundege, direction vector inofanira kuenderana ne normal vector.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.explain: Dot product ye direction vector (0, 1, 1) ne normal vector (0, 1, −1) ndi0, saka mutsetse unoenderana nendege. Zvakare, poinzi (1, 0, 0) inogutsa y−z=0, saka iri pandege. Saka mutsetse uri mundege.

n-m-h3-vec-06.title: Kutsanangurira Munin'ina Asati Aziva Cosine Dot Product
n-m-h3-vec-06.goal: Tsanangura zvinoreva dot product (nhamba imwe inoratidza kuti ma vector maviri anonongedza nzira imwe chete zvakadini) kuvateereri vasingazivi cosine, nekushandura mamiriro.
n-m-h3-vec-06.material: Jisu akatsanangura dot product yema vector kumunin'ina wake wegrade 7 seizvi: "Dot product yema vector maviri a ne b ndi |a||b|cosθ. Unongowedzera zvikamu woziwedzera, uye ndi0 kana ari perpendicular." Munin'ina wake haasati aziva cos, saka akabvunza zvakare, "Asi dot product chii?" (|a| ihukuru hwe a, θ inoverengwa "theta," uye cos ndi cosine.)
n-m-h3-vec-06.prereq.0: Definition ye dot product nekona iri pakati pema vector maviri
n-m-h3-vec-06.prereq.1: Chiratidzo che dot product nemamiriro e perpendicular
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara unotsanangura zvakanakisa zvinoreva dot product nemashoko anogona kunzwisiswa nemunin'ina wako.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga taura kuti mutsara mumwe nemumwe unoti mhedzisiro ye dot product inhamba kana vector.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.hint.1: Yedza mutsara mumwe nemumwe kuti kana ma vector maviri achinongedza nzira imwe chete, ari perpendicular, nekana achinongedza nzira dzakapesana.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.a: Dot product inhamba imwe inoratidza kuti vector imwe inonongedza nzira imwe chete nemumwe zvakadini, ichifunga hukuru hwazvo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.a: Tsananguro iyi inobata zvose zvinhu zve dot product: inokura kana nzira dzichienderana zvakanyanya, ndi0 kana iri perpendicular, uye inova negative kana dzichinongedza nzira dzakapesana.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.b: Dot product inzira yekuverenga inowedzera zvikamu zvema vector maviri kuti ipe vector itsva. Mhedzisiro iriwo museve.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.b: Mhedzisiro ye dot product haisi vector asi nhamba imwe. Wakasanganisa nzira yekuverenga nerudzi rwemhedzisiro.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.c: Dot product ndiyo product yehukuru hwema vector maviri. Inopa kukosha kumwe chete chero museve ichinongedza nzira ipi.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.c: Kukosha kwe dot product kunoenderana nekona iri pakati pema vector maviri. Tsananguro iyi inoregeredza nzira.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.d: Dot product ikukosha kunokuudza kona iri pakati pema vector maviri mumadhigirii. Kana ari pakona yakarurama, unowana 90.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.d: Dot product haisi kona pachayo. Pakona yakarurama dot product ndi0, kwete 90.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.explain: Dot product inhamba imwe inoenderana nehukuru hwema vector maviri nekona iri pakati pazvo. Inokura kana nzira dzichiwirirana zvakanyanya, ndi0 kana iri perpendicular, uye inova negative kana dzichinongedza nzira dzakapesana. A akafunga mhedzisiro ive vector, B akaregeredza nzira, uye D akaisanganisa nekona pachayo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.prompt: Zvino nyora iwe pachako tsananguro yekutumira kumunin'ina wako. (1) Itsanangure nenyaya yekudhonza sled nerwonde, (2) enzanisa kudhonza nzira imwe chete neyakaenda sled nekudhonza zvakananga (kumusoro), uye (3) usashandise mashoko senge cos, θ, kana projection.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga fungidzira nyaya apo nzira yakaenda sled nenzira yerwonde rwunodhonza zvakafanana.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.hint.1: Wobva wafunga kuti zvakawanda zvakadini zvinoshandiswa pakuenda mberi kana kudhonza kwerwonde kuri pakona yakarurama kunzira yekufamba.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakashandura here kuita nyaya inonzwisiswa nemunin'ina wako (sled, ngoro, zvichingodaro)?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaenzanisa here nzira imwe chete, nzira yakatsvedza, nenyaya yeperpendicular?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaisa here "zvakawanda zvakadini zvinoshandiswa munzira imwe chete" mumashoko panzvimbo yefomula?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.0: Kana ukadhonza sled nerwonde, kana rwonde rwuri munzira imwe chete neyakaenda sled, simba rako rose rinoenda mukufamba mberi. Kana rwonde rwakatsvedza, chikamu chesimba chete chinoshandiswa, uye kana ukadhonza zvakananga kudenga, hapana chinoenda mukufamba mberi, saka ndi0. Dot product inhamba imwe inokuudza kuti simba rakawanda zvakadini rinoshandiswa munzira yarinoenda.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.1: Kana uchisunda ngoro, inoenda zvakanaka kana wasunda munzira imwe chete yainoenda. Kana nzira yakatsauka zvishoma, inoenda zvishoma zvakanaka, uye kana ukasunda padivi pakona yakarurama, hapana chinobatsira ngoro kuenda mberi, saka ndi0. Dot product inhamba yekuti museve miviri inonongedza nzira imwe chete zvakadini.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.2: Kana ukadhonza rwonde kumusoro, hapana chinoshandiswa kuenda mberi, saka ndi0. Kana rwuri chaizvo munzira yakaenda sled, simba rose rinoshandiswa.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.3: Kana ukadhonza zvakananga munzira yakaenda sled, simba rose rinoshandiswa, uye kana rwakatsvedza, chikamu chete chinoshandiswa. Pakona yakarurama, ndi0.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.prompt: Munin'ina wako akabvunza, "Zvino ndeapi mamiriro apo dot product iri negative?" Sarudza inokodzera munyaya ye sled.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kune nzira imwe chete, perpendicular, nenzira yakapesana, nyora kuti imwe neimwe inobatsira here kana inodzivirira kuenda mberi.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti chiratidzo che dot product chinobatana sei nekuti inobatsira zvakadini.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.a: Kana rwonde rwunodhonza chaizvo munzira yakaenda sled
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.a: Munzira imwe chete, dot product ihuwandu hwepositive hukuru zvikuru.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.b: Kana rwonde rwadhonzwa kumusoro pakona yakarurama
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.c: Kana rwonde rwunodhonza zvakapesana nenzira yakaenda sled
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.c: Kana ichinongedza nzira yakapesana, inodzivirira kuenda mberi, saka dot product inegative.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.d: Kana rwonde rwunodhonza rwakatsvedza munzira imwe chete yakaenda sled
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.d: Munzira yakatsvedza kudivi rimwe chete, dot product ipositive uye kona iri pasi pe90°.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.explain: Dot product inova nhamba yepositive hombe kana ma vector maviri achinongedza kudivi rimwe chete zvakanyanya, ndi0 kana iri perpendicular, uye inova negative kana achinongedza kumativi akapesana. Munyaya ye sled, kudhonza nenzira yakapesana kunodzivirira kuenda mberi, saka kunoenderana nekukosha kwenegative.

n-m-h3-vec-07.title: Kana Hapana Ndege Mbiri Dzinoenderana, Ndege Nhatu Dzinosangana Papoinzi Imwe Here?
n-m-h3-vec-07.goal: Tarisa fanotaura yenzvimbo dzendege nhatu nemuenzaniso unopikisa waunogadzira iwe pachako, uye utsanangure chimiro chine muenzaniso unopikisa.
n-m-h3-vec-07.material: Funga ndege nhatu dzakasiyana. Shamwari yakati kana pasina ndege mbiri dzinoenderana, ndege nhatu dzinogara dzichisangana papoinzi imwe. Ndege mbiri x=0 ne y=0 hadzienderani, uye dzinosangana mumutsetse. (x=0 inoverengwa "x inoenzana ne0," uye ax+by+cz=d ndiyo equation yendege.)
n-m-h3-vec-07.thinking.0: Kuyedza fanotaura nemienzaniso yaunogadzira iwe pachako
n-m-h3-vec-07.thinking.2: Kutsanangura nzvimbo uchishandisa kurongeka kwemitsetse yekupindirana
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga tsvaga mutsetse apo ndege x=0 ne y=0 dzinosangana.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti zvinofanana pakati pazvo zvinochinja zvichienderana nekuti ndege yechitatu inosangana sei nemutsetse iwoyo.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.a: Hazvigari zvakarurama. Pane nyaya apo ndege nhatu dzisina poinzi yakafanana
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kwakafungawo hukama pakati pemutsetse apo ndege mbiri dzinosangana nendege yechitatu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.b: Inogara yakarurama. Ndege dzisingaenderani dzinosangana, saka ndege nhatu dzinosangana papoinzi imwe
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.b: Ndege mbiri dzichisangana mapeya nendege nhatu dzine poinzi yakafanana zvinhu zvakasiyana.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.c: Hazvigari zvakarurama. Asi pane nyaya mbiri chete: kusangana papoinzi kana mumutsetse
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.c: Hauna kuongorora nyaya isina poinzi yakafanana. Funga nyaya apo ndege yechitatu inoenderana nemutsetse wekupindirana wendege mbiri dzekutanga.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.d: Inogara yakarurama. Ndege nhatu hadzisangani chete kana mbiri dzacho dzichienderana
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.d: Uku kutonga kusina kutarisa zvakananga kuti pangava nehapana poinzi yakafanana kunyangwe pasina ndege dzinoenderana.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.explain: Ndege x=0 ne y=0 dzinosangana mu z-axis. Mhedzisiro inoenderana nekuti ndege yechitatu inosangana nemutsetse uyu here kana kwete. Kunyangwe pasina ndege mbiri pakati penhatu dzinoenderana, dzinogona kusava nepoinzi yakafanana. Tarisa kuti izvi zvechokwadi here nekugadzira muenzaniso iwe pachako.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.prompt: Pane ndege x=0 ne y=0. Sarudza ndege yechitatu ax + by + cz = d zvekuti hapana ndege mbiri pakati penhatu dzinoenderana uye ndege nhatu dzisina poinzi yakafanana. a, b, c, d ndema real number. Gadzira ndege nhatu dzakasiyana.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga tsvaga kuti mutsetse apo ndege x=0 ne y=0 dzinosangana uri papi.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti equation inofanira kuva nechimiro chakadini kuti hapana poinzi iri pamutsetse iwoyo inogutsa ndege yechitatu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndege yechitatu inoenderana nendege x=0. Tarisa kuti normal vector (a, b, c) inoenderana ne (1, 0, 0) here.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Plane yechitatu iri parallel neplane y=0. Tarisa kana normal vector (a, b, c) iri parallel ne (0, 1, 0).
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Hapana poinzi inopfuurwa neplanes dzose nhatu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Pane poinzi inopfuurwa neplanes dzose nhatu. Tarisa kana poinzi iri pamutsetse apo planes x=0 ne y=0 dzinosangana iri paplane yechitatu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.explain: Planes x=0 ne y=0 dzinosangana muz-axis. Kana plane yechitatu ichipfuura kunyange poinzi imwe chete iri paz-axis, planes nhatu dzine poinzi yakafanana. Kuisa poinzi (0, 0, z) iri paz-axis kunopa cz=d, uye kuti hapana z inogutsa izvi tinoda c=0 uye d≠0. Zvakare, a ne b dzinofanira kuva dzisiri 0 kuti plane irege kuva parallel ne x=0 ne y=0.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.prompt: Uchitora imwe yeplanes dzawakagadzira semuenzaniso, tsanangura kuti nei planes nhatu dzichisangana mbiri imwe nenguva asi dzisina poinzi yakafanana pakati pedzose nhatu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kuti chii chinoitika kana uchiisa poinzi iri pamutsetse wakagadzirwa ne x=0 ne y=0 muplane yawakagadzira.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti mitsetse mitatu inogadzirwa apo planes dzinosangana mbiri imwe nenguva inobatana sei kune mumwe nemumwe.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Mutsetse apo x=0 ne y=0 zvinosangana i ..., uye plane yechitatu ...
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti mitsetse mitatu yekusangana kweplanes yakarongwa sei here?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaratidza nefomula kuti nei plane yechitatu isingasangani nez-axis here?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakasiyanisa kuti dzinosangana mbiri imwe nenguva asi dzisingasangani nhatu pamwe chete here?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.0: Tora x+y=1, semuenzaniso. x=0 ne y=0 zvinosangana muz-axis, asi x+y=1 iparallel nez-axis, uye poinzi iri paz-axis ine x+y=0, saka haigoni kugutsa plane iyi. Hapana planes mbiri dziri parallel, asi hapana poinzi yakafanana kudzose nhatu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.1: Mitsetse mitatu yekusangana kweplanes yose mitsetse iri parallel nez-axis. Seyezviso zvitatu zvemativi etriangular prism, planes dzinosangana mbiri imwe nenguva, asi hapana poinzi inopfuurwa nedzose nhatu pamwe chete.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.2: x+y=1 iparallel nez-axis. Kuisa poinzi (0,0,z) iri paz-axis mairi kunopa 0=1, izvo zvisingagoneki, saka hapana poinzi yakafanana kuplanes nhatu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.3: Z-axis iparallel neplane yechitatu, saka hadzisangani. Saka planes dzinosangana mbiri imwe nenguva, asi hapana poinzi apo dzose nhatu dzinosangana pamwe chete.
